\chapter{Al-Baqarah (The Cow)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Aliflammeem}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thalika alkitabu la rayba feehi hudan lilmuttaqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena yuminoona bialghaybi wayuqeemoona alssalata wamimma razaqnahum yunfiqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena yuminoona bima onzila ilayka wama onzila min qablika wabialakhirati hum yooqinoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Olaika AAala hudan min rabbihim waolaika humu almuflihoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena kafaroo sawaon AAalayhim aanthartahum am lam tunthirhum la yuminoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Khatama Allahu AAala quloobihim waAAala samAAihim waAAala absarihim ghishawatun walahum AAathabun AAatheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wamina alnnasi man yaqoolu amanna biAllahi wabialyawmi alakhiri wama hum bimumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{YukhadiAAoona Allaha waallatheena amanoo wama yakhdaAAoona illa anfusahum wama yashAAuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fee quloobihim maradun fazadahumu Allahu maradan walahum AAathabun aleemun bima kanoo yakthiboona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha qeela lahum la tufsidoo fee alardi qaloo innama nahnu muslihoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ala innahum humu almufsidoona walakin la yashAAuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha qeela lahum aminoo kama amana alnnasu qaloo anuminu kama amana alssufahao ala innahum humu alssufahao walakin la yaAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha laqoo allatheena amanoo qaloo amanna waitha khalaw ila shayateenihim qaloo inna maAAakum innama nahnu mustahzioona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allahu yastahzio bihim wayamudduhum fee tughyanihim yaAAmahoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Olaika allatheena ishtarawoo alddalalata bialhuda fama rabihat tijaratuhum wama kanoo muhtadeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Mathaluhum kamathali allathee istawqada naran falamma adaat ma hawlahu thahaba Allahu binoorihim watarakahum fee thulumatin la yubsiroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Summun bukmun AAumyun fahum la yarjiAAoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Aw kasayyibin mina alssamai feehi thulumatun waraAAdun wabarqun yajAAaloona asabiAAahum fee athanihim mina alssawaAAiqi hathara almawti waAllahu muheetun bialkafireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yakadu albarqu yakhtafu absarahum kullama adaa lahum mashaw feehi waitha athlama AAalayhim qamoo walaw shaa Allahu lathahaba bisamAAihim waabsarihim inna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha alnnasu oAAbudoo rabbakumu allathee khalaqakum waallatheena min qablikum laAAallakum tattaqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allathee jaAAala lakumu alarda firashan waalssamaa binaan waanzala mina alssamai maan faakhraja bihi mina alththamarati rizqan lakum fala tajAAaloo lillahi andadan waantum taAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain kuntum fee raybin mimma nazzalna AAala AAabdina fatoo bisooratin min mithlihi waodAAoo shuhadaakum min dooni Allahi in kuntum sadiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fain lam tafAAaloo walan tafAAaloo faittaqoo alnnara allatee waqooduha alnnasu waalhijaratu oAAiddat lilkafireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wabashshiri allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati anna lahum jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu kullama ruziqoo minha min thamaratin rizqan qaloo hatha allathee ruziqna min qablu waotoo bihi mutashabihan walahum feeha azwajun mutahharatun wahum feeha khalidoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna Allaha la yastahyee an yadriba mathalan ma baAAoodatan fama fawqaha faamma allatheena amanoo fayaAAlamoona annahu alhaqqu min rabbihim waamma allatheena kafaroo fayaqooloona matha arada Allahu bihatha mathalan yudillu bihi katheeran wayahdee bihi katheeran wama yudillu bihi illa alfasiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena yanqudoona AAahda Allahi min baAAdi meethaqihi wayaqtaAAoona ma amara Allahu bihi an yoosala wayufsidoona fee alardi olaika humu alkhasiroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Kayfa takfuroona biAllahi wakuntum amwatan faahyakum thumma yumeetukum thumma yuhyeekum thumma ilayhi turjaAAoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Huwa allathee khalaqa lakum ma fee alardi jameeAAan thumma istawa ila alssamai fasawwahunna sabAAa samawatin wahuwa bikulli shayin AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith qala rabbuka lilmalaikati innee jaAAilun fee alardi khaleefatan qaloo atajAAalu feeha man yufsidu feeha wayasfiku alddimaa wanahnu nusabbihu bihamdika wanuqaddisu laka qala innee aAAlamu ma la taAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaAAallama adama alasmaa kullaha thumma AAaradahum AAala almalaikati faqala anbioonee biasmai haolai in kuntum sadiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qaloo subhanaka la AAilma lana illa ma AAallamtana innaka anta alAAaleemu alhakeemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qala ya adamu anbihum biasmaihim falamma anbaahum biasmaihim qala alam aqul lakum innee aAAlamu ghayba alssamawati waalardi waaAAlamu ma tubdoona wama kuntum taktumoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith qulna lilmalaikati osjudoo liadama fasajadoo illa ibleesa aba waistakbara wakana mina alkafireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqulna ya adamu oskun anta wazawjuka aljannata wakula minha raghadan haythu shituma wala taqraba hathihi alshshajarata fatakoona mina alththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faazallahuma alshshaytanu AAanha faakhrajahuma mimma kana feehi waqulna ihbitoo baAAdukum libaAAdin AAaduwwun walakum fee alardi mustaqarrun wamataAAun ila heenin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fatalaqqa adamu min rabbihi kalimatin fataba AAalayhi innahu huwa alttawwabu alrraheemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qulna ihbitoo minha jameeAAan faimma yatiyannakum minnee hudan faman tabiAAa hudaya fala khawfun AAalayhim wala hum yahzanoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biayatina olaika ashabu alnnari hum feeha khalidoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya banee israeela othkuroo niAAmatiya allatee anAAamtu AAalaykum waawfoo biAAahdee oofi biAAahdikum waiyyaya fairhabooni}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waaminoo bima anzaltu musaddiqan lima maAAakum wala takoonoo awwala kafirin bihi wala tashtaroo biayatee thamanan qaleelan waiyyaya faittaqooni}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala talbisoo alhaqqa bialbatili wataktumoo alhaqqa waantum taAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waaqeemoo alssalata waatoo alzzakata wairkaAAoo maAAa alrrakiAAeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Atamuroona alnnasa bialbirri watansawna anfusakum waantum tatloona alkitaba afala taAAqiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaistaAAeenoo bialssabri waalssalati wainnaha lakabeeratun illa AAala alkhashiAAeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena yathunnoona annahum mulaqoo rabbihim waannahum ilayhi rajiAAoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya banee israeela othkuroo niAAmatiya allatee anAAamtu AAalaykum waannee faddaltukum AAala alAAalameena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waittaqoo yawman la tajzee nafsun AAan nafsin shayan wala yuqbalu minha shafaAAatun wala yukhathu minha AAadlun wala hum yunsaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith najjaynakum min ali firAAawna yasoomoonakum sooa alAAathabi yuthabbihoona abnaakum wayastahyoona nisaakum wafee thalikum balaon min rabbikum AAatheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith faraqna bikumu albahra faanjaynakum waaghraqna ala firAAawna waantum tanthuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith waAAadna moosa arbaAAeena laylatan thumma ittakhathtumu alAAijla min baAAdihi waantum thalimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thumma AAafawna AAankum min baAAdi thalika laAAallakum tashkuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith atayna moosa alkitaba waalfurqana laAAallakum tahtadoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith qala moosa liqawmihi ya qawmi innakum thalamtum anfusakum biittikhathikumu alAAijla fatooboo ila bariikum faoqtuloo anfusakum thalikum khayrun lakum AAinda bariikum fataba AAalaykum innahu huwa alttawwabu alrraheemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith qultum ya moosa lan numina laka hatta nara Allaha jahratan faakhathatkumu alssaAAiqatu waantum tanthuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thumma baAAathnakum min baAAdi mawtikum laAAallakum tashkuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wathallalna AAalaykumu alghamama waanzalna AAalaykumu almanna waalssalwa kuloo min tayyibati ma razaqnakum wama thalamoona walakin kanoo anfusahum yathlimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith qulna odkhuloo hathihi alqaryata fakuloo minha haythu shitum raghadan waodkhuloo albaba sujjadan waqooloo hittatun naghfir lakum khatayakum wasanazeedu almuhsineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fabaddala allatheena thalamoo qawlan ghayra allathee qeela lahum faanzalna AAala allatheena thalamoo rijzan mina alssamai bima kanoo yafsuqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waithi istasqa moosa liqawmihi faqulna idrib biAAasaka alhajara fainfajarat minhu ithnata AAashrata AAaynan qad AAalima kullu onasin mashrabahum kuloo waishraboo min rizqi Allahi wala taAAthaw fee alardi mufsideena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith qultum ya moosa lan nasbira AAala taAAamin wahidin faodAAu lana rabbaka yukhrij lana mimma tunbitu alardu min baqliha waqiththaiha wafoomiha waAAadasiha wabasaliha qala atastabdiloona allathee huwa adna biallathee huwa khayrun ihbitoo misran fainna lakum ma saaltum waduribat AAalayhimu alththillatu waalmaskanatu wabaoo bighadabin mina Allahi thalika biannahum kanoo yakfuroona biayati Allahi wayaqtuloona alnnabiyyeena bighayri alhaqqi thalika bima AAasaw wakanoo yaAAtadoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena amanoo waallatheena hadoo waalnnasara waalssabieena man amana biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri waAAamila salihan falahum ajruhum AAinda rabbihim wala khawfun AAalayhim wala hum yahzanoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith akhathna meethaqakum warafaAAna fawqakumu alttoora khuthoo ma ataynakum biquwwatin waothkuroo ma feehi laAAallakum tattaqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thumma tawallaytum min baAAdi thalika falawla fadlu Allahi AAalaykum warahmatuhu lakuntum mina alkhasireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaqad AAalimtumu allatheena iAAtadaw minkum fee alssabti faqulna lahum koonoo qiradatan khasieena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{FajaAAalnaha nakalan lima bayna yadayha wama khalfaha wamawAAithatan lilmuttaqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith qala moosa liqawmihi inna Allaha yamurukum an tathbahoo baqaratan qaloo atattakhithuna huzuwan qala aAAoothu biAllahi an akoona mina aljahileena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qaloo odAAu lana rabbaka yubayyin lana ma hiya qala innahu yaqoolu innaha baqaratun la faridun wala bikrun AAawanun bayna thalika faifAAaloo ma tumaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qaloo odAAu lana rabbaka yubayyin lana ma lawnuha qala innahu yaqoolu innaha baqaratun safrao faqiAAun lawnuha tasurru alnnathireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qaloo odAAu lana rabbaka yubayyin lana ma hiya inna albaqara tashabaha AAalayna wainna in shaa Allahu lamuhtadoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qala innahu yaqoolu innaha baqaratun la thaloolun tutheeru alarda wala tasqee alhartha musallamatun la shiyata feeha qaloo alana jita bialhaqqi fathabahooha wama kadoo yafAAaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith qataltum nafsan faiddaratum feeha waAllahu mukhrijun ma kuntum taktumoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faqulna idriboohu bibaAAdiha kathalika yuhyee Allahu almawta wayureekum ayatihi laAAallakum taAAqiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thumma qasat quloobukum min baAAdi thalika fahiya kaalhijarati aw ashaddu qaswatan wainna mina alhijarati lama yatafajjaru minhu alanharu wainna minha lama yashshaqqaqu fayakhruju minhu almao wainna minha lama yahbitu min khashyati Allahi wama Allahu bighafilin AAamma taAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{AfatatmaAAoona an yuminoo lakum waqad kana fareequn minhum yasmaAAoona kalama Allahi thumma yuharrifoonahu min baAAdi ma AAaqaloohu wahum yaAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha laqoo allatheena amanoo qaloo amanna waitha khala baAAduhum ila baAAdin qaloo atuhaddithoonahum bima fataha Allahu AAalaykum liyuhajjookum bihi AAinda rabbikum afala taAAqiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Awala yaAAlamoona anna Allaha yaAAlamu ma yusirroona wama yuAAlinoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waminhum ommiyyoona la yaAAlamoona alkitaba illa amaniyya wain hum illa yathunnoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fawaylun lillatheena yaktuboona alkitaba biaydeehim thumma yaqooloona hatha min AAindi Allahi liyashtaroo bihi thamanan qaleelan fawaylun lahum mimma katabat aydeehim wawaylun lahum mimma yaksiboona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqaloo lan tamassana alnnaru illa ayyaman maAAdoodatan qul attakhathtum AAinda Allahi AAahdan falan yukhlifa Allahu AAahdahu am taqooloona AAala Allahi ma la taAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Bala man kasaba sayyiatan waahatat bihi khateeatuhu faolaika ashabu alnnari hum feeha khalidoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati olaika ashabu aljannati hum feeha khalidoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith akhathna meethaqa banee israeela la taAAbudoona illa Allaha wabialwalidayni ihsanan wathee alqurba waalyatama waalmasakeeni waqooloo lilnnasi husnan waaqeemoo alssalata waatoo alzzakata thumma tawallaytum illa qaleelan minkum waantum muAAridoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith akhathna meethaqakum la tasfikoona dimaakum wala tukhrijoona anfusakum min diyarikum thumma aqrartum waantum tashhadoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thumma antum haolai taqtuloona anfusakum watukhrijoona fareeqan minkum min diyarihim tathaharoona AAalayhim bialithmi waalAAudwani wain yatookum osara tufadoohum wahuwa muharramun AAalaykum ikhrajuhum afatuminoona bibaAAdi alkitabi watakfuroona bibaAAdin fama jazao man yafAAalu thalika minkum illa khizyun fee alhayati alddunya wayawma alqiyamati yuraddoona ila ashaddi alAAathabi wama Allahu bighafilin AAamma taAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][86]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Olaika allatheena ishtarawoo alhayata alddunya bialakhirati fala yukhaffafu AAanhumu alAAathabu wala hum yunsaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaqad atayna moosa alkitaba waqaffayna min baAAdihi bialrrusuli waatayna AAeesa ibna maryama albayyinati waayyadnahu biroohi alqudusi afakullama jaakum rasoolun bima la tahwa anfusukumu istakbartum fafareeqan kaththabtum wafareeqan taqtuloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqaloo quloobuna ghulfun bal laAAanahumu Allahu bikufrihim faqaleelan ma yuminoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][89]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walamma jaahum kitabun min AAindi Allahi musaddiqun lima maAAahum wakanoo min qablu yastaftihoona AAala allatheena kafaroo falamma jaahum ma AAarafoo kafaroo bihi falaAAnatu Allahi AAala alkafireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][90]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Bisama ishtaraw bihi anfusahum an yakfuroo bima anzala Allahu baghyan an yunazzila Allahu min fadlihi AAala man yashao min AAibadihi fabaoo bighadabin AAala ghadabin walilkafireena AAathabun muheenun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][91]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha qeela lahum aminoo bima anzala Allahu qaloo numinu bima onzila AAalayna wayakfuroona bima waraahu wahuwa alhaqqu musaddiqan lima maAAahum qul falima taqtuloona anbiyaa Allahi min qablu in kuntum mumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][92]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaqad jaakum moosa bialbayyinati thumma ittakhathtumu alAAijla min baAAdihi waantum thalimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][93]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith akhathna meethaqakum warafaAAna fawqakumu alttoora khuthoo ma ataynakum biquwwatin waismaAAoo qaloo samiAAna waAAasayna waoshriboo fee quloobihimu alAAijla bikufrihim qul bisama yamurukum bihi eemanukum in kuntum mumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][94]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul in kanat lakumu alddaru alakhiratu AAinda Allahi khalisatan min dooni alnnasi fatamannawoo almawta in kuntum sadiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][95]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walan yatamannawhu abadan bima qaddamat aydeehim waAllahu AAaleemun bialththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][96]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walatajidannahum ahrasa alnnasi AAala hayatin wamina allatheena ashrakoo yawaddu ahaduhum law yuAAammaru alfa sanatin wama huwa bimuzahzihihi mina alAAathabi an yuAAammara waAllahu baseerun bima yaAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][97]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul man kana AAaduwwan lijibreela fainnahu nazzalahu AAala qalbika biithni Allahi musaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi wahudan wabushra lilmumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][98]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Man kana AAaduwwan lillahi wamalaikatihi warusulihi wajibreela wameekala fainna Allaha AAaduwwun lilkafireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][99]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaqad anzalna ilayka ayatin bayyinatin wama yakfuru biha illa alfasiqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][100]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Awakullama AAahadoo AAahdan nabathahu fareequn minhum bal aktharuhum la yuminoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][101]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walamma jaahum rasoolun min AAindi Allahi musaddiqun lima maAAahum nabatha fareequn mina allatheena ootoo alkitaba kitaba Allahi waraa thuhoorihim kaannahum la yaAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][102]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaittabaAAoo ma tatloo alshshayateenu AAala mulki sulaymana wama kafara sulaymanu walakinna alshshayateena kafaroo yuAAallimoona alnnasa alssihra wama onzila AAala almalakayni bibabila haroota wamaroota wama yuAAallimani min ahadin hatta yaqoola innama nahnu fitnatun fala takfur fayataAAallamoona minhuma ma yufarriqoona bihi bayna almari wazawjihi wama hum bidarreena bihi min ahadin illa biithni Allahi wayataAAallamoona ma yadurruhum wala yanfaAAuhum walaqad AAalimoo lamani ishtarahu ma lahu fee alakhirati min khalaqin walabisa ma sharaw bihi anfusahum law kanoo yaAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][103]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaw annahum amanoo waittaqaw lamathoobatun min AAindi Allahi khayrun law kanoo yaAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][104]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la taqooloo raAAina waqooloo onthurna waismaAAoo walilkafireena AAathabun aleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][105]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ma yawaddu allatheena kafaroo min ahli alkitabi wala almushrikeena an yunazzala AAalaykum min khayrin min rabbikum waAllahu yakhtassu birahmatihi man yashao waAllahu thoo alfadli alAAatheemi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][106]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ma nansakh min ayatin aw nunsiha nati bikhayrin minha aw mithliha alam taAAlam anna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][107]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alam taAAlam anna Allaha lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi wama lakum min dooni Allahi min waliyyin wala naseerin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][108]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Am tureedoona an tasaloo rasoolakum kama suila moosa min qablu waman yatabaddali alkufra bialeemani faqad dalla sawaa alssabeeli}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][109]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wadda katheerun min ahli alkitabi law yaruddoonakum min baAAdi eemanikum kuffaran hasadan min AAindi anfusihim min baAAdi ma tabayyana lahumu alhaqqu faoAAfoo waisfahoo hatta yatiya Allahu biamrihi inna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][110]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waaqeemoo alssalata waatoo alzzakata wama tuqaddimoo lianfusikum min khayrin tajidoohu AAinda Allahi inna Allaha bima taAAmaloona baseerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][111]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqaloo lan yadkhula aljannata illa man kana hoodan aw nasara tilka amaniyyuhum qul hatoo burhanakum in kuntum sadiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][112]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Bala man aslama wajhahu lillahi wahuwa muhsinun falahu ajruhu AAinda rabbihi wala khawfun AAalayhim wala hum yahzanoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][113]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqalati alyahoodu laysati alnnasara AAala shayin waqalati alnnasara laysati alyahoodu AAala shayin wahum yatloona alkitaba kathalika qala allatheena la yaAAlamoona mithla qawlihim faAllahu yahkumu baynahum yawma alqiyamati feema kanoo feehi yakhtalifoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][114]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waman athlamu mimman manaAAa masajida Allahi an yuthkara feeha ismuhu wasaAAa fee kharabiha olaika ma kana lahum an yadkhulooha illa khaifeena lahum fee alddunya khizyun walahum fee alakhirati AAathabun AAatheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][115]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walillahi almashriqu waalmaghribu faaynama tuwalloo fathamma wajhu Allahi inna Allaha wasiAAun AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][116]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqaloo itakhatha Allahu waladan subhanahu bal lahu ma fee alssamawati waalardi kullun lahu qanitoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][117]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{BadeeAAu alssamawati waalardi waitha qada amran fainnama yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoonu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][118]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqala allatheena la yaAAlamoona lawla yukallimuna Allahu aw tateena ayatun kathalika qala allatheena min qablihim mithla qawlihim tashabahat quloobuhum qad bayyanna alayati liqawmin yooqinoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][119]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna arsalnaka bialhaqqi basheeran wanatheeran wala tusalu Aaan ashabi aljaheemi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][120]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walan tarda AAanka alyahoodu wala alnnasara hatta tattabiAAa millatahum qul inna huda Allahi huwa alhuda walaini ittabaAAta ahwaahum baAAda allathee jaaka mina alAAilmi ma laka mina Allahi min waliyyin wala naseerin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][121]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena ataynahumu alkitaba yatloonahu haqqa tilawatihi olaika yuminoona bihi waman yakfur bihi faolaika humu alkhasiroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][122]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya banee israeela othkuroo niAAmatiya allatee anAAamtu AAalaykum waannee faddaltukum AAala alAAalameena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][123]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waittaqoo yawman la tajzee nafsun AAan nafsin shayan wala yuqbalu minha AAadlun wala tanfaAAuha shafaAAatun wala hum yunsaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][124]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waithi ibtala ibraheema rabbuhu bikalimatin faatammahunna qala innee jaAAiluka lilnnasi imaman qala wamin thurriyyatee qala la yanalu AAahdee alththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][125]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith jaAAalna albayta mathabatan lilnnasi waamnan waittakhithoo min maqami ibraheema musallan waAAahidna ila ibraheema waismaAAeela an tahhira baytiya lilttaifeena waalAAakifeena waalrrukkaAAi alssujoodi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][126]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith qala ibraheemu rabbi ijAAal hatha baladan aminan waorzuq ahlahu mina alththamarati man amana minhum biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri qala waman kafara faomattiAAuhu qaleelan thumma adtarruhu ila AAathabi alnnari wabisa almaseeru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][127]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith yarfaAAu ibraheemu alqawaAAida mina albayti waismaAAeelu rabbana taqabbal minna innaka anta alssameeAAu alAAaleemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][128]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Rabbana waijAAalna muslimayni laka wamin thurriyyatina ommatan muslimatan laka waarina manasikana watub AAalayna innaka anta alttawwabu alrraheemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][129]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Rabbana waibAAath feehim rasoolan minhum yatloo AAalayhim ayatika wayuAAallimuhumu alkitaba waalhikmata wayuzakkeehim innaka anta alAAazeezu alhakeemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][130]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waman yarghabu AAan millati ibraheema illa man safiha nafsahu walaqadi istafaynahu fee alddunya wainnahu fee alakhirati lamina alssaliheena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][131]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ith qala lahu rabbuhu aslim qala aslamtu lirabbi alAAalameena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][132]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wawassa biha ibraheemu baneehi wayaAAqoobu ya baniyya inna Allaha istafa lakumu alddeena fala tamootunna illa waantum muslimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][133]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Am kuntum shuhadaa ith hadara yaAAqooba almawtu ith qala libaneehi ma taAAbudoona min baAAdee qaloo naAAbudu ilahaka wailaha abaika ibraheema waismaAAeela waishaqa ilahan wahidan wanahnu lahu muslimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][134]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Tilka ommatun qad khalat laha ma kasabat walakum ma kasabtum wala tusaloona AAamma kano yaAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][135]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqaloo koonoo hoodan aw nasara tahtadoo qul bal millata ibraheema haneefan wama kana mina almushrikeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][136]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qooloo amanna biAllahi wama onzila ilayna wama onzila ila ibraheema waismaAAeela waishaqa wayaAAqooba waalasbati wama ootiya moosa waAAeesa wama ootiya alnnabiyyoona min rabbihim la nufarriqu bayna ahadin minhum wanahnu lahu muslimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][137]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fain amanoo bimithli ma amantum bihi faqadi ihtadaw wain tawallaw fainnama hum fee shiqaqin fasayakfeekahumu Allahu wahuwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][138]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Sibghata Allahi waman ahsanu mina Allahi sibghatan wanahnu lahu AAabidoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][139]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul atuhajjoonana fee Allahi wahuwa rabbuna warabbukum walana aAAmaluna walakum aAAmalukum wanahnu lahu mukhlisoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][140]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Am taqooloona inna ibraheema waismaAAeela waishaqa wayaAAqooba waalasbata kanoo hoodan aw nasara qul aantum aAAlamu ami Allahu waman athlamu mimman katama shahadatan AAindahu mina Allahi wama Allahu bighafilin AAamma taAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][141]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Tilka ommatun qad khalat laha ma kasabat walakum ma kasabtum wala tusaloona AAamma kanoo yaAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][142]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Sayaqoolu alssufahao mina alnnasi ma wallahum AAan qiblatihimu allatee kanoo AAalayha qul lillahi almashriqu waalmaghribu yahdee man yashao ila siratin mustaqeemin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][143]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wakathalika jaAAalnakum ommatan wasatan litakoonoo shuhadaa AAala alnnasi wayakoona alrrasoolu AAalaykum shaheedan wama jaAAalna alqiblata allatee kunta AAalayha illa linaAAlama man yattabiAAu alrrasoola mimman yanqalibu AAala AAaqibayhi wain kanat lakabeeratan illa AAala allatheena hada Allahu wama kana Allahu liyudeeAAa eemanakum inna Allaha bialnnasi laraoofun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][144]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qad nara taqalluba wajhika fee alssamai falanuwalliyannaka qiblatan tardaha fawalli wajhaka shatra almasjidi alharami wahaythu ma kuntum fawalloo wujoohakum shatrahu wainna allatheena ootoo alkitaba layaAAlamoona annahu alhaqqu min rabbihim wama Allahu bighafilin AAamma yaAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][145]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walain atayta allatheena ootoo alkitaba bikulli ayatin ma tabiAAoo qiblataka wama anta bitabiAAin qiblatahum wama baAAduhum bitabiAAin qiblata baAAdin walaini ittabaAAta ahwaahum min baAAdi ma jaaka mina alAAilmi innaka ithan lamina alththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][146]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena ataynahumu alkitaba yaAArifoonahu kama yaAArifoona abnaahum wainna fareeqan minhum layaktumoona alhaqqa wahum yaAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][147]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alhaqqu min rabbika fala takoonanna mina almumtareena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][148]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walikullin wijhatun huwa muwalleeha faistabiqoo alkhayrati ayna ma takoonoo yati bikumu Allahu jameeAAan inna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][149]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wamin haythu kharajta fawalli wajhaka shatra almasjidi alharami wainnahu lalhaqqu min rabbika wama Allahu bighafilin AAamma taAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][150]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wamin haythu kharajta fawalli wajhaka shatra almasjidi alharami wahaythu ma kuntum fawalloo wujoohakum shatrahu lialla yakoona lilnnasi AAalaykum hujjatun illa allatheena thalamoo minhum fala takhshawhum waikhshawnee waliotimma niAAmatee AAalaykum walaAAallakum tahtadoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][151]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Kama arsalna feekum rasoolan minkum yatloo AAalaykum ayatina wayuzakkeekum wayuAAallimukumu alkitaba waalhikmata wayuAAallimukum ma lam takoonoo taAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][152]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faothkuroonee athkurkum waoshkuroo lee wala takfurooni}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][153]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo istaAAeenoo bialssabri waalssalati inna Allaha maAAa alssabireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][154]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala taqooloo liman yuqtalu fee sabeeli Allahi amwatun bal ahyaon walakin la tashAAuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][155]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walanabluwannakum bishayin mina alkhawfi waaljooAAi wanaqsin mina alamwali waalanfusi waalththamarati wabashshiri alssabireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][156]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena itha asabathum museebatun qaloo inna lillahi wainna ilayhi rajiAAoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][157]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Olaika AAalayhim salawatun min rabbihim warahmatun waolaika humu almuhtadoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][158]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna alssafa waalmarwata min shaAAairi Allahi faman hajja albayta awi iAAtamara fala junaha AAalayhi an yattawwafa bihima waman tatawwaAAa khayran fainna Allaha shakirun AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][159]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena yaktumoona ma anzalna mina albayyinati waalhuda min baAAdi ma bayyannahu lilnnasi fee alkitabi olaika yalAAanuhumu Allahu wayalAAanuhumu allaAAinoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][160]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Illa allatheena taboo waaslahoo wabayyanoo faolaika atoobu AAalayhim waana alttawwabu alrraheemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][161]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena kafaroo wamatoo wahum kuffarun olaika AAalayhim laAAnatu Allahi waalmalaikati waalnnasi ajmaAAeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][162]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Khalideena feeha la yukhaffafu AAanhumu alAAathabu wala hum yuntharoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][163]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wailahukum ilahun wahidun la ilaha illa huwa alrrahmanu alrraheemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][164]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna fee khalqi alssamawati waalardi waikhtilafi allayli waalnnahari waalfulki allatee tajree fee albahri bima yanfaAAu alnnasa wama anzala Allahu mina alssamai min main faahya bihi alarda baAAda mawtiha wabaththa feeha min kulli dabbatin watasreefi alrriyahi waalssahabi almusakhkhari bayna alssamai waalardi laayatin liqawmin yaAAqiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][165]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wamina alnnasi man yattakhithu min dooni Allahi andadan yuhibboonahum kahubbi Allahi waallatheena amanoo ashaddu hubban lillahi walaw yara allatheena thalamoo ith yarawna alAAathaba anna alquwwata lillahi jameeAAan waanna Allaha shadeedu alAAathabi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][166]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ith tabarraa allatheena ittubiAAoo mina allatheena ittabaAAoo waraawoo alAAathaba wataqattaAAat bihimu alasbabu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][167]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqala allatheena ittabaAAoo law anna lana karratan fanatabarraa minhum kama tabarraoo minna kathalika yureehimu Allahu aAAmalahum hasaratin AAalayhim wama hum bikharijeena mina alnnari}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][168]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha alnnasu kuloo mimma fee alardi halalan tayyiban wala tattabiAAoo khutuwati alshshaytani innahu lakum AAaduwwun mubeenun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][169]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Innama yamurukum bialssooi waalfahshai waan taqooloo AAala Allahi ma la taAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][170]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha qeela lahumu ittabiAAoo ma anzala Allahu qaloo bal nattabiAAu ma alfayna AAalayhi abaana awalaw kana abaohum la yaAAqiloona shayan wala yahtadoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][171]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wamathalu allatheena kafaroo kamathali allathee yanAAiqu bima la yasmaAAu illa duAAaan wanidaan summun bukmun AAumyun fahum la yaAAqiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][172]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo kuloo min tayyibati ma razaqnakum waoshkuroo lillahi in kuntum iyyahu taAAbudoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][173]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Innama harrama AAalaykumu almaytata waalddama walahma alkhinzeeri wama ohilla bihi lighayri Allahi famani idturra ghayra baghin wala AAadin fala ithma AAalayhi inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][174]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena yaktumoona ma anzala Allahu mina alkitabi wayashtaroona bihi thamanan qaleelan olaika ma yakuloona fee butoonihim illa alnnara wala yukallimuhumu Allahu yawma alqiyamati wala yuzakkeehim walahum AAathabun aleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][175]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Olaika allatheena ishtarawoo alddalalata bialhuda waalAAathaba bialmaghfirati fama asbarahum AAala alnnari}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][176]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thalika bianna Allaha nazzala alkitaba bialhaqqi wainna allatheena ikhtalafoo fee alkitabi lafee shiqaqin baAAeedin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][177]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Laysa albirra an tuwalloo wujoohakum qibala almashriqi waalmaghribi walakinna albirra man amana biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri waalmalaikati waalkitabi waalnnabiyyeena waata almala AAala hubbihi thawee alqurba waalyatama waalmasakeena waibna alssabeeli waalssaileena wafee alrriqabi waaqama alssalata waata alzzakata waalmoofoona biAAahdihim itha AAahadoo waalssabireena fee albasai waalddarrai waheena albasi olaika allatheena sadaqoo waolaika humu almuttaqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][178]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo kutiba AAalaykumu alqisasu fee alqatla alhurru bialhurri waalAAabdu bialAAabdi waalontha bialontha faman AAufiya lahu min akheehi shayon faittibaAAun bialmaAAroofi waadaon ilayhi biihsanin thalika takhfeefun min rabbikum warahmatun famani iAAtada baAAda thalika falahu AAathabun aleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][179]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walakum fee alqisasi hayatun ya olee alalbabi laAAallakum tattaqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][180]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Kutiba AAalaykum itha hadara ahadakumu almawtu in taraka khayran alwasiyyatu lilwalidayni waalaqrabeena bialmaAAroofi haqqan AAala almuttaqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][181]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faman baddalahu baAAdama samiAAahu fainnama ithmuhu AAala allatheena yubaddiloonahu inna Allaha sameeAAun AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][182]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faman khafa min moosin janafan aw ithman faaslaha baynahum fala ithma AAalayhi inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][183]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo kutiba AAalaykumu alssiyamu kama kutiba AAala allatheena min qablikum laAAallakum tattaqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][184]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ayyaman maAAdoodatin faman kana minkum mareedan aw AAala safarin faAAiddatun min ayyamin okhara waAAala allatheena yuteeqoonahu fidyatun taAAamu miskeenin faman tatawwaAAa khayran fahuwa khayrun lahu waan tasoomoo khayrun lakum in kuntum taAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][185]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Shahru ramadana allathee onzila feehi alquranu hudan lilnnasi wabayyinatin mina alhuda waalfurqani faman shahida minkumu alshshahra falyasumhu waman kana mareedan aw AAala safarin faAAiddatun min ayyamin okhara yureedu Allahu bikumu alyusra wala yureedu bikumu alAAusra walitukmiloo alAAiddata walitukabbiroo Allaha AAala ma hadakum walaAAallakum tashkuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][186]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha saalaka AAibadee AAannee fainnee qareebun ojeebu daAAwata alddaAAi itha daAAani falyastajeeboo lee walyuminoo bee laAAallahum yarshudoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][187]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ohilla lakum laylata alssiyami alrrafathu ila nisaikum hunna libasun lakum waantum libasun lahunna AAalima Allahu annakum kuntum takhtanoona anfusakum fataba AAalaykum waAAafa AAankum faalana bashiroohunna waibtaghoo ma kataba Allahu lakum wakuloo waishraboo hatta yatabayyana lakumu alkhaytu alabyadu mina alkhayti alaswadi mina alfajri thumma atimmoo alssiyama ila allayli wala tubashiroohunna waantum AAakifoona fee almasajidi tilka hudoodu Allahi fala taqrabooha kathalika yubayyinu Allahu ayatihi lilnnasi laAAallahum yattaqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][188]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala takuloo amwalakum baynakum bialbatili watudloo biha ila alhukkami litakuloo fareeqan min amwali alnnasi bialithmi waantum taAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][189]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yasaloonaka AAani alahillati qul hiya mawaqeetu lilnnasi waalhajji walaysa albirru bian tatoo albuyoota min thuhooriha walakinna albirra mani ittaqa watoo albuyoota min abwabiha waittaqoo Allaha laAAallakum tuflihoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][190]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqatiloo fee sabeeli Allahi allatheena yuqatiloonakum wala taAAtadoo inna Allaha la yuhibbu almuAAtadeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][191]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waoqtuloohum haythu thaqiftumoohum waakhrijoohum min haythu akhrajookum waalfitnatu ashaddu mina alqatli wala tuqatiloohum AAinda almasjidi alharami hatta yuqatilookum feehi fain qatalookum faoqtuloohum kathalika jazao alkafireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][192]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faini intahaw fainna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][193]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqatiloohum hatta la takoona fitnatun wayakoona alddeenu lillahi faini intahaw fala AAudwana illa AAala alththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][194]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alshshahru alharamu bialshshahri alharami waalhurumatu qisasun famani iAAtada AAalaykum faiAAtadoo AAalayhi bimithli ma iAAtada AAalaykum waittaqoo Allaha waiAAlamoo anna Allaha maAAa almuttaqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][195]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waanfiqoo fee sabeeli Allahi wala tulqoo biaydeekum ila alttahlukati waahsinoo inna Allaha yuhibbu almuhsineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][196]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waatimmoo alhajja waalAAumrata lillahi fain ohsirtum fama istaysara mina alhadyi wala tahliqoo ruoosakum hatta yablugha alhadyu mahillahu faman kana minkum mareedan aw bihi athan min rasihi fafidyatun min siyamin aw sadaqatin aw nusukin faitha amintum faman tamattaAAa bialAAumrati ila alhajji fama istaysara mina alhadyi faman lam yajid fasiyamu thalathati ayyamin fee alhajji wasabAAatin itha rajaAAtum tilka AAasharatun kamilatun thalika liman lam yakun ahluhu hadiree almasjidi alharami waittaqoo Allaha waiAAlamoo anna Allaha shadeedu alAAiqabi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][197]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alhajju ashhurun maAAloomatun faman farada feehinna alhajja fala rafatha wala fusooqa wala jidala fee alhajji wama tafAAaloo min khayrin yaAAlamhu Allahu watazawwadoo fainna khayra alzzadi alttaqwa waittaqooni ya olee alalbabi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][198]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Laysa AAalaykum junahun an tabtaghoo fadlan min rabbikum faitha afadtum min AAarafatin faothkuroo Allaha AAinda almashAAari alharami waothkuroohu kama hadakum wain kuntum min qablihi lamina alddalleena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][199]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thumma afeedoo min haythu afada alnnasu waistaghfiroo Allaha inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][200]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faitha qadaytum manasikakum faothkuroo Allaha kathikrikum abaakum aw ashadda thikran famina alnnasi man yaqoolu rabbana atina fee alddunya wama lahu fee alakhirati min khalaqin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][201]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waminhum man yaqoolu rabbana atina fee alddunya hasanatan wafee alakhirati hasanatan waqina AAathaba alnnari}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][202]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Olaika lahum naseebun mimma kasaboo waAllahu sareeAAu alhisabi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][203]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waothkuroo Allaha fee ayyamin maAAdoodatin faman taAAajjala fee yawmayni fala ithma AAalayhi waman taakhkhara fala ithma AAalayhi limani ittaqa waittaqoo Allaha waiAAlamoo annakum ilayhi tuhsharoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][204]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wamina alnnasi man yuAAjibuka qawluhu fee alhayati alddunya wayushhidu Allaha AAala ma fee qalbihi wahuwa aladdu alkhisami}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][205]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha tawalla saAAa fee alardi liyufsida feeha wayuhlika alhartha waalnnasla waAllahu la yuhibbu alfasada}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][206]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha qeela lahu ittaqi Allaha akhathathu alAAizzatu bialithmi fahasbuhu jahannamu walabisa almihadu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][207]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wamina alnnasi man yashree nafsahu ibtighaa mardati Allahi waAllahu raoofun bialAAibadi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][208]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo odkhuloo fee alssilmi kaffatan wala tattabiAAoo khutuwati alshshaytani innahu lakum AAaduwwun mubeenun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][209]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fain zalaltum min baAAdi ma jaatkumu albayyinatu faiAAlamoo anna Allaha AAazeezun hakeemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][210]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Hal yanthuroona illa an yatiyahumu Allahu fee thulalin mina alghamami waalmalaikatu waqudiya alamru waila Allahi turjaAAu alomooru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][211]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Sal banee israeela kam ataynahum min ayatin bayyinatin waman yubaddil niAAmata Allahi min baAAdi ma jaathu fainna Allaha shadeedu alAAiqabi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][212]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Zuyyina lillatheena kafaroo alhayatu alddunya wayaskharoona mina allatheena amanoo waallatheena ittaqaw fawqahum yawma alqiyamati waAllahu yarzuqu man yashao bighayri hisabin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][213]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Kana alnnasu ommatan wahidatan fabaAAatha Allahu alnnabiyyeena mubashshireena wamunthireena waanzala maAAahumu alkitaba bialhaqqi liyahkuma bayna alnnasi feema ikhtalafoo feehi wama ikhtalafa feehi illa allatheena ootoohu min baAAdi ma jaathumu albayyinatu baghyan baynahum fahada Allahu allatheena amanoo lima ikhtalafoo feehi mina alhaqqi biithnihi waAllahu yahdee man yashao ila siratin mustaqeemin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][214]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Am hasibtum an tadkhuloo aljannata walamma yatikum mathalu allatheena khalaw min qablikum massathumu albasao waalddarrao wazulziloo hatta yaqoola alrrasoolu waallatheena amanoo maAAahu mata nasru Allahi ala inna nasra Allahi qareebun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][215]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yasaloonaka matha yunfiqoona qul ma anfaqtum min khayrin falilwalidayni waalaqrabeena waalyatama waalmasakeeni waibni alssabeeli wama tafAAaloo min khayrin fainna Allaha bihi AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][216]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Kutiba AAalaykumu alqitalu wahuwa kurhun lakum waAAasa an takrahoo shayan wahuwa khayrun lakum waAAasa an tuhibboo shayan wahuwa sharrun lakum waAllahu yaAAlamu waantum la taAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][217]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yasaloonaka AAani alshshahri alharami qitalin feehi qul qitalun feehi kabeerun wasaddun AAan sabeeli Allahi wakufrun bihi waalmasjidi alharami waikhraju ahlihi minhu akbaru AAinda Allahi waalfitnatu akbaru mina alqatli wala yazaloona yuqatiloonakum hatta yaruddookum AAan deenikum ini istataAAoo waman yartadid minkum AAan deenihi fayamut wahuwa kafirun faolaika habitat aAAmaluhum fee alddunya waalakhirati waolaika ashabu alnnari hum feeha khalidoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][218]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena amanoo waallatheena hajaroo wajahadoo fee sabeeli Allahi olaika yarjoona rahmata Allahi waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][219]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yasaloonaka AAani alkhamri waalmaysiri qul feehima ithmun kabeerun wamanafiAAu lilnnasi waithmuhuma akbaru min nafAAihima wayasaloonaka matha yunfiqoona quli alAAafwa kathalika yubayyinu Allahu lakumu alayati laAAallakum tatafakkaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][220]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fee alddunya waalakhirati wayasaloonaka AAani alyatama qul islahun lahum khayrun wain tukhalitoohum faikhwanukum waAllahu yaAAlamu almufsida mina almuslihi walaw shaa Allahu laaAAnatakum inna Allaha AAazeezun hakeemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][221]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala tankihoo almushrikati hatta yuminna walaamatun muminatun khayrun min mushrikatin walaw aAAjabatkum wala tunkihoo almushrikeena hatta yuminoo walaAAabdun muminun khayrun min mushrikin walaw aAAjabakum olaika yadAAoona ila alnnari waAllahu yadAAoo ila aljannati waalmaghfirati biithnihi wayubayyinu ayatihi lilnnasi laAAallahum yatathakkaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][222]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wayasaloonaka AAani almaheedi qul huwa athan faiAAtaziloo alnnisaa fee almaheedi wala taqraboohunna hatta yathurna faitha tatahharna fatoohunna min haythu amarakumu Allahu inna Allaha yuhibbu alttawwabeena wayuhibbu almutatahhireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][223]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Nisaokum harthun lakum fatoo harthakum anna shitum waqaddimoo lianfusikum waittaqoo Allaha waiAAlamoo annakum mulaqoohu wabashshiri almumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][224]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala tajAAaloo Allaha AAurdatan liaymanikum an tabarroo watattaqoo watuslihoo bayna alnnasi waAllahu sameeAAun AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][225]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{La yuakhithukumu Allahu biallaghwi fee aymanikum walakin yuakhithukum bima kasabat quloobukum waAllahu ghafoorun haleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][226]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lillatheena yuloona min nisaihim tarabbusu arbaAAati ashhurin fain faoo fainna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][227]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain AAazamoo alttalaqa fainna Allaha sameeAAun AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][228]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waalmutallaqatu yatarabbasna bianfusihinna thalathata qurooin wala yahillu lahunna an yaktumna ma khalaqa Allahu fee arhamihinna in kunna yuminna biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri wabuAAoolatuhunna ahaqqu biraddihinna fee thalika in aradoo islahan walahunna mithlu allathee AAalayhinna bialmaAAroofi walilrrijali AAalayhinna darajatun waAllahu AAazeezun hakeemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][229]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alttalaqu marratani faimsakun bimaAAroofin aw tasreehun biihsanin wala yahillu lakum an takhuthoo mimma ataytumoohunna shayan illa an yakhafa alla yuqeema hudooda Allahi fain khiftum alla yuqeema hudooda Allahi fala junaha AAalayhima feema iftadat bihi tilka hudoodu Allahi fala taAAtadooha waman yataAAadda hudooda Allahi faolaika humu alththalimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][230]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fain tallaqaha fala tahillu lahu min baAAdu hatta tankiha zawjan ghayrahu fain tallaqaha fala junaha AAalayhima an yatarajaAAa in thanna an yuqeema hudooda Allahi watilka hudoodu Allahi yubayyinuha liqawmin yaAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][231]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha tallaqtumu alnnisaa fabalaghna ajalahunna faamsikoohunna bimaAAroofin aw sarrihoohunna bimaAAroofin wala tumsikoohunna diraran litaAAtadoo waman yafAAal thalika faqad thalama nafsahu wala tattakhithoo ayati Allahi huzuwan waothkuroo niAAmata Allahi AAalaykum wama anzala AAalaykum mina alkitabi waalhikmati yaAAithukum bihi waittaqoo Allaha waiAAlamoo anna Allaha bikulli shayin AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][232]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha tallaqtumu alnnisaa fabalaghna ajalahunna fala taAAduloohunna an yankihna azwajahunna itha taradaw baynahum bialmaAAroofi thalika yooAAathu bihi man kana minkum yuminu biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri thalikum azka lakum waatharu waAllahu yaAAlamu waantum la taAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][233]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waalwalidatu yurdiAAna awladahunna hawlayni kamilayni liman arada an yutimma alrradaAAata waAAala almawloodi lahu rizquhunna wakiswatuhunna bialmaAAroofi la tukallafu nafsun illa wusAAaha la tudarra walidatun biwaladiha wala mawloodun lahu biwaladihi waAAala alwarithi mithlu thalika fain arada fisalan AAan taradin minhuma watashawurin fala junaha AAalayhima wain aradtum an tastardiAAoo awladakum fala junaha AAalaykum itha sallamtum ma ataytum bialmaAAroofi waittaqoo Allaha waiAAlamoo anna Allaha bima taAAmaloona baseerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][234]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena yutawaffawna minkum wayatharoona azwajan yatarabbasna bianfusihinna arbaAAata ashhurin waAAashran faitha balaghna ajalahunna fala junaha AAalaykum feema faAAalna fee anfusihinna bialmaAAroofi waAllahu bima taAAmaloona khabeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][235]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala junaha AAalaykum feema AAarradtum bihi min khitbati alnnisai aw aknantum fee anfusikum AAalima Allahu annakum satathkuroonahunna walakin la tuwaAAidoohunna sirran illa an taqooloo qawlan maAAroofan wala taAAzimoo AAuqdata alnnikahi hatta yablugha alkitabu ajalahu waiAAlamoo anna Allaha yaAAlamu ma fee anfusikum faihtharoohu waiAAlamoo anna Allaha ghafoorun haleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][236]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{La junaha AAalaykum in tallaqtumu alnnisaa ma lam tamassoohunna aw tafridoo lahunna fareedatan wamattiAAoohunna AAala almoosiAAi qadaruhu waAAala almuqtiri qadaruhu mataAAan bialmaAAroofi haqqan AAala almuhsineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][237]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain tallaqtumoohunna min qabli an tamassoohunna waqad faradtum lahunna fareedatan fanisfu ma faradtum illa an yaAAfoona aw yaAAfuwa allathee biyadihi AAuqdatu alnnikahi waan taAAfoo aqrabu lilttaqwa wala tansawoo alfadla baynakum inna Allaha bima taAAmaloona baseerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][238]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Hafithoo AAala alssalawati waalssalati alwusta waqoomoo lillahi qaniteena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][239]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fain khiftum farijalan aw rukbanan faitha amintum faothkuroo Allaha kama AAallamakum ma lam takoonoo taAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][240]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena yutawaffawna minkum wayatharoona azwajan wasiyyatan liazwajihim mataAAan ila alhawli ghayra ikhrajin fain kharajna fala junaha AAalaykum fee ma faAAalna fee anfusihinna min maAAroofin waAllahu AAazeezun hakeemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][241]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walilmutallaqati mataAAun bialmaAAroofi haqqan AAala almuttaqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][242]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Kathalika yubayyinu Allahu lakum ayatihi laAAallakum taAAqiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][243]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alam tara ila allatheena kharajoo min diyarihim wahum oloofun hathara almawti faqala lahumu Allahu mootoo thumma ahyahum inna Allaha lathoo fadlin AAala alnnasi walakinna akthara alnnasi la yashkuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][244]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqatiloo fee sabeeli Allahi waiAAlamoo anna Allaha sameeAAun AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][245]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Man tha allathee yuqridu Allaha qardan hasanan fayudaAAifahu lahu adAAafan katheeratan waAllahu yaqbidu wayabsutu wailayhi turjaAAoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][246]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alam tara ila almalai min banee israeela min baAAdi moosa ith qaloo linabiyyin lahumu ibAAath lana malikan nuqatil fee sabeeli Allahi qala hal AAasaytum in kutiba AAalaykumu alqitalu alla tuqatiloo qaloo wama lana alla nuqatila fee sabeeli Allahi waqad okhrijna min diyarina waabnaina falamma kutiba AAalayhimu alqitalu tawallaw illa qaleelan minhum waAllahu AAaleemun bialththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][247]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqala lahum nabiyyuhum inna Allaha qad baAAatha lakum taloota malikan qaloo anna yakoonu lahu almulku AAalayna wanahnu ahaqqu bialmulki minhu walam yuta saAAatan mina almali qala inna Allaha istafahu AAalaykum wazadahu bastatan fee alAAilmi waaljismi waAllahu yutee mulkahu man yashao waAllahu wasiAAun AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][248]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqala lahum nabiyyuhum inna ayata mulkihi an yatiyakumu alttabootu feehi sakeenatun min rabbikum wabaqiyyatun mimma taraka alu moosa waalu haroona tahmiluhu almalaikatu inna fee thalika laayatan lakum in kuntum mumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][249]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Falamma fasala talootu bialjunoodi qala inna Allaha mubtaleekum binaharin faman shariba minhu falaysa minnee waman lam yatAAamhu fainnahu minnee illa mani ightarafa ghurfatan biyadihi fashariboo minhu illa qaleelan minhum falamma jawazahu huwa waallatheena amanoo maAAahu qaloo la taqata lana alyawma bijaloota wajunoodihi qala allatheena yathunnoona annahum mulaqoo Allahi kam min fiatin qaleelatin ghalabat fiatan katheeratan biithni Allahi waAllahu maAAa alssabireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][250]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walamma barazoo lijaloota wajunoodihi qaloo rabbana afrigh AAalayna sabran wathabbit aqdamana waonsurna AAala alqawmi alkafireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][251]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fahazamoohum biithni Allahi waqatala dawoodu jaloota waatahu Allahu almulka waalhikmata waAAallamahu mimma yashao walawla dafAAu Allahi alnnasa baAAdahum bibaAAdin lafasadati alardu walakinna Allaha thoo fadlin AAala alAAalameena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][252]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Tilka ayatu Allahi natlooha AAalayka bialhaqqi wainnaka lamina almursaleena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][253]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Tilka alrrusulu faddalna baAAdahum AAala baAAdin minhum man kallama Allahu warafaAAa baAAdahum darajatin waatayna AAeesa ibna maryama albayyinati waayyadnahu biroohi alqudusi walaw shaa Allahu ma iqtatala allatheena min baAAdihim min baAAdi ma jaathumu albayyinatu walakini ikhtalafoo faminhum man amana waminhum man kafara walaw shaa Allahu ma iqtataloo walakinna Allaha yafAAalu ma yureedu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][254]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo anfiqoo mimma razaqnakum min qabli an yatiya yawmun la bayAAun feehi wala khullatun wala shafaAAatun waalkafiroona humu alththalimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][255]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allahu la ilaha illa huwa alhayyu alqayyoomu la takhuthuhu sinatun wala nawmun lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi man tha allathee yashfaAAu AAindahu illa biithnihi yaAAlamu ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum wala yuheetoona bishayin min AAilmihi illa bima shaa wasiAAa kursiyyuhu alssamawati waalarda wala yaooduhu hifthuhuma wahuwa alAAaliyyu alAAatheemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][256]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{La ikraha fee alddeeni qad tabayyana alrrushdu mina alghayyi faman yakfur bialttaghooti wayumin biAllahi faqadi istamsaka bialAAurwati alwuthqa la infisama laha waAllahu sameeAAun AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][257]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allahu waliyyu allatheena amanoo yukhrijuhum mina alththulumati ila alnnoori waallatheena kafaroo awliyaohumu alttaghootu yukhrijoonahum mina alnnoori ila alththulumati olaika ashabu alnnari hum feeha khalidoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][258]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alam tara ila allathee hajja ibraheema fee rabbihi an atahu Allahu almulka ith qala ibraheemu rabbiya allathee yuhyee wayumeetu qala ana ohyee waomeetu qala ibraheemu fainna Allaha yatee bialshshamsi mina almashriqi fati biha mina almaghribi fabuhita allathee kafara waAllahu la yahdee alqawma alththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][259]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Aw kaallathee marra AAala qaryatin wahiya khawiyatun AAala AAurooshiha qala anna yuhyee hathihi Allahu baAAda mawtiha faamatahu Allahu miata AAamin thumma baAAathahu qala kam labithta qala labithtu yawman aw baAAda yawmin qala bal labithta miata AAamin faonthur ila taAAamika washarabika lam yatasannah waonthur ila himarika walinajAAalaka ayatan lilnnasi waonthur ila alAAithami kayfa nunshizuha thumma naksooha lahman falamma tabayyana lahu qala aAAlamu anna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][260]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith qala ibraheemu rabbi arinee kayfa tuhyee almawta qala awalam tumin qala bala walakin liyatmainna qalbee qala fakhuth arbaAAatan mina alttayri fasurhunna ilayka thumma ijAAal AAala kulli jabalin minhunna juzan thumma odAAuhunna yateenaka saAAyan waiAAlam anna Allaha AAazeezun hakeemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][261]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Mathalu allatheena yunfiqoona amwalahum fee sabeeli Allahi kamathali habbatin anbatat sabAAa sanabila fee kulli sunbulatin miatu habbatin waAllahu yudaAAifu liman yashao waAllahu wasiAAun AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][262]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena yunfiqoona amwalahum fee sabeeli Allahi thumma la yutbiAAoona ma anfaqoo mannan wala athan lahum ajruhum AAinda rabbihim wala khawfun AAalayhim wala hum yahzanoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][263]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qawlun maAAroofun wamaghfiratun khayrun min sadaqatin yatbaAAuha athan waAllahu ghaniyyun haleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][264]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tubtiloo sadaqatikum bialmanni waalatha kaallathee yunfiqu malahu riaa alnnasi wala yuminu biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri famathaluhu kamathali safwanin AAalayhi turabun faasabahu wabilun fatarakahu saldan la yaqdiroona AAala shayin mimma kasaboo waAllahu la yahdee alqawma alkafireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][265]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wamathalu allatheena yunfiqoona amwalahumu ibtighaa mardati Allahi watathbeetan min anfusihim kamathali jannatin birabwatin asabaha wabilun faatat okulaha diAAfayni fain lam yusibha wabilun fatallun waAllahu bima taAAmaloona baseerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][266]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ayawaddu ahadukum an takoona lahu jannatun min nakheelin waaAAnabin tajree min tahtiha alanharu lahu feeha min kulli alththamarati waasabahu alkibaru walahu thurriyyatun duAAafao faasabaha iAAsarun feehi narun faihtaraqat kathalika yubayyinu Allahu lakumu alayati laAAallakum tatafakkaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][267]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo anfiqoo min tayyibati ma kasabtum wamimma akhrajna lakum mina alardi wala tayammamoo alkhabeetha minhu tunfiqoona walastum biakhitheehi illa an tughmidoo feehi waiAAlamoo anna Allaha ghaniyyun hameedun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][268]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alshshaytanu yaAAidukumu alfaqra wayamurukum bialfahshai waAllahu yaAAidukum maghfiratan minhu wafadlan waAllahu wasiAAun AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][269]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yutee alhikmata man yashao waman yuta alhikmata faqad ootiya khayran katheeran wama yaththakkaru illa oloo alalbabi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][270]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama anfaqtum min nafaqatin aw nathartum min nathrin fainna Allaha yaAAlamuhu wama lilththalimeena min ansarin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][271]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{In tubdoo alssadaqati faniAAimma hiya wain tukhfooha watutooha alfuqaraa fahuwa khayrun lakum wayukaffiru AAankum min sayyiatikum waAllahu bima taAAmaloona khabeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][272]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Laysa AAalayka hudahum walakinna Allaha yahdee man yashao wama tunfiqoo min khayrin falianfusikum wama tunfiqoona illa ibtighaa wajhi Allahi wama tunfiqoo min khayrin yuwaffa ilaykum waantum la tuthlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][273]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lilfuqarai allatheena ohsiroo fee sabeeli Allahi la yastateeAAoona darban fee alardi yahsabuhumu aljahilu aghniyaa mina alttaAAaffufi taAArifuhum biseemahum la yasaloona alnnasa ilhafan wama tunfiqoo min khayrin fainna Allaha bihi AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][274]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena yunfiqoona amwalahum biallayli waalnnahari sirran waAAalaniyatan falahum ajruhum AAinda rabbihim wala khawfun AAalayhim wala hum yahzanoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][275]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena yakuloona alrriba la yaqoomoona illa kama yaqoomu allathee yatakhabbatuhu alshshaytanu mina almassi thalika biannahum qaloo innama albayAAu mithlu alrriba waahalla Allahu albayAAa waharrama alrriba faman jaahu mawAAithatun min rabbihi faintaha falahu ma salafa waamruhu ila Allahi waman AAada faolaika ashabu alnnari hum feeha khalidoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][276]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yamhaqu Allahu alrriba wayurbee alssadaqati waAllahu la yuhibbu kulla kaffarin atheemin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][277]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati waaqamoo alssalata waatawoo alzzakata lahum ajruhum AAinda rabbihim wala khawfun AAalayhim wala hum yahzanoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][278]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ittaqoo Allaha watharoo ma baqiya mina alrriba in kuntum mumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][279]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fain lam tafAAaloo fathanoo biharbin mina Allahi warasoolihi wain tubtum falakum ruoosu amwalikum la tathlimoona wala tuthlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][280]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain kana thoo AAusratin fanathiratun ila maysaratin waan tasaddaqoo khayrun lakum in kuntum taAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][281]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waittaqoo yawman turjaAAoona feehi ila Allahi thumma tuwaffa kullu nafsin ma kasabat wahum la yuthlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][282]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha tadayantum bidaynin ila ajalin musamman faoktuboohu walyaktub baynakum katibun bialAAadli wala yaba katibun an yaktuba kama AAallamahu Allahu falyaktub walyumlili allathee AAalayhi alhaqqu walyattaqi Allaha rabbahu wala yabkhas minhu shayan fain kana allathee AAalayhi alhaqqu safeehan aw daAAeefan aw la yastateeAAu an yumilla huwa falyumlil waliyyuhu bialAAadli waistashhidoo shaheedayni min rijalikum fain lam yakoona rajulayni farajulun waimraatani mimman tardawna mina alshshuhadai an tadilla ihdahuma fatuthakkira ihdahuma alokhra wala yaba alshshuhadao itha ma duAAoo wala tasamoo an taktuboohu sagheeran aw kabeeran ila ajalihi thalikum aqsatu AAinda Allahi waaqwamu lilshshahadati waadna alla tartaboo illa an takoona tijaratan hadiratan tudeeroonaha baynakum falaysa AAalaykum junahun alla taktubooha waashhidoo itha tabayaAAtum wala yudarra katibun wala shaheedun wain tafAAaloo fainnahu fusooqun bikum waittaqoo Allaha wayuAAallimukumu Allahu waAllahu bikulli shayin AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][283]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain kuntum AAala safarin walam tajidoo katiban farihanun maqboodatun fain amina baAAdukum baAAdan falyuaddi allathee itumina amanatahu walyattaqi Allaha rabbahu wala taktumoo alshshahadata waman yaktumha fainnahu athimun qalbuhu waAllahu bima taAAmaloona AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][284]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wain tubdoo ma fee anfusikum aw tukhfoohu yuhasibkum bihi Allahu fayaghfiru liman yashao wayuAAaththibu man yashao waAllahu AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][285]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Amana alrrasoolu bima onzila ilayhi min rabbihi waalmuminoona kullun amana biAllahi wamalaikatihi wakutubihi warusulihi la nufarriqu bayna ahadin min rusulihi waqaloo samiAAna waataAAna ghufranaka rabbana wailayka almaseeru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][286]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{La yukallifu Allahu nafsan illa wusAAaha laha ma kasabat waAAalayha ma iktasabat rabbana la tuakhithna in naseena aw akhtana rabbana wala tahmil AAalayna isran kama hamaltahu AAala allatheena min qablina rabbana wala tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bihi waoAAfu AAanna waighfir lana wairhamna anta mawlana faonsurna AAala alqawmi alkafireena}
\chapter{Al-'Imran (The Family of Amran)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Aliflammeem}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allahu la ilaha illa huwa alhayyu alqayyoomu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Nazzala AAalayka alkitaba bialhaqqi musaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi waanzala alttawrata waalinjeela}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Min qablu hudan lilnnasi waanzala alfurqana inna allatheena kafaroo biayati Allahi lahum AAathabun shadeedun waAllahu AAazeezun thoo intiqamin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna Allaha la yakhfa AAalayhi shayon fee alardi wala fee alssamai}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Huwa allathee yusawwirukum fee alarhami kayfa yashao la ilaha illa huwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Huwa allathee anzala AAalayka alkitaba minhu ayatun muhkamatun hunna ommu alkitabi waokharu mutashabihatun faamma allatheena fee quloobihim zayghun fayattabiAAoona ma tashabaha minhu ibtighaa alfitnati waibtighaa taweelihi wama yaAAlamu taweelahu illa Allahu waalrrasikhoona fee alAAilmi yaqooloona amanna bihi kullun min AAindi rabbina wama yaththakkaru illa oloo alalbabi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Rabbana la tuzigh quloobana baAAda ith hadaytana wahab lana min ladunka rahmatan innaka anta alwahhabu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Rabbana innaka jamiAAu alnnasi liyawmin la rayba feehi inna Allaha la yukhlifu almeeAAada}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena kafaroo lan tughniya AAanhum amwaluhum wala awladuhum mina Allahi shayan waolaika hum waqoodu alnnari}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Kadabi ali firAAawna waallatheena min qablihim kaththaboo biayatina faakhathahumu Allahu bithunoobihim waAllahu shadeedu alAAiqabi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul lillatheena kafaroo satughlaboona watuhsharoona ila jahannama wabisa almihadu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qad kana lakum ayatun fee fiatayni iltaqata fiatun tuqatilu fee sabeeli Allahi waokhra kafiratun yarawnahum mithlayhim raya alAAayni waAllahu yuayyidu binasrihi man yashao inna fee thalika laAAibratan liolee alabsari}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Zuyyina lilnnasi hubbu alshshahawati mina alnnisai waalbaneena waalqanateeri almuqantarati mina alththahabi waalfiddati waalkhayli almusawwamati waalanAAami waalharthi thalika mataAAu alhayati alddunya waAllahu AAindahu husnu almaabi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul aonabbiokum bikhayrin min thalikum lillatheena ittaqaw AAinda rabbihim jannatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha waazwajun mutahharatun waridwanun mina Allahi waAllahu baseerun bialAAibadi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena yaqooloona rabbana innana amanna faighfir lana thunoobana waqina AAathaba alnnari}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alssabireena waalssadiqeena waalqaniteena waalmunfiqeena waalmustaghfireena bialashari}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Shahida Allahu annahu la ilaha illa huwa waalmalaikatu waoloo alAAilmi qaiman bialqisti la ilaha illa huwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna alddeena AAinda Allahi alislamu wama ikhtalafa allatheena ootoo alkitaba illa min baAAdi ma jaahumu alAAilmu baghyan baynahum waman yakfur biayati Allahi fainna Allaha sareeAAu alhisabi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fain hajjooka faqul aslamtu wajhiya lillahi wamani ittabaAAani waqul lillatheena ootoo alkitaba waalommiyyeena aaslamtum fain aslamoo faqadi ihtadaw wain tawallaw fainnama AAalayka albalaghu waAllahu baseerun bialAAibadi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena yakfuroona biayati Allahi wayaqtuloona alnnabiyyeena bighayri haqqin wayaqtuloona allatheena yamuroona bialqisti mina alnnasi fabashshirhum biAAathabin aleemin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Olaika allatheena habitat aAAmaluhum fee alddunya waalakhirati wama lahum min nasireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alam tara ila allatheena ootoo naseeban mina alkitabi yudAAawna ila kitabi Allahi liyahkuma baynahum thumma yatawalla fareequn minhum wahum muAAridoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thalika biannahum qaloo lan tamassana alnnaru illa ayyaman maAAdoodatin wagharrahum fee deenihim ma kanoo yaftaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fakayfa itha jamaAAnahum liyawmin la rayba feehi wawuffiyat kullu nafsin ma kasabat wahum la yuthlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Quli allahumma malika almulki tutee almulka man tashao watanziAAu almulka mimman tashao watuAAizzu man tashao watuthillu man tashao biyadika alkhayru innaka AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Tooliju allayla fee alnnahari watooliju alnnahara fee allayli watukhriju alhayya mina almayyiti watukhriju almayyita mina alhayyi watarzuqu man tashao bighayri hisabin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{La yattakhithi almuminoona alkafireena awliyaa min dooni almumineena waman yafAAal thalika falaysa mina Allahi fee shayin illa an tattaqoo minhum tuqatan wayuhaththirukumu Allahu nafsahu waila Allahi almaseeru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul in tukhfoo ma fee sudoorikum aw tubdoohu yaAAlamhu Allahu wayaAAlamu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi waAllahu AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yawma tajidu kullu nafsin ma AAamilat min khayrin muhdaran wama AAamilat min sooin tawaddu law anna baynaha wabaynahu amadan baAAeedan wayuhaththirukumu Allahu nafsahu waAllahu raoofun bialAAibadi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul in kuntum tuhibboona Allaha faittabiAAoonee yuhbibkumu Allahu wayaghfir lakum thunoobakum waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul ateeAAoo Allaha waalrrasoola fain tawallaw fainna Allaha la yuhibbu alkafireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna Allaha istafa adama wanoohan waala ibraheema waala AAimrana AAala alAAalameena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thurriyyatan baAAduha min baAAdin waAllahu sameeAAun AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ith qalati imraatu AAimrana rabbi innee nathartu laka ma fee batnee muharraran fataqabbal minnee innaka anta alssameeAAu alAAaleemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Falamma wadaAAatha qalat rabbi innee wadaAAtuha ontha waAllahu aAAlamu bima wadaAAat walaysa alththakaru kaalontha wainnee sammaytuha maryama wainnee oAAeethuha bika wathurriyyataha mina alshshaytani alrrajeemi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fataqabbalaha rabbuha biqaboolin hasanin waanbataha nabatan hasanan wakaffalaha zakariyya kullama dakhala AAalayha zakariyya almihraba wajada AAindaha rizqan qala ya maryamu anna laki hatha qalat huwa min AAindi Allahi inna Allaha yarzuqu man yashao bighayri hisabin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Hunalika daAAa zakariyya rabbahu qala rabbi hab lee min ladunka thurriyyatan tayyibatan innaka sameeAAu aldduAAai}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fanadathu almalaikatu wahuwa qaimun yusallee fee almihrabi anna Allaha yubashshiruka biyahya musaddiqan bikalimatin mina Allahi wasayyidan wahasooran wanabiyyan mina alssaliheena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qala rabbi anna yakoonu lee ghulamun waqad balaghaniya alkibaru waimraatee AAaqirun qala kathalika Allahu yafAAalu ma yashao}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qala rabbi ijAAal lee ayatan qala ayatuka alla tukallima alnnasa thalathata ayyamin illa ramzan waothkur rabbaka katheeran wasabbih bialAAashiyyi waalibkari}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith qalati almalaikatu ya maryamu inna Allaha istafaki watahharaki waistafaki AAala nisai alAAalameena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya maryamu oqnutee lirabbiki waosjudee wairkaAAee maAAa alrrakiAAeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thalika min anbai alghaybi nooheehi ilayka wama kunta ladayhim ith yulqoona aqlamahum ayyuhum yakfulu maryama wama kunta ladayhim ith yakhtasimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ith qalati almalaikatu ya maryamu inna Allaha yubashshiruki bikalimatin minhu ismuhu almaseehu AAeesa ibnu maryama wajeehan fee alddunya waalakhirati wamina almuqarrabeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wayukallimu alnnasa fee almahdi wakahlan wamina alssaliheena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qalat rabbi anna yakoonu lee waladun walam yamsasnee basharun qala kathaliki Allahu yakhluqu ma yashao itha qada amran fainnama yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoonu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WayuAAallimuhu alkitaba waalhikmata waalttawrata waalinjeela}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][49]
\end{Arabic}}
