\flushleft{Warasoolan ila banee israeela annee qad jitukum biayatin min rabbikum annee akhluqu lakum mina altteeni kahayati alttayri faanfukhu feehi fayakoonu tayran biithni Allahi waobrio alakmaha waalabrasa waohyee almawta biithni Allahi waonabbiokum bima takuloona wama taddakhiroona fee buyootikum inna fee thalika laayatan lakum in kuntum mumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wamusaddiqan lima bayna yadayya mina alttawrati waliohilla lakum baAAda allathee hurrima AAalaykum wajitukum biayatin min rabbikum faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna Allaha rabbee warabbukum faoAAbudoohu hatha siratun mustaqeemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Falamma ahassa AAeesa minhumu alkufra qala man ansaree ila Allahi qala alhawariyyoona nahnu ansaru Allahi amanna biAllahi waishhad bianna muslimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Rabbana amanna bima anzalta waittabaAAna alrrasoola faoktubna maAAa alshshahideena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wamakaroo wamakara Allahu waAllahu khayru almakireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ith qala Allahu ya AAeesa innee mutawaffeeka warafiAAuka ilayya wamutahhiruka mina allatheena kafaroo wajaAAilu allatheena ittabaAAooka fawqa allatheena kafaroo ila yawmi alqiyamati thumma ilayya marjiAAukum faahkumu baynakum feema kuntum feehi takhtalifoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faamma allatheena kafaroo faoAAaththibuhum AAathaban shadeedan fee alddunya waalakhirati wama lahum min nasireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waamma allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati fayuwaffeehim ojoorahum waAllahu la yuhibbu alththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thalika natloohu AAalayka mina alayati waalththikri alhakeemi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna mathala AAeesa AAinda Allahi kamathali adama khalaqahu min turabin thumma qala lahu kun fayakoonu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alhaqqu min rabbika fala takun mina almumtareena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faman hajjaka feehi min baAAdi ma jaaka mina alAAilmi faqul taAAalaw nadAAu abnaana waabnaakum wanisaana wanisaakum waanfusana waanfusakum thumma nabtahil fanajAAal laAAnata Allahi AAala alkathibeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna hatha lahuwa alqasasu alhaqqu wama min ilahin illa Allahu wainna Allaha lahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fain tawallaw fainna Allaha AAaleemun bialmufsideena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul ya ahla alkitabi taAAalaw ila kalimatin sawain baynana wabaynakum alla naAAbuda illa Allaha wala nushrika bihi shayan wala yattakhitha baAAduna baAAdan arbaban min dooni Allahi fain tawallaw faqooloo ishhadoo bianna muslimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ahla alkitabi lima tuhajjoona fee ibraheema wama onzilati alttawratu waalinjeelu illa min baAAdihi afala taAAqiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Haantum haolai hajajtum feema lakum bihi AAilmun falima tuhajjoona feema laysa lakum bihi AAilmun waAllahu yaAAlamu waantum la taAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ma kana ibraheemu yahoodiyyan wala nasraniyyan walakin kana haneefan musliman wama kana mina almushrikeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna awla alnnasi biibraheema lallatheena ittabaAAoohu wahatha alnnabiyyu waallatheena amanoo waAllahu waliyyu almumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waddat taifatun min ahli alkitabi law yudilloonakum wama yudilloona illa anfusahum wama yashAAuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ahla alkitabi lima takfuroona biayati Allahi waantum tashhadoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ahla alkitabi lima talbisoona alhaqqa bialbatili wataktumoona alhaqqa waantum taAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqalat taifatun min ahli alkitabi aminoo biallathee onzila AAala allatheena amanoo wajha alnnahari waokfuroo akhirahu laAAallahum yarjiAAoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala tuminoo illa liman tabiAAa deenakum qul inna alhuda huda Allahi an yuta ahadun mithla ma ooteetum aw yuhajjookum AAinda rabbikum qul inna alfadla biyadi Allahi yuteehi man yashao waAllahu wasiAAun AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yakhtassu birahmatihi man yashao waAllahu thoo alfadli alAAatheemi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wamin ahli alkitabi man in tamanhu biqintarin yuaddihi ilayka waminhum man in tamanhu bideenarin la yuaddihi ilayka illa ma dumta AAalayhi qaiman thalika biannahum qaloo laysa AAalayna fee alommiyyeena sabeelun wayaqooloona AAala Allahi alkathiba wahum yaAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Bala man awfa biAAahdihi waittaqa fainna Allaha yuhibbu almuttaqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena yashtaroona biAAahdi Allahi waaymanihim thamanan qaleelan olaika la khalaqa lahum fee alakhirati wala yukallimuhumu Allahu wala yanthuru ilayhim yawma alqiyamati wala yuzakkeehim walahum AAathabun aleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wainna minhum lafareeqan yalwoona alsinatahum bialkitabi litahsaboohu mina alkitabi wama huwa mina alkitabi wayaqooloona huwa min AAindi Allahi wama huwa min AAindi Allahi wayaqooloona AAala Allahi alkathiba wahum yaAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ma kana libasharin an yutiyahu Allahu alkitaba waalhukma waalnnubuwwata thumma yaqoola lilnnasi koonoo AAibadan lee min dooni Allahi walakin koonoo rabbaniyyeena bima kuntum tuAAallimoona alkitaba wabima kuntum tadrusoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala yamurakum an tattakhithoo almalaikata waalnnabiyyeena arbaban ayamurukum bialkufri baAAda ith antum muslimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith akhatha Allahu meethaqa alnnabiyyeena lama ataytukum min kitabin wahikmatin thumma jaakum rasoolun musaddiqun lima maAAakum latuminunna bihi walatansurunnahu qala aaqrartum waakhathtum AAala thalikum isree qaloo aqrarna qala faishhadoo waana maAAakum mina alshshahideena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faman tawalla baAAda thalika faolaika humu alfasiqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Afaghayra deeni Allahi yabghoona walahu aslama man fee alssamawati waalardi tawAAan wakarhan wailayhi yurjaAAoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul amanna biAllahi wama onzila AAalayna wama onzila AAala ibraheema waismaAAeela waishaqa wayaAAqooba waalasbati wama ootiya moosa waAAeesa waalnnabiyyoona min rabbihim la nufarriqu bayna ahadin minhum wanahnu lahu muslimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waman yabtaghi ghayra alislami deenan falan yuqbala minhu wahuwa fee alakhirati mina alkhasireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][86]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Kayfa yahdee Allahu qawman kafaroo baAAda eemanihim washahidoo anna alrrasoola haqqun wajaahumu albayyinatu waAllahu la yahdee alqawma alththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Olaika jazaohum anna AAalayhim laAAnata Allahi waalmalaikati waalnnasi ajmaAAeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Khalideena feeha la yukhaffafu AAanhumu alAAathabu wala hum yuntharoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][89]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Illa allatheena taboo min baAAdi thalika waaslahoo fainna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][90]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena kafaroo baAAda eemanihim thumma izdadoo kufran lan tuqbala tawbatuhum waolaika humu alddalloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][91]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena kafaroo wamatoo wahum kuffarun falan yuqbala min ahadihim milo alardi thahaban walawi iftada bihi olaika lahum AAathabun aleemun wama lahum min nasireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][92]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lan tanaloo albirra hatta tunfiqoo mimma tuhibboona wama tunfiqoo min shayin fainna Allaha bihi AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][93]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Kullu alttaAAami kana hillan libanee israeela illa ma harrama israeelu AAala nafsihi min qabli an tunazzala alttawratu qul fatoo bialttawrati faotlooha in kuntum sadiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][94]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Famani iftara AAala Allahi alkathiba min baAAdi thalika faolaika humu althalimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][95]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul sadaqa Allahu faittabiAAoo millata ibraheema haneefan wama kana mina almushrikeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][96]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna awwala baytin wudiAAa lilnnasi lallathee bibakkata mubarakan wahudan lilAAalameena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][97]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Feehi ayatun bayyinatun maqamu ibraheema waman dakhalahu kana aminan walillahi AAala alnnasi hijju albayti mani istataAAa ilayhi sabeelan waman kafara fainna Allaha ghaniyyun AAani alAAalameena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][98]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul ya ahla alkitabi lima takfuroona biayati Allahi waAllahu shaheedun AAala ma taAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][99]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul ya ahla alkitabi lima tasuddoona AAan sabeeli Allahi man amana tabghoonaha AAiwajan waantum shuhadao wama Allahu bighafilin AAamma taAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][100]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo in tuteeAAoo fareeqan mina allatheena ootoo alkitaba yaruddookum baAAda eemanikum kafireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][101]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wakayfa takfuroona waantum tutla AAalaykum ayatu Allahi wafeekum rasooluhu waman yaAAtasim biAllahi faqad hudiya ila siratin mustaqeemin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][102]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ittaqoo Allaha haqqa tuqatihi wala tamootunna illa waantum muslimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][103]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaiAAtasimoo bihabli Allahi jameeAAan wala tafarraqoo waothkuroo niAAmata Allahi AAalaykum ith kuntum aAAdaan faallafa bayna quloobikum faasbahtum biniAAmatihi ikhwanan wakuntum AAala shafa hufratin mina alnnari faanqathakum minha kathalika yubayyinu Allahu lakum ayatihi laAAallakum tahtadoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][104]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waltakun minkum ommatun yadAAoona ila alkhayri wayamuroona bialmaAAroofi wayanhawna AAani almunkari waolaika humu almuflihoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][105]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala takoonoo kaallatheena tafarraqoo waikhtalafoo min baAAdi ma jaahumu albayyinatu waolaika lahum AAathabun AAatheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][106]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yawma tabyaddu wujoohun wataswaddu wujoohun faamma allatheena iswaddat wujoohuhum akafartum baAAda eemanikum fathooqoo alAAathaba bima kuntum takfuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][107]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waamma allatheena ibyaddat wujoohuhum fafee rahmati Allahi hum feeha khalidoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][108]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Tilka ayatu Allahi natlooha AAalayka bialhaqqi wama Allahu yureedu thulman lilAAalameena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][109]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi waila Allahi turjaAAu alomooru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][110]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Kuntum khayra ommatin okhrijat lilnnasi tamuroona bialmaAAroofi watanhawna AAani almunkari watuminoona biAllahi walaw amana ahlu alkitabi lakana khayran lahum minhumu almuminoona waaktharuhumu alfasiqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][111]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lan yadurrookum illa athan wain yuqatilookum yuwallookumu aladbara thumma la yunsaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][112]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Duribat AAalayhimu alththillatu ayna ma thuqifoo illa bihablin mina Allahi wahablin mina alnnasi wabaoo bighadabin mina Allahi waduribat AAalayhimu almaskanatu thalika biannahum kanoo yakfuroona biayati Allahi wayaqtuloona alanbiyaa bighayri haqqin thalika bima AAasaw wakanoo yaAAtadoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][113]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Laysoo sawaan min ahli alkitabi ommatun qaimatun yatloona ayati Allahi anaa allayli wahum yasjudoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][114]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yuminoona biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri wayamuroona bialmaAAroofi wayanhawna AAani almunkari wayusariAAoona fee alkhayrati waolaika mina alssaliheena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][115]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama yafAAaloo min khayrin falan yukfaroohu waAllahu AAaleemun bialmuttaqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][116]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena kafaroo lan tughniya AAanhum amwaluhum wala awladuhum mina Allahi shayan waolaika ashabu alnnari hum feeha khalidoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][117]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Mathalu ma yunfiqoona fee hathihi alhayati alddunya kamathali reehin feeha sirrun asabat hartha qawmin thalamoo anfusahum faahlakathu wama thalamahumu Allahu walakin anfusahum yathlimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][118]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tattakhithoo bitanatan min doonikum la yaloonakum khabalan waddoo ma AAanittum qad badati albaghdao min afwahihim wama tukhfee sudooruhum akbaru qad bayyanna lakumu alayati in kuntum taAAqiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][119]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Haantum olai tuhibboonahum wala yuhibboonakum watuminoona bialkitabi kullihi waitha laqookum qaloo amanna waitha khalaw AAaddoo AAalaykumu alanamila mina alghaythi qul mootoo bighaythikum inna Allaha AAaleemun bithati alssudoori}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][120]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{In tamsaskum hasanatun tasuhum wain tusibkum sayyiatun yafrahoo biha wain tasbiroo watattaqoo la yadurrukum kayduhum shayan inna Allaha bima yaAAmaloona muheetun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][121]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith ghadawta min ahlika tubawwio almumineena maqaAAida lilqitali waAllahu sameeAAun AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][122]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ith hammat taifatani minkum an tafshala waAllahu waliyyuhuma waAAala Allahi falyatawakkali almuminoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][123]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaqad nasarakumu Allahu bibadrin waantum athillatun faittaqoo Allaha laAAallakum tashkuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][124]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ith taqoolu lilmumineena alan yakfiyakum an yumiddakum rabbukum bithalathati alafin mina almalaikati munzaleena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][125]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Bala in tasbiroo watattaqoo wayatookum min fawrihim hatha yumdidkum rabbukum bikhamsati alafin mina almalaikati musawwimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][126]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama jaAAalahu Allahu illa bushra lakum walitatmainna quloobukum bihi wama alnnasru illa min AAindi Allahi alAAazeezi alhakeemi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][127]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{LiyaqtaAAa tarafan mina allatheena kafaroo aw yakbitahum fayanqaliboo khaibeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][128]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Laysa laka mina alamri shayon aw yatooba AAalayhim aw yuAAaththibahum fainnahum thalimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][129]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi yaghfiru liman yashao wayuAAaththibu man yashao waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][130]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la takuloo alrriba adAAafan mudaAAafatan waittaqoo Allaha laAAallakum tuflihoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][131]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waittaqoo alnnara allatee oAAiddat lilkafireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][132]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaateeAAoo Allaha waalrrasoola laAAallakum turhamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][133]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WasariAAoo ila maghfiratin min rabbikum wajannatin AAarduha alssamawatu waalardu oAAiddat lilmuttaqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][134]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena yunfiqoona fee alssarrai waalddarrai waalkathimeena alghaytha waalAAafeena AAani alnnasi waAllahu yuhibbu almuhsineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][135]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena itha faAAaloo fahishatan aw thalamoo anfusahum thakaroo Allaha faistaghfaroo lithunoobihim waman yaghfiru alththunooba illa Allahu walam yusirroo AAala ma faAAaloo wahum yaAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][136]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Olaika jazaohum maghfiratun min rabbihim wajannatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha waniAAma ajru alAAamileena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][137]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qad khalat min qablikum sunanun faseeroo fee alardi faonthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu almukaththibeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][138]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Hatha bayanun lilnnasi wahudan wamawAAithatun lilmuttaqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][139]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala tahinoo wala tahzanoo waantumu alaAAlawna in kuntum mumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][140]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{In yamsaskum qarhun faqad massa alqawma qarhun mithluhu watilka alayyamu nudawiluha bayna alnnasi waliyaAAlama Allahu allatheena amanoo wayattakhitha minkum shuhadaa waAllahu la yuhibbu alththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][141]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waliyumahhisa Allahu allatheena amanoo wayamhaqa alkafireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][142]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Am hasibtum an tadkhuloo aljannata walamma yaAAlami Allahu allatheena jahadoo minkum wayaAAlama alssabireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][143]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaqad kuntum tamannawna almawta min qabli an talqawhu faqad raaytumoohu waantum tanthuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][144]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama muhammadun illa rasoolun qad khalat min qablihi alrrusulu afain mata aw qutila inqalabtum AAala aAAqabikum waman yanqalib AAala AAaqibayhi falan yadurra Allaha shayan wasayajzee Allahu alshshakireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][145]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama kana linafsin an tamoota illa biithni Allahi kitaban muajjalan waman yurid thawaba alddunya nutihi minha waman yurid thawaba alakhirati nutihi minha wasanajzee alshshakireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][146]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wakaayyin min nabiyyin qatala maAAahu ribbiyyoona katheerun fama wahanoo lima asabahum fee sabeeli Allahi wama daAAufoo wama istakanoo waAllahu yuhibbu alssabireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][147]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama kana qawlahum illa an qaloo rabbana ighfir lana thunoobana waisrafana fee amrina wathabbit aqdamana waonsurna AAala alqawmi alkafireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][148]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faatahumu Allahu thawaba alddunya wahusna thawabi alakhirati waAllahu yuhibbu almuhsineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][149]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo in tuteeAAoo allatheena kafaroo yaruddookum AAala aAAqabikum fatanqaliboo khasireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][150]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Bali Allahu mawlakum wahuwa khayru alnnasireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][151]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Sanulqee fee quloobi allatheena kafaroo alrruAAba bima ashrakoo biAllahi ma lam yunazzil bihi sultanan wamawahumu alnnaru wabisa mathwa alththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][152]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaqad sadaqakumu Allahu waAAdahu ith tahussoonahum biithnihi hatta itha fashiltum watanazaAAtum fee alamri waAAasaytum min baAAdi ma arakum ma tuhibboona minkum man yureedu alddunya waminkum man yureedu alakhirata thumma sarafakum AAanhum liyabtaliyakum walaqad AAafa AAankum waAllahu thoo fadlin AAala almumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][153]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ith tusAAidoona wala talwoona AAala ahadin waalrrasoolu yadAAookum fee okhrakum faathabakum ghamman bighammin likayla tahzanoo AAala ma fatakum wala ma asabakum waAllahu khabeerun bima taAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][154]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thumma anzala AAalaykum min baAAdi alghammi amanatan nuAAasan yaghsha taifatan minkum wataifatun qad ahammathum anfusuhum yathunnoona biAllahi ghayra alhaqqi thanna aljahiliyyati yaqooloona hal lana mina alamri min shayin qul inna alamra kullahu lillahi yukhfoona fee anfusihim ma la yubdoona laka yaqooloona law kana lana mina alamri shayon ma qutilna hahuna qul law kuntum fee buyootikum labaraza allatheena kutiba AAalayhimu alqatlu ila madajiAAihim waliyabtaliya Allahu ma fee sudoorikum waliyumahhisa ma fee quloobikum waAllahu AAaleemun bithati alssudoori}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][155]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena tawallaw minkum yawma iltaqa aljamAAani innama istazallahumu alshshaytanu bibaAAdi ma kasaboo walaqad AAafa Allahu AAanhum inna Allaha ghafoorun haleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][156]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la takoonoo kaallatheena kafaroo waqaloo liikhwanihim itha daraboo fee alardi aw kanoo ghuzzan law kanoo AAindana ma matoo wama qutiloo liyajAAala Allahu thalika hasratan fee quloobihim waAllahu yuhyee wayumeetu waAllahu bima taAAmaloona baseerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][157]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walain qutiltum fee sabeeli Allahi aw muttum lamaghfiratun mina Allahi warahmatun khayrun mimma yajmaAAoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][158]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walain muttum aw qutiltum laila Allahi tuhsharoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][159]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fabima rahmatin mina Allahi linta lahum walaw kunta faththan ghaleetha alqalbi lainfaddoo min hawlika faoAAfu AAanhum waistaghfir lahum washawirhum fee alamri faitha AAazamta fatawakkal AAala Allahi inna Allaha yuhibbu almutawakkileena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][160]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{In yansurkumu Allahu fala ghaliba lakum wain yakhthulkum faman tha allathee yansurukum min baAAdihi waAAala Allahi falyatawakkali almuminoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][161]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama kana linabiyyin an yaghulla waman yaghlul yati bima ghalla yawma alqiyamati thumma tuwaffa kullu nafsin ma kasabat wahum la yuthlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][162]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Afamani ittabaAAa ridwana Allahi kaman baa bisakhatin mina Allahi wamawahu jahannamu wabisa almaseeru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][163]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Hum darajatun AAinda Allahi waAllahu baseerun bima yaAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][164]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Laqad manna Allahu AAala almumineena ith baAAatha feehim rasoolan min anfusihim yatloo AAalayhim ayatihi wayuzakkeehim wayuAAallimuhumu alkitaba waalhikmata wain kanoo min qablu lafee dalalin mubeenin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][165]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Awalamma asabatkum museebatun qad asabtum mithlayha qultum anna hatha qul huwa min AAindi anfusikum inna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][166]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama asabakum yawma iltaqa aljamAAani fabiithni Allahi waliyaAAlama almumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][167]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaliyaAAlama allatheena nafaqoo waqeela lahum taAAalaw qatiloo fee sabeeli Allahi awi idfaAAoo qaloo law naAAlamu qitalan laittabaAAnakum hum lilkufri yawmaithin aqrabu minhum lileemani yaqooloona biafwahihim ma laysa fee quloobihim waAllahu aAAlamu bima yaktumoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][168]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena qaloo liikhwanihim waqaAAadoo law ataAAoona ma qutiloo qul faidraoo AAan anfusikumu almawta in kuntum sadiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][169]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala tahsabanna allatheena qutiloo fee sabeeli Allahi amwatan bal ahyaon AAinda rabbihim yurzaqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][170]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fariheena bima atahumu Allahu min fadlihi wayastabshiroona biallatheena lam yalhaqoo bihim min khalfihim alla khawfun AAalayhim wala hum yahzanoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][171]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yastabshiroona biniAAmatin mina Allahi wafadlin waanna Allaha la yudeeAAu ajra almumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][172]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena istajaboo lillahi waalrrasooli min baAAdi ma asabahumu alqarhu lillatheena ahsanoo minhum waittaqaw ajrun AAatheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][173]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena qala lahumu alnnasu inna alnnasa qad jamaAAoo lakum faikhshawhum fazadahum eemanan waqaloo hasbuna Allahu waniAAma alwakeelu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][174]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fainqalaboo biniAAmatin mina Allahi wafadlin lam yamsashum sooon waittabaAAoo ridwana Allahi waAllahu thoo fadlin AAatheemin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][175]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Innama thalikumu alshshaytanu yukhawwifu awliyaahu fala takhafoohum wakhafooni in kuntum mumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][176]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala yahzunka allatheena yusariAAoona fee alkufri innahum lan yadurroo Allaha shayan yureedu Allahu alla yajAAala lahum haththan fee alakhirati walahum AAathabun AAatheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][177]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena ishtarawoo alkufra bialeemani lan yadurroo Allaha shayan walahum AAathabun aleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][178]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala yahsabanna allatheena kafaroo annama numlee lahum khayrun lianfusihim innama numlee lahum liyazdadoo ithman walahum AAathabun muheenun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][179]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ma kana Allahu liyathara almumineena AAala ma antum AAalayhi hatta yameeza alkhabeetha mina alttayyibi wama kana Allahu liyutliAAakum AAala alghaybi walakinna Allaha yajtabee min rusulihi man yashao faaminoo biAllahi warusulihi wain tuminoo watattaqoo falakum ajrun AAatheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][180]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala yahsabanna allatheena yabkhaloona bima atahummu Allahu min fadlihi huwa khayran lahum bal huwa sharrun lahum sayutawwaqoona ma bakhiloo bihi yawma alqiyamati walillahi meerathu alssamawati waalardi waAllahu bima taAAmaloona khabeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][181]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Laqad samiAAa Allahu qawla allatheena qaloo inna Allaha faqeerun wanahnu aghniyaon sanaktubu ma qaloo waqatlahumu alanbiyaa bighayri haqqin wanaqoolu thooqoo AAathaba alhareeqi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][182]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thalika bima qaddamat aydeekum waanna Allaha laysa bithallamin lilAAabeedi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][183]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena qaloo inna Allaha AAahida ilayna alla numina lirasoolin hatta yatiyana biqurbanin takuluhu alnnaru qul qad jaakum rusulun min qablee bialbayyinati wabiallathee qultum falima qataltumoohum in kutum sadiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][184]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fain kaththabooka faqad kuththiba rusulun min qablika jaoo bialbayyinati waalzzuburi waalkitabi almuneeri}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][185]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Kullu nafsin thaiqatu almawti wainnama tuwaffawna ojoorakum yawma alqiyamati faman zuhziha AAani alnnari waodkhila aljannata faqad faza wama alhayatu alddunya illa mataAAu alghuroori}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][186]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Latublawunna fee amwalikum waanfusikum walatasmaAAunna mina allatheena ootoo alkitaba min qablikum wamina allatheena ashrakoo athan katheeran wain tasbiroo watattaqoo fainna thalika min AAazmi alomoori}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][187]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith akhatha Allahu meethaqa allatheena ootoo alkitaba latubayyinunnahu lilnnasi wala taktumoonahu fanabathoohu waraa thuhoorihim waishtaraw bihi thamanan qaleelan fabisa ma yashtaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][188]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{La tahsabanna allatheena yafrahoona bima ataw wayuhibboona an yuhmadoo bima lam yafAAaloo fala tahsabannahum bimafazatin mina alAAathabi walahum AAathabun aleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][189]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walillahi mulku alssamawati waalardi waAllahu AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][190]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna fee khalqi alssamawati waalardi waikhtilafi allayli waalnnahari laayatin liolee alalbabi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][191]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena yathkuroona Allaha qiyaman waquAAoodan waAAala junoobihim wayatafakkaroona fee khalqi alssamawati waalardi rabbana ma khalaqta hatha batilan subhanaka faqina AAathaba alnnari}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][192]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Rabbana innaka man tudkhili alnnara faqad akhzaytahu wama lilththalimeena min ansarin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][193]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Rabbana innana samiAAna munadiyan yunadee lileemani an aminoo birabbikum faamanna rabbana faighfir lana thunoobana wakaffir AAanna sayyiatina watawaffana maAAa alabrari}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][194]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Rabbana waatina ma waAAadtana AAala rusulika wala tukhzina yawma alqiyamati innaka la tukhlifu almeeAAada}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][195]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faistajaba lahum rabbuhum annee la odeeAAu AAamala AAamilin minkum min thakarin aw ontha baAAdukum min baAAdin faallatheena hajaroo waokhrijoo min diyarihim waoothoo fee sabeelee waqataloo waqutiloo laokaffiranna AAanhum sayyiatihim walaodkhilannahum jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu thawaban min AAindi Allahi waAllahu AAindahu husnu alththawabi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][196]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{La yaghurrannaka taqallubu allatheena kafaroo fee albiladi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][197]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{MataAAun qaleelun thumma mawahum jahannamu wabisa almihadu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][198]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lakini allatheena ittaqaw rabbahum lahum jannatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha nuzulan min AAindi Allahi wama AAinda Allahi khayrun lilabrari}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][199]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wainna min ahli alkitabi laman yuminu biAllahi wama onzila ilaykum wama onzila ilayhim khashiAAeena lillahi la yashtaroona biayati Allahi thamanan qaleelan olaika lahum ajruhum AAinda rabbihim inna Allaha sareeAAu alhisabi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][200]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo isbiroo wasabiroo warabitoo waittaqoo Allaha laAAallakum tuflihoona}
\chapter{An-Nisa' (The Women)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha alnnasu ittaqoo rabbakumu allathee khalaqakum min nafsin wahidatin wakhalaqa minha zawjaha wabaththa minhuma rijalan katheeran wanisaan waittaqoo Allaha allathee tasaaloona bihi waalarhama inna Allaha kana AAalaykum raqeeban}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waatoo alyatama amwalahum wala tatabaddaloo alkhabeetha bialttayyibi wala takuloo amwalahum ila amwalikum innahu kana hooban kabeeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain khiftum alla tuqsitoo fee alyatama fainkihoo ma taba lakum mina alnnisai mathna wathulatha warubaAAa fain khiftum alla taAAdiloo fawahidatan aw ma malakat aymanukum thalika adna alla taAAooloo}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waatoo alnnisaa saduqatihinna nihlatan fain tibna lakum AAan shayin minhu nafsan fakuloohu haneean mareean}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala tutoo alssufahaa amwalakumu allatee jaAAala Allahu lakum qiyaman waorzuqoohum feeha waoksoohum waqooloo lahum qawlan maAAroofan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waibtaloo alyatama hatta itha balaghoo alnnikaha fain anastum minhum rushdan faidfaAAoo ilayhim amwalahum wala takulooha israfan wabidaran an yakbaroo waman kana ghaniyyan falyastaAAfif waman kana faqeeran falyakul bialmaAAroofi faitha dafaAAtum ilayhim amwalahum faashhidoo AAalayhim wakafa biAllahi haseeban}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lilrrijali naseebun mimma taraka alwalidani waalaqraboona walilnnisai naseebun mimma taraka alwalidani waalaqraboona mimma qalla minhu aw kathura naseeban mafroodan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha hadara alqismata oloo alqurba waalyatama waalmasakeenu faorzuqoohum minhu waqooloo lahum qawlan maAAroofan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walyakhsha allatheena law tarakoo min khalfihim thurriyyatan diAAafan khafoo AAalayhim falyattaqoo Allaha walyaqooloo qawlan sadeedan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena yakuloona amwala alyatama thulman innama yakuloona fee butoonihim naran wasayaslawna saAAeeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yooseekumu Allahu fee awladikum lilththakari mithlu haththi alonthayayni fain kunna nisaan fawqa ithnatayni falahunna thulutha ma taraka wain kanat wahidatan falaha alnnisfu waliabawayhi likulli wahidin minhuma alssudusu mimma taraka in kana lahu waladun fain lam yakun lahu waladun wawarithahu abawahu faliommihi alththuluthu fain kana lahu ikhwatun faliommihi alssudusu min baAAdi wasiyyatin yoosee biha aw daynin abaokum waabnaokum la tadroona ayyuhum aqrabu lakum nafAAan fareedatan mina Allahi inna Allaha kana AAaleeman hakeeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walakum nisfu ma taraka azwajukum in lam yakun lahunna waladun fain kana lahunna waladun falakumu alrrubuAAu mimma tarakna min baAAdi wasiyyatin yooseena biha aw daynin walahunna alrrubuAAu mimma taraktum in lam yakun lakum waladun fain kana lakum waladun falahunna alththumunu mimma taraktum min baAAdi wasiyyatin toosoona biha aw daynin wain kana rajulun yoorathu kalalatan awi imraatun walahu akhun aw okhtun falikulli wahidin minhuma alssudusu fain kanoo akthara min thalika fahum shurakao fee alththuluthi min baAAdi wasiyyatin yoosa biha aw daynin ghayra mudarrin wasiyyatan mina Allahi waAllahu AAaleemun haleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Tilka hudoodu Allahi waman yutiAAi Allaha warasoolahu yudkhilhu jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha wathalika alfawzu alAAatheemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waman yaAAsi Allaha warasoolahu wayataAAadda hudoodahu yudkhilhu naran khalidan feeha walahu AAathabun muheenun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatee yateena alfahishata min nisaikum faistashhidoo AAalayhinna arbaAAatan minkum fain shahidoo faamsikoohunna fee albuyooti hatta yatawaffahunna almawtu aw yajAAala Allahu lahunna sabeelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallathani yatiyaniha minkum faathoohuma fain taba waaslaha faaAAridoo AAanhuma inna Allaha kana tawwaban raheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Innama alttawbatu AAala Allahi lillatheena yaAAmaloona alssooa bijahalatin thumma yatooboona min qareebin faolaika yatoobu Allahu AAalayhim wakana Allahu AAaleeman hakeeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaysati alttawbatu lillatheena yaAAmaloona alssayyiati hatta itha hadara ahadahumu almawtu qala innee tubtu alana wala allatheena yamootoona wahum kuffarun olaika aAAtadna lahum AAathaban aleeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la yahillu lakum an tarithoo alnnisaa karhan wala taAAduloohunna litathhaboo bibaAAdi ma ataytumoohunna illa an yateena bifahishatin mubayyinatin waAAashiroohunna bialmaAAroofi fain karihtumoohunna faAAasa an takrahoo shayan wayajAAala Allahu feehi khayran katheeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain aradtumu istibdala zawjin makana zawjin waataytum ihdahunna qintaran fala takhuthoo minhu shayan atakhuthoonahu buhtanan waithman mubeenan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wakayfa takhuthoonahu waqad afda baAAdukum ila baAAdin waakhathna minkum meethaqan ghaleethan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala tankihoo ma nakaha abaokum mina alnnisai illa ma qad salafa innahu kana fahishatan wamaqtan wasaa sabeelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Hurrimat AAalaykum ommahatukum wabanatukum waakhawatukum waAAammatukum wakhalatukum wabanatu alakhi wabanatu alokhti waommahatukumu allatee ardaAAnakum waakhawatukum mina alrradaAAati waommahatu nisaikum warabaibukumu allatee fee hujoorikum min nisaikumu allatee dakhaltum bihinna fain lam takoonoo dakhaltum bihinna fala junaha AAalaykum wahalailu abnaikumu allatheena min aslabikum waan tajmaAAoo bayna alokhtayni illa ma qad salafa inna Allaha kana ghafooran raheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waalmuhsanatu mina alnnisai illa ma malakat aymanukum kitaba Allahi AAalaykum waohilla lakum ma waraa thalikum an tabtaghoo biamwalikum muhsineena ghayra musafiheena fama istamtaAAtum bihi minhunna faatoohunna ojoorahunna fareedatan wala junaha AAalaykum feema taradaytum bihi min baAAdi alfareedati inna Allaha kana AAaleeman hakeeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waman lam yastatiAA minkum tawlan an yankiha almuhsanati almuminati famin ma malakat aymanukum min fatayatikumu almuminati waAllahu aAAlamu bieemanikum baAAdukum min baAAdin fainkihoohunna biithni ahlihinna waatoohunna ojoorahunna bialmaAAroofi muhsanatin ghayra masafihatin wala muttakhithati akhdanin faitha ohsinna fain atayna bifahishatin faAAalayhinna nisfu ma AAala almuhsanati mina alAAathabi thalika liman khashiya alAAanata minkum waan tasbiroo khayrun lakum waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yureedu Allahu liyubayyina lakum wayahdiyakum sunana allatheena min qablikum wayatooba AAalaykum waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaAllahu yureedu an yatooba AAalaykum wayureedu allatheena yattabiAAoona alshshahawati an tameeloo maylan AAatheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yureedu Allahu an yukhaffifa AAankum wakhuliqa alinsanu daAAeefan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la takuloo amwalakum baynakum bialbatili illa an takoona tijaratan AAan taradin minkum wala taqtuloo anfusakum inna Allaha kana bikum raheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waman yafAAal thalika AAudwanan wathulman fasawfa nusleehi naran wakana thalika AAala Allahi yaseeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{In tajtaniboo kabaira ma tunhawna AAanhu nukaffir AAankum sayyiatikum wanudkhilkum mudkhalan kareeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala tatamannaw ma faddala Allahu bihi baAAdakum AAala baAAdin lilrrijali naseebun mimma iktasaboo walilnnisai naseebun mimma iktasabna waisaloo Allaha min fadlihi inna Allaha kana bikulli shayin AAaleeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walikullin jaAAalna mawaliya mimma taraka alwalidani waalaqraboona waallatheena AAaqadat aymanukum faatoohum naseebahum inna Allaha kana AAala kulli shayin shaheedan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alrrijalu qawwamoona AAala alnnisai bima faddala Allahu baAAdahum AAala baAAdin wabima anfaqoo min amwalihim faalssalihatu qanitatun hafithatun lilghaybi bima hafitha Allahu waallatee takhafoona nushoozahunna faAAithoohunna waohjuroohunna fee almadajiAAi waidriboohunna fain ataAAnakum fala tabghoo AAalayhinna sabeelan inna Allaha kana AAaliyyan kabeeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain khiftum shiqaqa baynihima faibAAathoo hakaman min ahlihi wahakaman min ahliha in yureeda islahan yuwaffiqi Allahu baynahuma inna Allaha kana AAaleeman khabeeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaoAAbudoo Allaha wala tushrikoo bihi shayan wabialwalidayni ihsanan wabithee alqurba waalyatama waalmasakeeni waaljari thee alqurba waaljari aljunubi waalssahibi bialjanbi waibni alssabeeli wama malakat aymanukum inna Allaha la yuhibbu man kana mukhtalan fakhooran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena yabkhaloona wayamuroona alnnasa bialbukhli wayaktumoona ma atahumu Allahu min fadlihi waaAAtadna lilkafireena AAathaban muheenan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena yunfiqoona amwalahum riaa alnnasi wala yuminoona biAllahi wala bialyawmi alakhiri waman yakuni alshshaytanu lahu qareenan fasaa qareenan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wamatha AAalayhim law amanoo biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri waanfaqoo mimma razaqahumu Allahu wakana Allahu bihim AAaleeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna Allaha la yathlimu mithqala tharratin wain taku hasanatan yudaAAifha wayuti min ladunhu ajran AAatheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fakayfa itha jina min kulli ommatin bishaheedin wajina bika AAala haolai shaheedan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yawmaithin yawaddu allatheena kafaroo waAAasawoo alrrasoola law tusawwa bihimu alardu wala yaktumoona Allaha hadeethan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la taqraboo alssalata waantum sukara hatta taAAlamoo ma taqooloona wala junuban illa AAabiree sabeelin hatta taghtasiloo wain kuntum marda aw AAala safarin aw jaa ahadun minkum mina alghaiti aw lamastumu alnnisaa falam tajidoo maan fatayammamoo saAAeedan tayyiban faimsahoo biwujoohikum waaydeekum inna Allaha kana AAafuwwan ghafooran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alam tara ila allatheena ootoo naseeban mina alkitabi yashtaroona alddalalata wayureedoona an tadilloo alssabeela}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaAllahu aAAlamu biaAAdaikum wakafa biAllahi waliyyan wakafa biAllahi naseeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Mina allatheena hadoo yuharrifoona alkalima AAan mawadiAAihi wayaqooloona samiAAna waAAasayna waismaAA ghayra musmaAAin waraAAina layyan bialsinatihim wataAAnan fee alddeeni walaw annahum qaloo samiAAna waataAAna waismaAA waonthurna lakana khayran lahum waaqwama walakin laAAanahumu Allahu bikufrihim fala yuminoona illa qaleelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena ootoo alkitaba aminoo bima nazzalna musaddiqan lima maAAakum min qabli an natmisa wujoohan fanaruddaha AAala adbariha aw nalAAanahum kama laAAanna ashaba alssabti wakana amru Allahi mafAAoolan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna Allaha la yaghfiru an yushraka bihi wayaghfiru ma doona thalika liman yashao waman yushrik biAllahi faqadi iftara ithman AAatheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alam tara ila allatheena yuzakkoona anfusahum bali Allahu yuzakkee man yashao wala yuthlamoona fateelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Onthur kayfa yaftaroona AAala Allahi alkathiba wakafa bihi ithman mubeenan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alam tara ila allatheena ootoo naseeban mina alkitabi yuminoona bialjibti waalttaghooti wayaqooloona lillatheena kafaroo haolai ahda mina allatheena amanoo sabeelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Olaika allatheena laAAanahumu Allahu waman yalAAani Allahu falan tajida lahu naseeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Am lahum naseebun mina almulki faithan la yutoona alnnasa naqeeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Am yahsudoona alnnasa AAala ma atahumu Allahu min fadlihi faqad atayna ala ibraheema alkitaba waalhikmata waataynahum mulkan AAatheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faminhum man amana bihi waminhum man sadda AAanhu wakafa bijahannama saAAeeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena kafaroo biayatina sawfa nusleehim naran kullama nadijat julooduhum baddalnahum juloodan ghayraha liyathooqoo alAAathaba inna Allaha kana AAazeezan hakeeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati sanudkhiluhum jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha abadan lahum feeha azwajun mutahharatun wanudkhiluhum thillan thaleelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna Allaha yamurukum an tuaddoo alamanati ila ahliha waitha hakamtum bayna alnnasi an tahkumoo bialAAadli inna Allaha niAAimma yaAAithukum bihi inna Allaha kana sameeAAan baseeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ateeAAoo Allaha waateeAAoo alrrasoola waolee alamri minkum fain tanazaAAtum fee shayin faruddoohu ila Allahi waalrrasooli in kuntum tuminoona biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri thalika khayrun waahsanu taweelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alam tara ila allatheena yazAAumoona annahum amanoo bima onzila ilayka wama onzila min qablika yureedoona an yatahakamoo ila alttaghooti waqad omiroo an yakfuroo bihi wayureedu alshshaytanu an yudillahum dalalan baAAeedan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha qeela lahum taAAalaw ila ma anzala Allahu waila alrrasooli raayta almunafiqeena yasuddoona AAanka sudoodan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fakayfa itha asabathum museebatun bima qaddamat aydeehim thumma jaooka yahlifoona biAllahi in aradna illa ihsanan watawfeeqan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Olaika allatheena yaAAlamu Allahu ma fee quloobihim faaAArid AAanhum waAAithhum waqul lahum fee anfusihim qawlan baleeghan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama arsalna min rasoolin illa liyutaAAa biithni Allahi walaw annahum ith thalamoo anfusahum jaooka faistaghfaroo Allaha waistaghfara lahumu alrrasoolu lawajadoo Allaha tawwaban raheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fala warabbika la yuminoona hatta yuhakkimooka feema shajara baynahum thumma la yajidoo fee anfusihim harajan mimma qadayta wayusallimoo tasleeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaw anna katabna AAalayhim ani oqtuloo anfusakum awi okhrujoo min diyarikum ma faAAaloohu illa qaleelun minhum walaw annahum faAAaloo ma yooAAathoona bihi lakana khayran lahum waashadda tathbeetan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waithan laataynahum min ladunna ajran AAatheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walahadaynahum siratan mustaqeeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waman yutiAAi Allaha waalrrasoola faolaika maAAa allatheena anAAama Allahu AAalayhim mina alnnabiyyeena waalssiddeeqeena waalshshuhadai waalssaliheena wahasuna olaika rafeeqan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thalika alfadlu mina Allahi wakafa biAllahi AAaleeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo khuthoo hithrakum fainfiroo thubatin awi infiroo jameeAAan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wainna minkum laman layubattianna fain asabatkum museebatun qala qad anAAama Allahu AAalayya ith lam akun maAAahum shaheedan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walain asabakum fadlun mina Allahi layaqoolanna kaan lam takun baynakum wabaynahu mawaddatun ya laytanee kuntu maAAahum faafooza fawzan AAatheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Falyuqatil fee sabeeli Allahi allatheena yashroona alhayata alddunya bialakhirati waman yuqatil fee sabeeli Allahi fayuqtal aw yaghlib fasawfa nuteehi ajran AAatheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama lakum la tuqatiloona fee sabeeli Allahi waalmustadAAafeena mina alrrijali waalnnisai waalwildani allatheena yaqooloona rabbana akhrijna min hathihi alqaryati alththalimi ahluha waijAAal lana min ladunka waliyyan waijAAal lana min ladunka naseeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena amanoo yuqatiloona fee sabeeli Allahi waallatheena kafaroo yuqatiloona fee sabeeli alttaghooti faqatiloo awliyaa alshshaytani inna kayda alshshaytani kana daAAeefan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alam tara ila allatheena qeela lahum kuffoo aydiyakum waaqeemoo alssalata waatoo alzzakata falamma kutiba AAalayhimu alqitalu itha fareequn minhum yakhshawna alnnasa kakhashyati Allahi aw ashadda khashyatan waqaloo rabbana lima katabta AAalayna alqitala lawla akhkhartana ila ajalin qareebin qul mataAAu alddunya qaleelun waalakhiratu khayrun limani ittaqa wala tuthlamoona fateelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Aynama takoonoo yudrikkumu almawtu walaw kuntum fee buroojin mushayyadatin wain tusibhum hasanatun yaqooloo hathihi min AAindi Allahi wain tusibhum sayyiatun yaqooloo hathihi min AAindika qul kullun min AAindi Allahi famali haolai alqawmi la yakadoona yafqahoona hadeethan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ma asabaka min hasanatin famina Allahi wama asabaka min sayyiatin famin nafsika waarsalnaka lilnnasi rasoolan wakafa biAllahi shaheedan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Man yutiAAi alrrasoola faqad ataAAa Allaha waman tawalla fama arsalnaka AAalayhim hafeethan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wayaqooloona taAAatun faitha barazoo min AAindika bayyata taifatun minhum ghayra allathee taqoolu waAllahu yaktubu ma yubayyitoona faaAArid AAanhum watawakkal AAala Allahi wakafa biAllahi wakeelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Afala yatadabbaroona alqurana walaw kana min AAindi ghayri Allahi lawajadoo feehi ikhtilafan katheeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha jaahum amrun mina alamni awi alkhawfi athaAAoo bihi walaw raddoohu ila alrrasooli waila olee alamri minhum laAAalimahu allatheena yastanbitoonahu minhum walawla fadlu Allahi AAalaykum warahmatuhu laittabaAAtumu alshshaytana illa qaleelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faqatil fee sabeeli Allahi la tukallafu illa nafsaka waharridi almumineena AAasa Allahu an yakuffa basa allatheena kafaroo waAllahu ashaddu basan waashaddu tankeelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Man yashfaAA shafaAAatan hasanatan yakun lahu naseebun minha waman yashfaAA shafaAAatan sayyiatan yakun lahu kiflun minha wakana Allahu AAala kulli shayin muqeetan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][86]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha huyyeetum bitahiyyatin fahayyoo biahsana minha aw ruddooha inna Allaha kana AAala kulli shayin haseeban}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allahu la ilaha illa huwa layajmaAAannakum ila yawmi alqiyamati la rayba feehi waman asdaqu mina Allahi hadeethan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fama lakum fee almunafiqeena fiatayni waAllahu arkasahum bima kasaboo atureedoona an tahdoo man adalla Allahu waman yudlili Allahu falan tajida lahu sabeelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][89]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waddoo law takfuroona kama kafaroo fatakoonoona sawaan fala tattakhithoo minhum awliyaa hatta yuhajiroo fee sabeeli Allahi fain tawallaw fakhuthoohum waoqtuloohum haythu wajadtumoohum wala tattakhithoo minhum waliyyan wala naseeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][90]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Illa allatheena yasiloona ila qawmin baynakum wabaynahum meethaqun aw jaookum hasirat sudooruhum an yuqatilookum aw yuqatiloo qawmahum walaw shaa Allahu lasallatahum AAalaykum falaqatalookum faini iAAtazalookum falam yuqatilookum waalqaw ilaykumu alssalama fama jaAAala Allahu lakum AAalayhim sabeelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][91]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Satajidoona akhareena yureedoona an yamanookum wayamanoo qawmahum kulla ma ruddoo ila alfitnati orkisoo feeha fain lam yaAAtazilookum wayulqoo ilaykumu alssalama wayakuffoo aydiyahum fakhuthoohum waoqtuloohum haythu thaqiftumoohum waolaikum jaAAalna lakum AAalayhim sultanan mubeenan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][92]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama kana limuminin an yaqtula muminan illa khataan waman qatala muminan khataan fatahreeru raqabatin muminatin wadiyatun musallamatun ila ahlihi illa an yassaddaqoo fain kana min qawmin AAaduwwin lakum wahuwa muminun fatahreeru raqabatin muminatin wain kana min qawmin baynakum wabaynahum meethaqun fadiyatun musallamatun ila ahlihi watahreeru raqabatin muminatin faman lam yajid fasiyamu shahrayni mutatabiAAayni tawbatan mina Allahi wakana Allahu AAaleeman hakeeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][93]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waman yaqtul muminan mutaAAammidan fajazaohu jahannamu khalidan feeha waghadiba Allahu AAalayhi walaAAanahu waaAAadda lahu AAathaban AAatheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][94]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha darabtum fee sabeeli Allahi fatabayyanoo wala taqooloo liman alqa ilaykumu alssalama lasta muminan tabtaghoona AAarada alhayati alddunya faAAinda Allahi maghanimu katheeratun kathalika kuntum min qablu famanna Allahu AAalaykum fatabayyanoo inna Allaha kana bima taAAmaloona khabeeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][95]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{La yastawee alqaAAidoona mina almumineena ghayru olee alddarari waalmujahidoona fee sabeeli Allahi biamwalihim waanfusihim faddala Allahu almujahideena biamwalihim waanfusihim AAala alqaAAideena darajatan wakullan waAAada Allahu alhusna wafaddala Allahu almujahideena AAala alqaAAideena ajran AAatheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][96]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Darajatin minhu wamaghfiratan warahmatan wakana Allahu ghafooran raheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][97]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena tawaffahumu almalaikatu thalimee anfusihim qaloo feema kuntum qaloo kunna mustadAAafeena fee alardi qaloo alam takun ardu Allahi wasiAAatan fatuhajiroo feeha faolaika mawahum jahannamu wasaat maseeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][98]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Illa almustadAAafeena mina alrrijali waalnnisai waalwildani la yastateeAAoona heelatan wala yahtadoona sabeelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][99]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faolaika AAasa Allahu an yaAAfuwa AAanhum wakana Allahu AAafuwwan ghafooran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][100]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waman yuhajir fee sabeeli Allahi yajid fee alardi muraghaman katheeran wasaAAatan waman yakhruj min baytihi muhajiran ila Allahi warasoolihi thumma yudrikhu almawtu faqad waqaAAa ajruhu AAala Allahi wakana Allahu ghafooran raheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][101]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha darabtum fee alardi falaysa AAalaykum junahun an taqsuroo mina alssalati in khiftum an yaftinakumu allatheena kafaroo inna alkafireena kanoo lakum AAaduwwan mubeenan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][102]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha kunta feehim faaqamta lahumu alssalata faltaqum taifatun minhum maAAaka walyakhuthoo aslihatahum faitha sajadoo falyakoonoo min waraikum waltati taifatun okhra lam yusalloo falyusalloo maAAaka walyakhuthoo hithrahum waaslihatahum wadda allatheena kafaroo law taghfuloona AAan aslihatikum waamtiAAatikum fayameeloona AAalaykum maylatan wahidatan wala junaha AAalaykum in kana bikum athan min matarin aw kuntum marda an tadaAAoo aslihatakum wakhuthoo hithrakum inna Allaha aAAadda lilkafireena AAathaban muheenan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][103]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faitha qadaytumu alssalata faothkuroo Allaha qiyaman waquAAoodan waAAala junoobikum faitha itmanantum faaqeemoo alssalata inna alssalata kanat AAala almumineena kitaban mawqootan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][104]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala tahinoo fee ibtighai alqawmi in takoonoo talamoona fainnahum yalamoona kama talamoona watarjoona mina Allahi ma la yarjoona wakana Allahu AAaleeman hakeeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][105]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna anzalna ilayka alkitaba bialhaqqi litahkuma bayna alnnasi bima araka Allahu wala takun lilkhaineena khaseeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][106]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waistaghfiri Allaha inna Allaha kana ghafooran raheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][107]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala tujadil AAani allatheena yakhtanoona anfusahum inna Allaha la yuhibbu man kana khawwanan atheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][108]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yastakhfoona mina alnnasi wala yastakhfoona mina Allahi wahuwa maAAahum ith yubayyitoona ma la yarda mina alqawli wakana Allahu bima yaAAmaloona muheetan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][109]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Haantum haolai jadaltum AAanhum fee alhayati alddunya faman yujadilu Allaha AAanhum yawma alqiyamati am man yakoonu AAalayhim wakeelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][110]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waman yaAAmal sooan aw yathlim nafsahu thumma yastaghfiri Allaha yajidi Allaha ghafooran raheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][111]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waman yaksib ithman fainnama yaksibuhu AAala nafsihi wakana Allahu AAaleeman hakeeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][112]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waman yaksib khateeatan aw ithman thumma yarmi bihi bareean faqadi ihtamala buhtanan waithman mubeenan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][113]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walawla fadlu Allahi AAalayka warahmatuhu lahammat taifatun minhum an yudillooka wama yudilloona illa anfusahum wama yadurroonaka min shayin waanzala Allahu AAalayka alkitaba waalhikmata waAAallamaka ma lam takun taAAlamu wakana fadlu Allahi AAalayka AAatheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][114]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{La khayra fee katheerin min najwahum illa man amara bisadaqatin aw maAAroofin aw islahin bayna alnnasi waman yafAAal thalika ibtighaa mardati Allahi fasawfa nuteehi ajran AAatheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][115]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waman yushaqiqi alrrasoola min baAAdi ma tabayyana lahu alhuda wayattabiAA ghayra sabeeli almumineena nuwallihi ma tawalla wanuslihi jahannama wasaat maseeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][116]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna Allaha la yaghfiru an yushraka bihi wayaghfiru ma doona thalika liman yashao waman yushrik biAllahi faqad dalla dalalan baAAeedan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][117]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{In yadAAoona min doonihi illa inathan wain yadAAoona illa shaytanan mareedan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][118]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{LaAAanahu Allahu waqala laattakhithanna min AAibadika naseeban mafroodan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][119]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaodillannahum walaomanniyannahum walaamurannahum falayubattikunna athana alanAAami walaamurannahum falayughayyirunna khalqa Allahi waman yattakhithi alshshaytana waliyyan min dooni Allahi faqad khasira khusranan mubeenan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][120]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{YaAAiduhum wayumanneehim wama yaAAiduhumu alshshaytanu illa ghurooran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][121]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Olaika mawahum jahannamu wala yajidoona AAanha maheesan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][122]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati sanudkhiluhum jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha abadan waAAda Allahi haqqan waman asdaqu mina Allahi qeelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][123]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Laysa biamaniyyikum wala amaniyyi ahli alkitabi man yaAAmal sooan yujza bihi wala yajid lahu min dooni Allahi waliyyan wala naseeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][124]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waman yaAAmal mina alssalihati min thakarin aw ontha wahuwa muminun faolaika yadkhuloona aljannata wala yuthlamoona naqeeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][125]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waman ahsanu deenan mimman aslama wajhahu lillahi wahuwa muhsinun waittabaAAa millata ibraheema haneefan waittakhatha Allahu ibraheema khaleelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][126]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wakana Allahu bikulli shayin muheetan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][127]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wayastaftoonaka fee alnnisai quli Allahu yufteekum feehinna wama yutla AAalaykum fee alkitabi fee yatama alnnisai allatee la tutoonahunna ma kutiba lahunna watarghaboona an tankihoohunna waalmustadAAafeena mina alwildani waan taqoomoo lilyatama bialqisti wama tafAAaloo min khayrin fainna Allaha kana bihi AAaleeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][128]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waini imraatun khafat min baAAliha nushoozan aw iAAradan fala junaha AAalayhima an yusliha baynahuma sulhan waalssulhu khayrun waohdirati alanfusu alshshuhha wain tuhsinoo watattaqoo fainna Allaha kana bima taAAmaloona khabeeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][129]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walan tastateeAAoo an taAAdiloo bayna alnnisai walaw harastum fala tameeloo kulla almayli fatatharooha kaalmuAAallaqati wain tuslihoo watattaqoo fainna Allaha kana ghafooran raheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][130]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain yatafarraqa yughni Allahu kullan min saAAatihi wakana Allahu wasiAAan hakeeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][131]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi walaqad wassayna allatheena ootoo alkitaba min qablikum waiyyakum ani ittaqoo Allaha wain takfuroo fainna lillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wakana Allahu ghaniyyan hameedan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][132]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wakafa biAllahi wakeelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][133]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{In yasha yuthhibkum ayyuha alnnasu wayati biakhareena wakana Allahu AAala thalika qadeeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][134]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Man kana yureedu thawaba alddunya faAAinda Allahi thawabu alddunya waalakhirati wakana Allahu sameeAAan baseeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][135]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo koonoo qawwameena bialqisti shuhadaa lillahi walaw AAala anfusikum awi alwalidayni waalaqrabeena in yakun ghaniyyan aw faqeeran faAllahu awla bihima fala tattabiAAoo alhawa an taAAdiloo wain talwoo aw tuAAridoo fainna Allaha kana bima taAAmaloona khabeeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][136]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo aminoo biAllahi warasoolihi waalkitabi allathee nazzala AAala rasoolihi waalkitabi allathee anzala min qablu waman yakfur biAllahi wamalaikatihi wakutubihi warusulihi waalyawmi alakhiri faqad dalla dalalan baAAeedan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][137]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena amanoo thumma kafaroo thumma amanoo thumma kafaroo thumma izdadoo kufran lam yakuni Allahu liyaghfira lahum wala liyahdiyahum sabeelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][138]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Bashshiri almunafiqeena bianna lahum AAathaban aleeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][139]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena yattakhithoona alkafireena awliyaa min dooni almumineena ayabtaghoona AAindahumu alAAizzata fainna alAAizzata lillahi jameeAAan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][140]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqad nazzala AAalaykum fee alkitabi an itha samiAAtum ayati Allahi yukfaru biha wayustahzao biha fala taqAAudoo maAAahum hatta yakhoodoo fee hadeethin ghayrihi innakum ithan mithluhum inna Allaha jamiAAu almunafiqeena waalkafireena fee jahannama jameeAAan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][141]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena yatarabbasoona bikum fain kana lakum fathun mina Allahi qaloo alam nakun maAAakum wain kana lilkafireena naseebun qaloo alam nastahwith AAalaykum wanamnaAAkum mina almumineena faAllahu yahkumu baynakum yawma alqiyamati walan yajAAala Allahu lilkafireena AAala almumineena sabeelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][142]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna almunafiqeena yukhadiAAoona Allaha wahuwa khadiAAuhum waitha qamoo ila alssalati qamoo kusala yuraoona alnnasa wala yathkuroona Allaha illa qaleelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][143]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Muthabthabeena bayna thalika la ila haolai wala ila haolai waman yudlili Allahu falan tajida lahu sabeelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][144]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tattakhithoo alkafireena awliyaa min dooni almumineena atureedoona an tajAAaloo lillahi AAalaykum sultanan mubeenan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][145]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna almunafiqeena fee alddarki alasfali mina alnnari walan tajida lahum naseeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][146]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Illa allatheena taboo waaslahoo waiAAtasamoo biAllahi waakhlasoo deenahum lillahi faolaika maAAa almumineena wasawfa yuti Allahu almumineena ajran AAatheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][147]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ma yafAAalu Allahu biAAathabikum in shakartum waamantum wakana Allahu shakiran AAaleeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][148]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{La yuhibbu Allahu aljahra bialssooi mina alqawli illa man thulima wakana Allahu sameeAAan AAaleeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][149]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{In tubdoo khayran aw tukhfoohu aw taAAfoo AAan sooin fainna Allaha kana AAafuwwan qadeeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][150]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena yakfuroona biAllahi warusulihi wayureedoona an yufarriqoo bayna Allahi warusulihi wayaqooloona numinu bibaAAdin wanakfuru bibaAAdin wayureedoona an yattakhithoo bayna thalika sabeelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][151]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Olaika humu alkafiroona haqqan waaAAtadna lilkafireena AAathaban muheenan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][152]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena amanoo biAllahi warusulihi walam yufarriqoo bayna ahadin minhum olaika sawfa yuteehim ojoorahum wakana Allahu ghafooran raheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][153]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yasaluka ahlu alkitabi an tunazzila AAalayhim kitaban mina alssamai faqad saaloo moosa akbara min thalika faqaloo arina Allaha jahratan faakhathathumu alssaAAiqatu bithulmihim thumma ittakhathoo alAAijla min baAAdi ma jaathumu albayyinatu faAAafawna AAan thalika waatayna moosa sultanan mubeenan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][154]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WarafaAAna fawqahumu alttoora bimeethaqihim waqulna lahumu odkhuloo albaba sujjadan waqulna lahum la taAAdoo fee alssabti waakhathna minhum meethaqan ghaleethan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][155]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fabima naqdihim meethaqahum wakufrihim biayati Allahi waqatlihimu alanbiyaa bighayri haqqin waqawlihim quloobuna ghulfun bal tabaAAa Allahu AAalayha bikufrihim fala yuminoona illa qaleelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][156]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wabikufrihim waqawlihim AAala maryama buhtanan AAatheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][157]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqawlihim inna qatalna almaseeha AAeesa ibna maryama rasoola Allahi wama qataloohu wama salaboohu walakin shubbiha lahum wainna allatheena ikhtalafoo feehi lafee shakkin minhu ma lahum bihi min AAilmin illa ittibaAAa alththanni wama qataloohu yaqeenan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][158]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Bal rafaAAahu Allahu ilayhi wakana Allahu AAazeezan hakeeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][159]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain min ahli alkitabi illa layuminanna bihi qabla mawtihi wayawma alqiyamati yakoonu AAalayhim shaheedan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][160]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fabithulmin mina allatheena hadoo harramna AAalayhim tayyibatin ohillat lahum wabisaddihim AAan sabeeli Allahi katheeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][161]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waakhthihimu alrriba waqad nuhoo AAanhu waaklihim amwala alnnasi bialbatili waaAAtadna lilkafireena minhum AAathaban aleeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][162]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lakini alrrasikhoona fee alAAilmi minhum waalmuminoona yuminoona bima onzila ilayka wama onzila min qablika waalmuqeemeena alssalata waalmutoona alzzakata waalmuminoona biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri olaika sanuteehim ajran AAatheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][163]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna awhayna ilayka kama awhayna ila noohin waalnnabiyyeena min baAAdihi waawhayna ila ibraheema waismaAAeela waishaqa wayaAAqooba waalasbati waAAeesa waayyooba wayoonusa waharoona wasulaymana waatayna dawooda zabooran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][164]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Warusulan qad qasasnahum AAalayka min qablu warusulan lam naqsushum AAalayka wakallama Allahu moosa takleeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][165]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Rusulan mubashshireena wamunthireena lialla yakoona lilnnasi AAala Allahi hujjatun baAAda alrrusuli wakana Allahu AAazeezan hakeeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][166]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lakini Allahu yashhadu bima anzala ilayka anzalahu biAAilmihi waalmalaikatu yashhadoona wakafa biAllahi shaheedan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][167]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena kafaroo wasaddoo AAan sabeeli Allahi qad dalloo dalalan baAAeedan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][168]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena kafaroo wathalamoo lam yakuni Allahu liyaghfira lahum wala liyahdiyahum tareeqan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][169]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Illa tareeqa jahannama khalideena feeha abadan wakana thalika AAala Allahi yaseeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][170]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha alnnasu qad jaakumu alrrasoolu bialhaqqi min rabbikum faaminoo khayran lakum wain takfuroo fainna lillahi ma fee alssamawati waalardi wakana Allahu AAaleeman hakeeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][171]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ahla alkitabi la taghloo fee deenikum wala taqooloo AAala Allahi illa alhaqqa innama almaseehu AAeesa ibnu maryama rasoolu Allahi wakalimatuhu alqaha ila maryama waroohun minhu faaminoo biAllahi warusulihi wala taqooloo thalathatun intahoo khayran lakum innama Allahu ilahun wahidun subhanahu an yakoona lahu waladun lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wakafa biAllahi wakeelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][172]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lan yastankifa almaseehu an yakoona AAabdan lillahi wala almalaikatu almuqarraboona waman yastankif AAan AAibadatihi wayastakbir fasayahshuruhum ilayhi jameeAAan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][173]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faamma allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati fayuwaffeehim ojoorahum wayazeeduhum min fadlihi waamma allatheena istankafoo waistakbaroo fayuAAaththibuhum AAathaban aleeman wala yajidoona lahum min dooni Allahi waliyyan wala naseeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][174]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha alnnasu qad jaakum burhanun min rabbikum waanzalna ilaykum nooran mubeenan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][175]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faamma allatheena amanoo biAllahi waiAAtasamoo bihi fasayudkhiluhum fee rahmatin minhu wafadlin wayahdeehim ilayhi siratan mustaqeeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[4][176]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yastaftoonaka quli Allahu yufteekum fee alkalalati ini imruon halaka laysa lahu waladun walahu okhtun falaha nisfu ma taraka wahuwa yarithuha in lam yakun laha waladun fain kanata ithnatayni falahuma alththuluthani mimma taraka wain kanoo ikhwatan rijalan wanisaan falilththakari mithlu haththi alonthayayni yubayyinu Allahu lakum an tadilloo waAllahu bikulli shayin AAaleemun}
\chapter{Al-Ma'idah (The Food)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo awfoo bialAAuqoodi ohillat lakum baheematu alanAAami illa ma yutla AAalaykum ghayra muhillee alssaydi waantum hurumun inna Allaha yahkumu ma yureedu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tuhilloo shaAAaira Allahi wala alshshahra alharama wala alhadya wala alqalaida wala ammeena albayta alharama yabtaghoona fadlan min rabbihim waridwanan waitha halaltum faistadoo wala yajrimannakum shanaanu qawmin an saddookum AAani almasjidi alharami an taAAtadoo wataAAawanoo AAala albirri waalttaqwa wala taAAawanoo AAala alithmi waalAAudwani waittaqoo Allaha inna Allaha shadeedu alAAiqabi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Hurrimat AAalaykumu almaytatu waalddamu walahmu alkhinzeeri wama ohilla lighayri Allahi bihi waalmunkhaniqatu waalmawqoothatu waalmutaraddiyatu waalnnateehatu wama akala alssabuAAu illa ma thakkaytum wama thubiha AAala alnnusubi waan tastaqsimoo bialazlami thalikum fisqun alyawma yaisa allatheena kafaroo min deenikum fala takhshawhum waikhshawni alyawma akmaltu lakum deenakum waatmamtu AAalaykum niAAmatee waradeetu lakumu alislama deenan famani idturra fee makhmasatin ghayra mutajanifin liithmin fainna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yasaloonaka matha ohilla lahum qul ohilla lakumu alttayyibatu wama AAallamtum mina aljawarihi mukallibeena tuAAallimoonahunna mimma AAallamakumu Allahu fakuloo mimma amsakna AAalaykum waothkuroo isma Allahi AAalayhi waittaqoo Allaha inna Allaha sareeAAu alhisabi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alyawma ohilla lakumu alttayyibatu wataAAamu allatheena ootoo alkitaba hillun lakum wataAAamukum hillun lahum waalmuhsanatu mina almuminati waalmuhsanatu mina allatheena ootoo alkitaba min qablikum itha ataytumoohunna ojoorahunna muhsineena ghayra musafiheena wala muttakhithee akhdanin waman yakfur bialeemani faqad habita AAamaluhu wahuwa fee alakhirati mina alkhasireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha qumtum ila alssalati faighsiloo wujoohakum waaydiyakum ila almarafiqi waimsahoo biruoosikum waarjulakum ila alkaAAbayni wain kuntum junuban faittahharoo wain kuntum marda aw AAala safarin aw jaa ahadun minkum mina alghaiti aw lamastumu alnnisaa falam tajidoo maan fatayammamoo saAAeedan tayyiban faimsahoo biwujoohikum waaydeekum minhu ma yureedu Allahu liyajAAala AAalaykum min harajin walakin yureedu liyutahhirakum waliyutimma niAAmatahu AAalaykum laAAallakum tashkuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waothkuroo niAAmata Allahi AAalaykum wameethaqahu allathee wathaqakum bihi ith qultum samiAAna waataAAna waittaqoo Allaha inna Allaha AAaleemun bithati alssudoori}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo koonoo qawwameena lillahi shuhadaa bialqisti wala yajrimannakum shanaanu qawmin AAala alla taAAdiloo iAAdiloo huwa aqrabu lilttaqwa waittaqoo Allaha inna Allaha khabeerun bima taAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaAAada Allahu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum maghfiratun waajrun AAatheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biayatina olaika ashabu aljaheemi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo othkuroo niAAmata Allahi AAalaykum ith hamma qawmun an yabsutoo ilaykum aydiyahum fakaffa aydiyahum AAankum waittaqoo Allaha waAAala Allahi falyatawakkali almuminoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaqad akhatha Allahu meethaqa banee israeela wabaAAathna minhumu ithnay AAashara naqeeban waqala Allahu innee maAAakum lain aqamtumu alssalata waataytumu alzzakata waamantum birusulee waAAazzartumoohum waaqradtumu Allaha qardan hasanan laokaffiranna AAankum sayyiatikum walaodkhilannakum jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu faman kafara baAAda thalika minkum faqad dalla sawaa alssabeeli}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fabima naqdihim meethaqahum laAAannahum wajaAAalna quloobahum qasiyatan yuharrifoona alkalima AAan mawadiAAihi wanasoo haththan mimma thukkiroo bihi wala tazalu tattaliAAu AAala khainatin minhum illa qaleelan minhum faoAAfu AAanhum waisfah inna Allaha yuhibbu almuhsineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wamina allatheena qaloo inna nasara akhathna meethaqahum fanasoo haththan mimma thukkiroo bihi faaghrayna baynahumu alAAadawata waalbaghdaa ila yawmi alqiyamati wasawfa yunabbiohumu Allahu bima kanoo yasnaAAoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
