\quranayah[5][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ahla alkitabi qad jaakum rasooluna yubayyinu lakum katheeran mimma kuntum tukhfoona mina alkitabi wayaAAfoo AAan katheerin qad jaakum mina Allahi noorun wakitabun mubeenun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yahdee bihi Allahu mani ittabaAAa ridwanahu subula alssalami wayukhrijuhum mina alththulumati ila alnnoori biithnihi wayahdeehim ila siratin mustaqeemin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Laqad kafara allatheena qaloo inna Allaha huwa almaseehu ibnu maryama qul faman yamliku mina Allahi shayan in arada an yuhlika almaseeha ibna maryama waommahu waman fee alardi jameeAAan walillahi mulku alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma yakhluqu ma yashao waAllahu AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqalati alyahoodu waalnnasara nahnu abnao Allahi waahibbaohu qul falima yuAAaththibukum bithunoobikum bal antum basharun mimman khalaqa yaghfiru liman yashao wayuAAaththibu man yashao walillahi mulku alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma wailayhi almaseeru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ahla alkitabi qad jaakum rasooluna yubayyinu lakum AAala fatratin mina alrrusuli an taqooloo ma jaana min basheerin wala natheerin faqad jaakum basheerun wanatheerun waAllahu AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith qala moosa liqawmihi ya qawmi othkuroo niAAmata Allahi AAalaykum ith jaAAala feekum anbiyaa wajaAAalakum mulookan waatakum ma lam yuti ahadan mina alAAalameena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya qawmi odkhuloo alarda almuqaddasata allatee kataba Allahu lakum wala tartaddoo AAala adbarikum fatanqaliboo khasireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qaloo ya moosa inna feeha qawman jabbareena wainna lan nadkhulaha hatta yakhrujoo minha fain yakhrujoo minha fainna dakhiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qala rajulani mina allatheena yakhafoona anAAama Allahu AAalayhima odkhuloo AAalayhimu albaba faitha dakhaltumoohu fainnakum ghaliboona waAAala Allahi fatawakkaloo in kuntum mumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qaloo ya moosa inna lan nadkhulaha abadan ma damoo feeha faithhab anta warabbuka faqatila inna hahuna qaAAidoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qala rabbi innee la amliku illa nafsee waakhee faofruq baynana wabayna alqawmi alfasiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qala fainnaha muharramatun AAalayhim arbaAAeena sanatan yateehoona fee alardi fala tasa AAala alqawmi alfasiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waotlu AAalayhim nabaa ibnay adama bialhaqqi ith qarraba qurbanan fatuqubbila min ahadihima walam yutaqabbal mina alakhari qala laaqtulannaka qala innama yataqabbalu Allahu mina almuttaqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lain basatta ilayya yadaka litaqtulanee ma ana bibasitin yadiya ilayka liaqtulaka innee akhafu Allaha rabba alAAalameena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Innee oreedu an tabooa biithmee waithmika fatakoona min ashabi alnnari wathalika jazao alththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{FatawwaAAat lahu nafsuhu qatla akheehi faqatalahu faasbaha mina alkhasireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{FabaAAatha Allahu ghuraban yabhathu fee alardi liyuriyahu kayfa yuwaree sawata akheehi qala ya waylata aAAajaztu an akoona mithla hatha alghurabi faowariya sawata akhee faasbaha mina alnnadimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Min ajli thalika katabna AAala banee israeela annahu man qatala nafsan bighayri nafsin aw fasadin fee alardi fakaannama qatala alnnasa jameeAAan waman ahyaha fakaannama ahya alnnasa jameeAAan walaqad jaa thum rusuluna bialbayyinati thumma inna katheeran minhum baAAda thalika fee alardi lamusrifoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Innama jazao allatheena yuhariboona Allaha warasoolahu wayasAAawna fee alardi fasadan an yuqattaloo aw yusallaboo aw tuqattaAAa aydeehim waarjuluhum min khilafin aw yunfaw mina alardi thalika lahum khizyun fee alddunya walahum fee alakhirati AAathabun AAatheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Illa allatheena taboo min qabli an taqdiroo AAalayhim faiAAlamoo anna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ittaqoo Allaha waibtaghoo ilayhi alwaseelata wajahidoo fee sabeelihi laAAallakum tuflihoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena kafaroo law anna lahum ma fee alardi jameeAAan wamithlahu maAAahu liyaftadoo bihi min AAathabi yawmi alqiyamati ma tuqubbila minhum walahum AAathabun aleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yureedoona an yakhrujoo mina alnnari wama hum bikharijeena minha walahum AAathabun muqeemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waalssariqu waalssariqatu faiqtaAAoo aydiyahuma jazaan bima kasaba nakalan mina Allahi waAllahu AAazeezun hakeemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faman taba min baAAdi thulmihi waaslaha fainna Allaha yatoobu AAalayhi inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alam taAAlam anna Allaha lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi yuAAaththibu man yashao wayaghfiru liman yashao waAllahu AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha alrrasoolu la yahzunka allatheena yusariAAoona fee alkufri mina allatheena qaloo amanna biafwahihim walam tumin quloobuhum wamina allatheena hadoo sammaAAoona lilkathibi sammaAAoona liqawmin akhareena lam yatooka yuharrifoona alkalima min baAAdi mawadiAAihi yaqooloona in ooteetum hatha fakhuthoohu wain lam tutawhu faihtharoo waman yuridi Allahu fitnatahu falan tamlika lahu mina Allahi shayan olaika allatheena lam yuridi Allahu an yutahhira quloobahum lahum fee alddunya khizyun walahum fee alakhirati AAathabun AAatheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{SammaAAoona lilkathibi akkaloona lilssuhti fain jaooka faohkum baynahum aw aAArid AAanhum wain tuAArid AAanhum falan yadurrooka shayan wain hakamta faohkum baynahum bialqisti inna Allaha yuhibbu almuqsiteena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wakayfa yuhakkimoonaka waAAindahumu alttawratu feeha hukmu Allahi thumma yatawallawna min baAAdi thalika wama olaika bialmumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna anzalna alttawrata feeha hudan wanoorun yahkumu biha alnnabiyyoona allatheena aslamoo lillatheena hadoo waalrrabbaniyyoona waalahbaru bima istuhfithoo min kitabi Allahi wakanoo AAalayhi shuhadaa fala takhshawoo alnnasa waikhshawni wala tashtaroo biayatee thamanan qaleelan waman lam yahkum bima anzala Allahu faolaika humu alkafiroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wakatabna AAalayhim feeha anna alnnafsa bialnnafsi waalAAayna bialAAayni waalanfa bialanfi waalothuna bialothuni waalssinna bialssinni waaljurooha qisasun faman tasaddaqa bihi fahuwa kaffaratun lahu waman lam yahkum bima anzala Allahu faolaika humu alththalimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqaffayna AAala atharihim biAAeesa ibni maryama musaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi mina alttawrati waataynahu alinjeela feehi hudan wanoorun wamusaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi mina alttawrati wahudan wamawAAithatan lilmuttaqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walyahkum ahlu alinjeeli bima anzala Allahu feehi waman lam yahkum bima anzala Allahu faolaika humu alfasiqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waanzalna ilayka alkitaba bialhaqqi musaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi mina alkitabi wamuhayminan AAalayhi faohkum baynahum bima anzala Allahu wala tattabiAA ahwaahum AAamma jaaka mina alhaqqi likullin jaAAalna minkum shirAAatan waminhajan walaw shaa Allahu lajaAAalakum ommatan wahidatan walakin liyabluwakum fee ma atakum faistabiqoo alkhayrati ila Allahi marjiAAukum jameeAAan fayunabbiokum bima kuntum feehi takhtalifoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waani ohkum baynahum bima anzala Allahu wala tattabiAA ahwaahum waihtharhum an yaftinooka AAan baAAdi ma anzala Allahu ilayka fain tawallaw faiAAlam annama yureedu Allahu an yuseebahum bibaAAdi thunoobihim wainna katheeran mina alnnasi lafasiqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Afahukma aljahiliyyati yabghoona waman ahsanu mina Allahu hukman liqawmin yooqinoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tattakhithoo alyahooda waalnnasara awliyaa baAAduhum awliyao baAAdin waman yatawallahum minkum fainnahu minhum inna Allaha la yahdee alqawma alththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fatara allatheena fee quloobihim maradun yusariAAoona feehim yaqooloona nakhsha an tuseebana dairatun faAAasa Allahu an yatiya bialfathi aw amrin min AAindihi fayusbihoo AAala ma asarroo fee anfusihim nadimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wayaqoolu allatheena amanoo ahaolai allatheena aqsamoo biAllahi jahda aymanihim innahum lamaAAakum habitat aAAmaluhum faasbahoo khasireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo man yartadda minkum AAan deenihi fasawfa yatee Allahu biqawmin yuhibbuhum wayuhibboonahu athillatin AAala almumineena aAAizzatin AAala alkafireena yujahidoona fee sabeeli Allahi wala yakhafoona lawmata laimin thalika fadlu Allahi yuteehi man yashao waAllahu wasiAAun AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Innama waliyyukumu Allahu warasooluhu waallatheena amanoo allatheena yuqeemoona alssalata wayutoona alzzakata wahum rakiAAoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waman yatawalla Allaha warasoolahu waallatheena amanoo fainna hizba Allahi humu alghaliboona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tattakhithoo allatheena ittakhathoo deenakum huzuwan walaAAiban mina allatheena ootoo alkitaba min qablikum waalkuffara awliyaa waittaqoo Allaha in kuntum mumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha nadaytum ila alssalati ittakhathooha huzuwan walaAAiban thalika biannahum qawmun la yaAAqiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul ya ahla alkitabi hal tanqimoona minna illa an amanna biAllahi wama onzila ilayna wama onzila min qablu waanna aktharakum fasiqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul hal onabbiokum bisharrin min thalika mathoobatan AAinda Allahi man laAAanahu Allahu waghadiba AAalayhi wajaAAala minhumu alqiradata waalkhanazeera waAAabada alttaghooti olaika sharrun makanan waadallu AAan sawai alssabeeli}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha jaookum qaloo amanna waqad dakhaloo bialkufri wahum qad kharajoo bihi waAllahu aAAlamu bima kanoo yaktumoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Watara katheeran minhum yusariAAoona fee alithmi waalAAudwani waaklihimu alssuhta labisa ma kanoo yaAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lawla yanhahumu alrrabbaniyyoona waalahbaru AAan qawlihimu alithma waaklihimu alssuhta labisa ma kanoo yasnaAAoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqalati alyahoodu yadu Allahi maghloolatun ghullat aydeehim waluAAinoo bima qaloo bal yadahu mabsootatani yunfiqu kayfa yashao walayazeedanna katheeran minhum ma onzila ilayka min rabbika tughyanan wakufran waalqayna baynahumu alAAadawata waalbaghdaa ila yawmi alqiyamati kullama awqadoo naran lilharbi atfaaha Allahu wayasAAawna fee alardi fasadan waAllahu la yuhibbu almufsideena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaw anna ahla alkitabi amanoo waittaqaw lakaffarna AAanhum sayyiatihim walaadkhalnahum jannati alnnaAAeemi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaw annahum aqamoo alttawrata waalinjeela wama onzila ilayhim min rabbihim laakaloo min fawqihim wamin tahti arjulihim minhum ommatun muqtasidatun wakatheerun minhum saa ma yaAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha alrrasoolu balligh ma onzila ilayka min rabbika wain lam tafAAal fama ballaghta risalatahu waAllahu yaAAsimuka mina alnnasi inna Allaha la yahdee alqawma alkafireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul ya ahla alkitabi lastum AAala shayin hatta tuqeemoo alttawrata waalinjeela wama onzila ilaykum min rabbikum walayazeedanna katheeran minhum ma onzila ilayka min rabbika tughyanan wakufran fala tasa AAala alqawmi alkafireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena amanoo waallatheena hadoo waalssabioona waalnnasara man amana biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri waAAamila salihan fala khawfun AAalayhim wala hum yahzanoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Laqad akhathna meethaqa banee israeela waarsalna ilayhim rusulan kullama jaahum rasoolun bima la tahwa anfusuhum fareeqan kaththaboo wafareeqan yaqtuloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wahasiboo alla takoona fitnatun faAAamoo wasammoo thumma taba Allahu AAalayhim thumma AAamoo wasammoo katheerun minhum waAllahu baseerun bima yaAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Laqad kafara allatheena qaloo inna Allaha huwa almaseehu ibnu maryama waqala almaseehu ya banee israeela oAAbudoo Allaha rabbee warabbakum innahu man yushrik biAllahi faqad harrama Allahu AAalayhi aljannata wamawahu alnnaru wama lilththalimeena min ansarin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Laqad kafara allatheena qaloo inna Allaha thalithu thalathatin wama min ilahin illa ilahun wahidun wain lam yantahoo AAamma yaqooloona layamassanna allatheena kafaroo minhum AAathabun aleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Afala yatooboona ila Allahi wayastaghfiroonahu waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ma almaseehu ibnu maryama illa rasoolun qad khalat min qablihi alrrusulu waommuhu siddeeqatun kana yakulani alttaAAama onthur kayfa nubayyinu lahumu alayati thumma onthur anna yufakoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul ataAAbudoona min dooni Allahi ma la yamliku lakum darran wala nafAAan waAllahu huwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul ya ahla alkitabi la taghloo fee deenikum ghayra alhaqqi wala tattabiAAoo ahwaa qawmin qad dalloo min qablu waadalloo katheeran wadalloo AAan sawai alssabeeli}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{LuAAina allatheena kafaroo min banee israeela AAala lisani dawooda waAAeesa ibni maryama thalika bima AAasaw wakanoo yaAAtadoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Kanoo la yatanahawna AAan munkarin faAAaloohu labisa ma kanoo yafAAaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Tara katheeran minhum yatawallawna allatheena kafaroo labisa ma qaddamat lahum anfusuhum an sakhita Allahu AAalayhim wafee alAAathabi hum khalidoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaw kanoo yuminoona biAllahi waalnnabiyyi wama onzila ilayhi ma ittakhathoohum awliyaa walakinna katheeran minhum fasiqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Latajidanna ashadda alnnasi AAadawatan lillatheena amanoo alyahooda waallatheena ashrakoo walatajidanna aqrabahum mawaddatan lillatheena amanoo allatheena qaloo inna nasara thalika bianna minhum qisseeseena waruhbanan waannahum la yastakbiroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha samiAAoo ma onzila ila alrrasooli tara aAAyunahum tafeedu mina alddamAAi mimma AAarafoo mina alhaqqi yaqooloona rabbana amanna faoktubna maAAa alshshahideena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama lana la numinu biAllahi wama jaana mina alhaqqi wanatmaAAu an yudkhilana rabbuna maAAa alqawmi alssaliheena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faathabahumu Allahu bima qaloo jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha wathalika jazao almuhsineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][86]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biayatina olaika ashabu aljaheemi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tuharrimoo tayyibati ma ahalla Allahu lakum wala taAAtadoo inna Allaha la yuhibbu almuAAtadeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wakuloo mimma razaqakumu Allahu halalan tayyiban waittaqoo Allaha allathee antum bihi muminoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][89]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{La yuakhithukumu Allahu biallaghwi fee aymanikum walakin yuakhithukum bima AAaqqadtumu alaymana fakaffaratuhu itAAamu AAasharati masakeena min awsati ma tutAAimoona ahleekum aw kiswatuhum aw tahreeru raqabatin faman lam yajid fasiyamu thalathati ayyamin thalika kaffaratu aymanikum itha halaftum waihfathoo aymanakum kathalika yubayyinu Allahu lakum ayatihi laAAallakum tashkuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][90]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo innama alkhamru waalmaysiru waalansabu waalazlamu rijsun min AAamali alshshaytani faijtaniboohu laAAallakum tuflihoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][91]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Innama yureedu alshshaytanu an yooqiAAa baynakumu alAAadawata waalbaghdaa fee alkhamri waalmaysiri wayasuddakum AAan thikri Allahi waAAani alssalati fahal antum muntahoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][92]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaateeAAoo Allaha waateeAAoo alrrasoola waihtharoo fain tawallaytum faiAAlamoo annama AAala rasoolina albalaghu almubeenu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][93]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Laysa AAala allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati junahun feema taAAimoo itha ma ittaqaw waamanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati thumma ittaqaw waamanoo thumma ittaqaw waahsanoo waAllahu yuhibbu almuhsineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][94]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo layabluwannakumu Allahu bishayin mina alssaydi tanaluhu aydeekum warimahukum liyaAAlama Allahu man yakhafuhu bialghaybi famani iAAtada baAAda thalika falahu AAathabun aleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][95]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la taqtuloo alssayda waantum hurumun waman qatalahu minkum mutaAAammidan fajazaon mithlu ma qatala mina alnnaAAami yahkumu bihi thawa AAadlin minkum hadyan baligha alkaAAbati aw kaffaratun taAAamu masakeena aw AAadlu thalika siyaman liyathooqa wabala amrihi AAafa Allahu AAamma salafa waman AAada fayantaqimu Allahu minhu waAllahu AAazeezun thoo intiqamin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][96]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ohilla lakum saydu albahri wataAAamuhu mataAAan lakum walilssayyarati wahurrima AAalaykum saydu albarri ma dumtum huruman waittaqoo Allaha allathee ilayhi tuhsharoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][97]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{JaAAala Allahu alkaAAbata albayta alharama qiyaman lilnnasi waalshshahra alharama waalhadya waalqalaida thalika litaAAlamoo anna Allaha yaAAlamu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi waanna Allaha bikulli shayin AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][98]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{IAAlamoo anna Allaha shadeedu alAAiqabi waanna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][99]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ma AAala alrrasooli illa albalaghu waAllahu yaAAlamu ma tubdoona wama taktumoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][100]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul la yastawee alkhabeethu waalttayyibu walaw aAAjabaka kathratu alkhabeethi faittaqoo Allaha ya olee alalbabi laAAallakum tuflihoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][101]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tasaloo AAan ashyaa in tubda lakum tasukum wain tasaloo AAanha heena yunazzalu alquranu tubda lakum AAafa Allahu AAanha waAllahu ghafoorun haleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][102]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qad saalaha qawmun min qablikum thumma asbahoo biha kafireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][103]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ma jaAAala Allahu min baheeratin wala saibatin wala waseelatin wala hamin walakinna allatheena kafaroo yaftaroona AAala Allahi alkathiba waaktharuhum la yaAAqiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][104]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha qeela lahum taAAalaw ila ma anzala Allahu waila alrrasooli qaloo hasbuna ma wajadna AAalayhi abaana awalaw kana abaohum la yaAAlamoona shayan wala yahtadoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][105]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo AAalaykum anfusakum la yadurrukum man dalla itha ihtadaytum ila Allahi marjiAAukum jameeAAan fayunabbiokum bima kuntum taAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][106]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo shahadatu baynikum itha hadara ahadakumu almawtu heena alwasiyyati ithnani thawa AAadlin minkum aw akharani min ghayrikum in antum darabtum fee alardi faasabatkum museebatu almawti tahbisoonahuma min baAAdi alssalati fayuqsimani biAllahi ini irtabtum la nashtaree bihi thamanan walaw kana tha qurba wala naktumu shahadata Allahi inna ithan lamina alathimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][107]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fain AAuthira AAala annahuma istahaqqa ithman faakharani yaqoomani maqamahuma mina allatheena istahaqqa AAalayhimu alawlayani fayuqsimani biAllahi lashahadatuna ahaqqu min shahadatihima wama iAAtadayna inna ithan lamina alththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][108]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thalika adna an yatoo bialshshahadati AAala wajhiha aw yakhafoo an turadda aymanun baAAda aymanihim waittaqoo Allaha waismaAAoo waAllahu la yahdee alqawma alfasiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][109]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yawma yajmaAAu Allahu alrrusula fayaqoolu matha ojibtum qaloo la AAilma lana innaka anta AAallamu alghuyoobi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][110]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ith qala Allahu ya AAeesa ibna maryama othkur niAAmatee AAalayka waAAala walidatika ith ayyadtuka biroohi alqudusi tukallimu alnnasa fee almahdi wakahlan waith AAallamtuka alkitaba waalhikmata waalttawrata waalinjeela waith takhluqu mina altteeni kahayati alttayri biithnee fatanfukhu feeha fatakoonu tayran biithnee watubrio alakmaha waalabrasa biithnee waith tukhriju almawta biithnee waith kafaftu banee israeela AAanka ith jitahum bialbayyinati faqala allatheena kafaroo minhum in hatha illa sihrun mubeenun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][111]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith awhaytu ila alhawariyyeena an aminoo bee wabirasoolee qaloo amanna waishhad biannana muslimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][112]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ith qala alhawariyyoona ya AAeesa ibna maryama hal yastateeAAu rabbuka an yunazzila AAalayna maidatan mina alssamai qala ittaqoo Allaha in kuntum mumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][113]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qaloo nureedu an nakula minha watatmainna quloobuna wanaAAlama an qad sadaqtana wanakoona AAalayha mina alshshahideena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][114]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qala AAeesa ibnu maryama allahumma rabbana anzil AAalayna maidatan mina alssamai takoonu lana AAeedan liawwalina waakhirina waayatan minka waorzuqna waanta khayru alrraziqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][115]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qala Allahu innee munazziluha AAalaykum faman yakfur baAAdu minkum fainnee oAAaththibuhu AAathaban la oAAaththibuhu ahadan mina alAAalameena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][116]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith qala Allahu ya AAeesa ibna maryama aanta qulta lilnnasi ittakhithoonee waommiya ilahayni min dooni Allahi qala subhanaka ma yakoonu lee an aqoola ma laysa lee bihaqqin in kuntu qultuhu faqad AAalimtahu taAAlamu ma fee nafsee wala aAAlamu ma fee nafsika innaka anta AAallamu alghuyoobi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][117]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ma qultu lahum illa ma amartanee bihi ani oAAbudoo Allaha rabbee warabbakum wakuntu AAalayhim shaheedan ma dumtu feehim falamma tawaffaytanee kunta anta alrraqeeba AAalayhim waanta AAala kulli shayin shaheedun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][118]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{In tuAAaththibhum fainnahum AAibaduka wain taghfir lahum fainnaka anta alAAazeezu alhakeemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][119]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qala Allahu hatha yawmu yanfaAAu alssadiqeena sidquhum lahum jannatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha abadan radiya Allahu AAanhum waradoo AAanhu thalika alfawzu alAAatheemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[5][120]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lillahi mulku alssamawati waalardi wama feehinna wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}
\chapter{Al-An'am (The Cattle)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alhamdu lillahi allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda wajaAAala alththulumati waalnnoora thumma allatheena kafaroo birabbihim yaAAdiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Huwa allathee khalaqakum min teenin thumma qada ajalan waajalun musamman AAindahu thumma antum tamtaroona}

\quranayah[6][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wahuwa Allahu fee alssamawati wafee alardi yaAAlamu sirrakum wajahrakum wayaAAlamu ma taksiboona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama tateehim min ayatin min ayati rabbihim illa kanoo AAanha muAArideena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][5]
\end{Arabic}}

\quranayah[6][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alam yaraw kam ahlakna min qablihim min qarnin makkannahum fee alardi ma lam numakkin lakum waarsalna alssamaa AAalayhim midraran wajaAAalna alanhara tajree min tahtihim faahlaknahum bithunoobihim waanshana min baAAdihim qarnan akhareena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaw nazzalna AAalayka kitaban fee qirtasin falamasoohu biaydeehim laqala allatheena kafaroo in hatha illa sihrun mubeenun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqaloo lawla onzila AAalayhi malakun walaw anzalna malakan laqudiya alamru thumma la yuntharoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaw jaAAalnahu malakan lajaAAalnahu rajulan walalabasna AAalayhim ma yalbisoona}

\quranayah[6][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaqadi istuhzia birusulin min qablika fahaqa biallatheena sakhiroo minhum ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona}

\quranayah[6][11]

\flushleft{Qul seeroo fee alardi thumma onthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu almukaththibeena}

\quranayah[6][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul liman ma fee alssamawati waalardi qul lillahi kataba AAala nafsihi alrrahmata layajmaAAannakum ila yawmi alqiyamati la rayba feehi allatheena khasiroo anfusahum fahum la yuminoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][13]
\end{Arabic}}

\quranayah[6][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul aghayra Allahi attakhithu waliyyan fatiri alssamawati waalardi wahuwa yutAAimu wala yutAAamu qul innee omirtu an akoona awwala man aslama wala takoonanna mina almushrikeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][15]

\flushleft{Qul innee akhafu in AAasaytu rabbee AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin}

\quranayah[6][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Man yusraf AAanhu yawmaithin faqad rahimahu wathalika alfawzu almubeenu}

\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain yamsaska Allahu bidurrin fala kashifa lahu illa huwa wain yamsaska bikhayrin fahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}

\quranayah[6][20]

\flushleft{Allatheena ataynahumu alkitaba yaAArifoonahu kama yaAArifoona abnaahum allatheena khasiroo anfusahum fahum la yuminoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waman athlamu mimmani iftara AAala Allahi kathiban aw kaththaba biayatihi innahu la yuflihu alththalimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wayawma nahshuruhum jameeAAan thumma naqoolu lillatheena ashrakoo ayna shurakaokumu allatheena kuntum tazAAumoona}

\quranayah[6][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thumma lam takun fitnatuhum illa an qaloo waAllahi rabbina ma kunna mushrikeena}

\flushleft{Waminhum man yastamiAAu ilayka wajaAAalna AAala quloobihim akinnatan an yafqahoohu wafee athanihim waqran wain yaraw kulla ayatin la yuminoo biha hatta itha jaooka yujadiloonaka yaqoolu allatheena kafaroo in hatha illa asateeru alawwaleena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][26]

\flushleft{Wahum yanhawna AAanhu wayanawna AAanhu wain yuhlikoona illa anfusahum wama yashAAuroona}

\quranayah[6][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaw tara ith wuqifoo AAala alnnari faqaloo ya laytana nuraddu wala nukaththiba biayati rabbina wanakoona mina almumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Bal bada lahum ma kanoo yukhfoona min qablu walaw ruddoo laAAadoo lima nuhoo AAanhu wainnahum lakathiboona}

\quranayah[6][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqaloo in hiya illa hayatuna alddunya wama nahnu bimabAAootheena}

\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaw tara ith wuqifoo AAala rabbihim qala alaysa hatha bialhaqqi qaloo bala warabbina qala fathooqoo alAAathaba bima kuntum takfuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qad khasira allatheena kaththaboo biliqai Allahi hatta itha jaathumu alssaAAatu baghtatan qaloo ya hasratana AAala ma farratna feeha wahum yahmiloona awzarahum AAala thuhoorihim ala saa ma yaziroona}

\quranayah[6][32]
\end{Arabic}}

\quranayah[6][33]
\end{Arabic}}

\quranayah[6][34]

\flushleft{Walaqad kuththibat rusulun min qablika fasabaroo AAala ma kuththiboo waoothoo hatta atahum nasruna wala mubaddila likalimati Allahi walaqad jaaka min nabai almursaleena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain kana kabura AAalayka iAAraduhum faini istataAAta an tabtaghiya nafaqan fee alardi aw sullaman fee alssamai fatatiyahum biayatin walaw shaa Allahu lajamaAAahum AAala alhuda fala takoonanna mina aljahileena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Innama yastajeebu allatheena yasmaAAoona waalmawta yabAAathuhumu Allahu thumma ilayhi yurjaAAoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqaloo lawla nuzzila AAalayhi ayatun min rabbihi qul inna Allaha qadirun AAala an yunazzila ayatan walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona}

\quranayah[6][38]

\flushleft{Wama min dabbatin fee alardi wala tairin yateeru bijanahayhi illa omamun amthalukum ma farratna fee alkitabi min shayin thumma ila rabbihim yuhsharoona}

\quranayah[6][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena kaththaboo biayatina summun wabukmun fee alththulumati man yashai Allahu yudlilhu waman yasha yajAAalhu AAala siratin mustaqeemin}

\quranayah[6][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul araaytakum in atakum AAathabu Allahi aw atatkumu alssaAAatu aghayra Allahi tadAAoona in kuntum sadiqeena}

\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Bal iyyahu tadAAoona fayakshifu ma tadAAoona ilayhi in shaa watansawna ma tushrikoona}

\quranayah[6][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaqad arsalna ila omamin min qablika faakhathnahum bialbasai waalddarrai laAAallahum yatadarraAAoona}

\quranayah[6][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Falawla ith jaahum basuna tadarraAAoo walakin qasat quloobuhum wazayyana lahumu alshshaytanu ma kanoo yaAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Falamma nasoo ma thukkiroo bihi fatahna AAalayhim abwaba kulli shayin hatta itha farihoo bima ootoo akhathnahum baghtatan faitha hum mublisoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{FaqutiAAa dabiru alqawmi allatheena thalamoo waalhamdu lillahi rabbi alAAalameena}

\quranayah[6][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul araaytum in akhatha Allahu samAAakum waabsarakum wakhatama AAala quloobikum man ilahun ghayru Allahi yateekum bihi onthur kayfa nusarrifu alayati thumma hum yasdifoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][47]

\flushleft{Qul araaytakum in atakum AAathabu Allahi baghtatan aw jahratan hal yuhlaku illa alqawmu alththalimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama nursilu almursaleena illa mubashshireena wamunthireena faman amana waaslaha fala khawfun AAalayhim wala hum yahzanoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena kaththaboo biayatina yamassuhumu alAAathabu bima kanoo yafsuqoona}

\quranayah[6][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul la aqoolu lakum AAindee khazainu Allahi wala aAAlamu alghayba wala aqoolu lakum innee malakun in attabiAAu illa ma yooha ilayya qul hal yastawee alaAAma waalbaseeru afala tatafakkaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waanthir bihi allatheena yakhafoona an yuhsharoo ila rabbihim laysa lahum min doonihi waliyyun wala shafeeAAun laAAallahum yattaqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala tatrudi allatheena yadAAoona rabbahum bialghadati waalAAashiyyi yureedoona wajhahu ma AAalayka min hisabihim min shayin wama min hisabika AAalayhim min shayin fatatrudahum fatakoona mina alththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wakathalika fatanna baAAdahum bibaAAdin liyaqooloo ahaolai manna Allahu AAalayhim min baynina alaysa Allahu biaAAlama bialshshakireena}

\quranayah[6][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha jaaka allatheena yuminoona biayatina faqul salamun AAalaykum kataba rabbukum AAala nafsihi alrrahmata annahu man AAamila minkum sooan bijahalatin thumma taba min baAAdihi waaslaha faannahu ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wakathalika nufassilu alayati walitastabeena sabeelu almujrimeena}

\quranayah[6][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul innee nuheetu an aAAbuda allatheena tadAAoona min dooni Allahi qul la attabiAAu ahwaakum qad dalaltu ithan wama ana mina almuhtadeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul innee AAala bayyinatin min rabbee wakaththabtum bihi ma AAindee ma tastaAAjiloona bihi ini alhukmu illa lillahi yaqussu alhaqqa wahuwa khayru alfasileena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul law anna AAindee ma tastaAAjiloona bihi laqudiya alamru baynee wabaynakum waAllahu aAAlamu bialththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaAAindahu mafatihu alghaybi la yaAAlamuha illa huwa wayaAAlamu ma fee albarri waalbahri wama tasqutu min waraqatin illa yaAAlamuha wala habbatin fee thulumati alardi wala ratbin wala yabisin illa fee kitabin mubeenin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wahuwa allathee yatawaffakum biallayli wayaAAlamu ma jarahtum bialnnahari thumma yabAAathukum feehi liyuqda ajalun musamman thumma ilayhi marjiAAukum thumma yunabbiokum bima kuntum taAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wahuwa alqahiru fawqa AAibadihi wayursilu AAalaykum hafathatan hatta itha jaa ahadakumu almawtu tawaffathu rusuluna wahum la yufarritoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thumma ruddoo ila Allahi mawlahumu alhaqqi ala lahu alhukmu wahuwa asraAAu alhasibeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul man yunajjeekum min thulumati albarri waalbahri tadAAoonahu tadarruAAan wakhufyatan lain anjana min hathihi lanakoonanna mina alshshakireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Quli Allahu yunajjeekum minha wamin kulli karbin thumma antum tushrikoona}

\quranayah[6][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul huwa alqadiru AAala an yabAAatha AAalaykum AAathaban min fawqikum aw min tahti arjulikum aw yalbisakum shiyaAAan wayutheeqa baAAdakum basa baAAdin onthur kayfa nusarrifu alayati laAAallahum yafqahoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wakaththaba bihi qawmuka wahuwa alhaqqu qul lastu AAalaykum biwakeelin}

\quranayah[6][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Likulli nabain mustaqarrun wasawfa taAAlamoona}

\quranayah[6][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha raayta allatheena yakhoodoona fee ayatina faaAArid AAanhum hatta yakhoodoo fee hadeethin ghayrihi waimma yunsiyannaka alshshaytanu fala taqAAud baAAda alththikra maAAa alqawmi alththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama AAala allatheena yattaqoona min hisabihim min shayin walakin thikra laAAallahum yattaqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wathari allatheena ittakhathoo deenahum laAAiban walahwan wagharrathumu alhayatu alddunya wathakkir bihi an tubsala nafsun bima kasabat laysa laha min dooni Allahi waliyyun wala shafeeAAun wain taAAdil kulla AAadlin la yukhath minha olaika allatheena obsiloo bima kasaboo lahum sharabun min hameemin waAAathabun aleemun bima kanoo yakfuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul anadAAoo min dooni Allahi ma la yanfaAAuna wala yadurruna wanuraddu AAala aAAqabina baAAda ith hadana Allahu kaallathee istahwathu alshshayateenu fee alardi hayrana lahu ashabun yadAAoonahu ila alhuda itina qul inna huda Allahi huwa alhuda waomirna linuslima lirabbi alAAalameena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waan aqeemoo alssalata waittaqoohu wahuwa allathee ilayhi tuhsharoona}

\quranayah[6][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wahuwa allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda bialhaqqi wayawma yaqoolu kun fayakoonu qawluhu alhaqqu walahu almulku yawma yunfakhu fee alssoori AAalimu alghaybi waalshshahadati wahuwa alhakeemu alkhabeeru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith qala ibraheemu liabeehi azara atattakhithu asnaman alihatan innee araka waqawmaka fee dalalin mubeenin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wakathalika nuree ibraheema malakoota alssamawati waalardi waliyakoona mina almooqineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Falamma janna AAalayhi allaylu raa kawkaban qala hatha rabbee falamma afala qala la ohibbu alafileena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Falamma raa alqamara bazighan qala hatha rabbee falamma afala qala lain lam yahdinee rabbee laakoonanna mina alqawmi alddalleena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Falamma raa alshshamsa bazighatan qala hatha rabbee hatha akbaru falamma afalat qala ya qawmi innee bareeon mimma tushrikoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Innee wajjahtu wajhiya lillathee fatara alssamawati waalarda haneefan wama ana mina almushrikeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wahajjahu qawmuhu qala atuhajjoonnee fee Allahi waqad hadani wala akhafu ma tushrikoona bihi illa an yashaa rabbee shayan wasiAAa rabbee kulla shayin AAilman afala tatathakkaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wakayfa akhafu ma ashraktum wala takhafoona annakum ashraktum biAllahi ma lam yunazzil bihi AAalaykum sultanan faayyu alfareeqayni ahaqqu bialamni in kuntum taAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena amanoo walam yalbisoo eemanahum bithulmin olaika lahumu alamnu wahum muhtadoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Watilka hujjatuna ataynaha ibraheema AAala qawmihi narfaAAu darajatin man nashao inna rabbaka hakeemun AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wawahabna lahu ishaqa wayaAAqooba kullan hadayna wanoohan hadayna min qablu wamin thurriyyatihi dawooda wasulaymana waayyooba wayoosufa wamoosa waharoona wakathalika najzee almuhsineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wazakariyya wayahya waAAeesa wailyasa kullun mina alssaliheena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][86]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaismaAAeela wailyasaAAa wayoonusa walootan wakullan faddalna AAala alAAalameena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wamin abaihim wathurriyyatihim waikhwanihim waijtabaynahum wahadaynahum ila siratin mustaqeemin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thalika huda Allahi yahdee bihi man yashao min AAibadihi walaw ashrakoo lahabita AAanhum ma kanoo yaAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][89]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Olaika allatheena ataynahumu alkitaba waalhukma waalnnubuwwata fain yakfur biha haolai faqad wakkalna biha qawman laysoo biha bikafireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][90]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Olaika allatheena hada Allahu fabihudahumu iqtadih qul la asalukum AAalayhi ajran in huwa illa thikra lilAAalameena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][91]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama qadaroo Allaha haqqa qadrihi ith qaloo ma anzala Allahu AAala basharin min shayin qul man anzala alkitaba allathee jaa bihi moosa nooran wahudan lilnnasi tajAAaloonahu qarateesa tubdoonaha watukhfoona katheeran waAAullimtum ma lam taAAlamoo antum wala abaokum quli Allahu thumma tharhum fee khawdihim yalAAaboona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][92]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wahatha kitabun anzalnahu mubarakun musaddiqu allathee bayna yadayhi walitunthira omma alqura waman hawlaha waallatheena yuminoona bialakhirati yuminoona bihi wahum AAala salatihim yuhafithoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][93]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waman athlamu mimmani iftara AAala Allahi kathiban aw qala oohiya ilayya walam yooha ilayhi shayon waman qala saonzilu mithla ma anzala Allahu walaw tara ithi alththalimoona fee ghamarati almawti waalmalaikatu basitoo aydeehim akhrijoo anfusakumu alyawma tujzawna AAathaba alhooni bima kuntum taqooloona AAala Allahi ghayra alhaqqi wakuntum AAan ayatihi tastakbiroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][94]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaqad jitumoona furada kama khalaqnakum awwala marratin wataraktum ma khawwalnakum waraa thuhoorikum wama nara maAAakum shufaAAaakumu allatheena zaAAamtum annahum feekum shurakao laqad taqattaAAa baynakum wadalla AAankum ma kuntum tazAAumoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][95]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna Allaha faliqu alhabbi waalnnawa yukhriju alhayya mina almayyiti wamukhriju almayyiti mina alhayyi thalikumu Allahu faanna tufakoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][96]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faliqu alisbahi wajaAAala allayla sakanan waalshshamsa waalqamara husbanan thalika taqdeeru alAAazeezi alAAaleemi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][97]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wahuwa allathee jaAAala lakumu alnnujooma litahtadoo biha fee thulumati albarri waalbahri qad fassalna alayati liqawmin yaAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][98]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wahuwa allathee anshaakum min nafsin wahidatin famustaqarrun wamustawdaAAun qad fassalna alayati liqawmin yafqahoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][99]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wahuwa allathee anzala mina alssamai maan faakhrajna bihi nabata kulli shayin faakhrajna minhu khadiran nukhriju minhu habban mutarakiban wamina alnnakhli min talAAiha qinwanun daniyatun wajannatin min aAAnabin waalzzaytoona waalrrummana mushtabihan waghayra mutashabihin onthuroo ila thamarihi itha athmara wayanAAihi inna fee thalikum laayatin liqawmin yuminoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][100]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WajaAAaloo lillahi shurakaa aljinna wakhalaqahum wakharaqoo lahu baneena wabanatin bighayri AAilmin subhanahu wataAAala AAamma yasifoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][101]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{BadeeAAu alssamawati waalardi anna yakoonu lahu waladun walam takun lahu sahibatun wakhalaqa kulla shayin wahuwa bikulli shayin AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][102]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thalikumu Allahu rabbukum la ilaha illa huwa khaliqu kulli shayin faoAAbudoohu wahuwa AAala kulli shayin wakeelun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][103]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{La tudrikuhu alabsaru wahuwa yudriku alabsara wahuwa allateefu alkhabeeru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][104]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qad jaakum basairu min rabbikum faman absara falinafsihi waman AAamiya faAAalayha wama ana AAalaykum bihafeethin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][105]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wakathalika nusarrifu alayati waliyaqooloo darasta walinubayyinahu liqawmin yaAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][106]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{IttabiAA ma oohiya ilayka min rabbika la ilaha illa huwa waaAArid AAani almushrikeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][107]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaw shaa Allahu ma ashrakoo wama jaAAalnaka AAalayhim hafeethan wama anta AAalayhim biwakeelin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][108]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala tasubboo allatheena yadAAoona min dooni Allahi fayasubboo Allaha AAadwan bighayri AAilmin kathalika zayyanna likulli ommatin AAamalahum thumma ila rabbihim marjiAAuhum fayunabbiohum bima kanoo yaAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][109]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waaqsamoo biAllahi jahda aymanihim lain jaathum ayatun layuminunna biha qul innama alayatu AAinda Allahi wama yushAAirukum annaha itha jaat la yuminoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][110]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wanuqallibu afidatahum waabsarahum kama lam yuminoo bihi awwala marratin wanatharuhum fee tughyanihim yaAAmahoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][111]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaw annana nazzalna ilayhimu almalaikata wakallamahumu almawta wahasharna AAalayhim kulla shayin qubulan ma kanoo liyuminoo illa an yashaa Allahu walakinna aktharahum yajhaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][112]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wakathalika jaAAalna likulli nabiyyin AAaduwwan shayateena alinsi waaljinni yoohee baAAduhum ila baAAdin zukhrufa alqawli ghurooran walaw shaa rabbuka ma faAAaloohu fatharhum wama yaftaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][113]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walitasgha ilayhi afidatu allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati waliyardawhu waliyaqtarifoo ma hum muqtarifoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][114]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Afaghayra Allahi abtaghee hakaman wahuwa allathee anzala ilaykumu alkitaba mufassalan waallatheena ataynahumu alkitaba yaAAlamoona annahu munazzalun min rabbika bialhaqqi fala takoonanna mina almumtareena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][115]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Watammat kalimatu rabbika sidqan waAAadlan la mubaddila likalimatihi wahuwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][116]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain tutiAA akthara man fee alardi yudillooka AAan sabeeli Allahi in yattabiAAoona illa alththanna wain hum illa yakhrusoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][117]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna rabbaka huwa aAAlamu man yadillu AAan sabeelihi wahuwa aAAlamu bialmuhtadeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][118]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fakuloo mimma thukira ismu Allahi AAalayhi in kuntum biayatihi mumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][119]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama lakum alla takuloo mimma thukira ismu Allahi AAalayhi waqad fassala lakum ma harrama AAalaykum illa ma idturirtum ilayhi wainna katheeran layudilloona biahwaihim bighayri AAilmin inna rabbaka huwa aAAlamu bialmuAAtadeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][120]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Watharoo thahira alithmi wabatinahu inna allatheena yaksiboona alithma sayujzawna bima kanoo yaqtarifoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][121]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala takuloo mimma lam yuthkari ismu Allahi AAalayhi wainnahu lafisqun wainna alshshayateena layoohoona ila awliyaihim liyujadilookum wain ataAAtumoohum innakum lamushrikoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][122]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Awa man kana maytan faahyaynahu wajaAAalna lahu nooran yamshee bihi fee alnnasi kaman mathaluhu fee alththulumati laysa bikharijin minha kathalika zuyyina lilkafireena ma kanoo yaAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][123]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wakathalika jaAAalna fee kulli qaryatin akabira mujrimeeha liyamkuroo feeha wama yamkuroona illa bianfusihim wama yashAAuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][124]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha jaathum ayatun qaloo lan numina hatta nuta mithla ma ootiya rusulu Allahi Allahu aAAlamu haythu yajAAalu risalatahu sayuseebu allatheena ajramoo sagharun AAinda Allahi waAAathabun shadeedun bima kanoo yamkuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][125]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faman yuridi Allahu an yahdiyahu yashrah sadrahu lilislami waman yurid an yudillahu yajAAal sadrahu dayyiqan harajan kaannama yassaAAAAadu fee alssamai kathalika yajAAalu Allahu alrrijsa AAala allatheena la yuminoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][126]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wahatha siratu rabbika mustaqeeman qad fassalna alayati liqawmin yaththakkaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][127]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lahum daru alssalami AAinda rabbihim wahuwa waliyyuhum bima kanoo yaAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][128]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wayawma yahshuruhum jameeAAan ya maAAshara aljinni qadi istakthartum mina alinsi waqala awliyaohum mina alinsi rabbana istamtaAAa baAAduna bibaAAdin wabalaghna ajalana allathee ajjalta lana qala alnnaru mathwakum khalideena feeha illa ma shaa Allahu inna rabbaka hakeemun AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][129]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wakathalika nuwallee baAAda alththalimeena baAAdan bima kanoo yaksiboona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][130]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya maAAshara aljinni waalinsi alam yatikum rusulun minkum yaqussoona AAalaykum ayatee wayunthiroonakum liqaa yawmikum hatha qaloo shahidna AAala anfusina wagharrathumu alhayatu alddunya washahidoo AAala anfusihim annahum kanoo kafireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][131]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thalika an lam yakun rabbuka muhlika alqura bithulmin waahluha ghafiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][132]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walikullin darajatun mimma AAamiloo wama rabbuka bighafilin AAamma yaAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][133]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Warabbuka alghaniyyu thoo alrrahmati in yasha yuthhibkum wayastakhlif min baAAdikum ma yashao kama anshaakum min thurriyyati qawmin akhareena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][134]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna ma tooAAadoona laatin wama antum bimuAAjizeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][135]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul ya qawmi iAAmaloo AAala makanatikum innee AAamilun fasawfa taAAlamoona man takoonu lahu AAaqibatu alddari innahu la yuflihu alththalimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][136]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WajaAAaloo lillahi mimma tharaa mina alharthi waalanAAami naseeban faqaloo hatha lillahi bizaAAmihim wahatha lishurakaina fama kana lishurakaihim fala yasilu ila Allahi wama kana lillahi fahuwa yasilu ila shurakaihim saa ma yahkumoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][137]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wakathalika zayyana likatheerin mina almushrikeena qatla awladihim shurakaohum liyurdoohum waliyalbisoo AAalayhim deenahum walaw shaa Allahu ma faAAaloohu fatharhum wama yaftaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][138]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqaloo hathihi anAAamun waharthun hijrun la yatAAamuha illa man nashao bizaAAmihim waanAAamun hurrimat thuhooruha waanAAamun la yathkuroona isma Allahi AAalayha iftiraan AAalayhi sayajzeehim bima kanoo yaftaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][139]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqaloo ma fee butooni hathihi alanAAami khalisatun lithukoorina wamuharramun AAala azwajina wain yakun maytatan fahum feehi shurakao sayajzeehim wasfahum innahu hakeemun AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][140]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qad khasira allatheena qataloo awladahum safahan bighayri AAilmin waharramoo ma razaqahumu Allahu iftiraan AAala Allahi qad dalloo wama kanoo muhtadeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][141]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wahuwa allathee anshaa jannatin maAArooshatin waghayra maAArooshatin waalnnakhla waalzzarAAa mukhtalifan okuluhu waalzzaytoona waalrrummana mutashabihan waghayra mutashabihin kuloo min thamarihi itha athmara waatoo haqqahu yawma hasadihi wala tusrifoo innahu la yuhibbu almusrifeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][142]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wamina alanAAami hamoolatan wafarshan kuloo mimma razaqakumu Allahu wala tattabiAAoo khutuwati alshshaytani innahu lakum AAaduwwun mubeenun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][143]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thamaniyata azwajin mina alddani ithnayni wamina almaAAzi ithnayni qul alththakarayni harrama ami alonthayayni amma ishtamalat AAalayhi arhamu alonthayayni nabbioonee biAAilmin in kuntum sadiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][144]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wamina alibili ithnayni wamina albaqari ithnayni qul alththakarayni harrama ami alonthayayni amma ishtamalat AAalayhi arhamu alonthayayni am kuntum shuhadaa ith wassakumu Allahu bihatha faman athlamu mimmani iftara AAala Allahi kathiban liyudilla alnnasa bighayri AAilmin inna Allaha la yahdee alqawma alththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][145]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul la ajidu fee ma oohiya ilayya muharraman AAala taAAimin yatAAamuhu illa an yakoona maytatan aw daman masfoohan aw lahma khinzeerin fainnahu rijsun aw fisqan ohilla lighayri Allahi bihi famani idturra ghayra baghin wala AAadin fainna rabbaka ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][146]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaAAala allatheena hadoo harramna kulla thee thufurin wamina albaqari waalghanami harramna AAalayhim shuhoomahuma illa ma hamalat thuhooruhuma awi alhawaya aw ma ikhtalata biAAathmin thalika jazaynahum bibaghyihim wainna lasadiqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][147]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fain kaththabooka faqul rabbukum thoo rahmatin wasiAAatin wala yuraddu basuhu AAani alqawmi almujrimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][148]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Sayaqoolu allatheena ashrakoo law shaa Allahu ma ashrakna wala abaona wala harramna min shayin kathalika kaththaba allatheena min qablihim hatta thaqoo basana qul hal AAindakum min AAilmin fatukhrijoohu lana in tattabiAAoona illa alththanna wain antum illa takhrusoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][149]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul falillahi alhujjatu albalighatu falaw shaa lahadakum ajmaAAeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][150]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul halumma shuhadaakumu allatheena yashhadoona anna Allaha harrama hatha fain shahidoo fala tashhad maAAahum wala tattabiAA ahwaa allatheena kaththaboo biayatina waallatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati wahum birabbihim yaAAdiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][151]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul taAAalaw atlu ma harrama rabbukum AAalaykum alla tushrikoo bihi shayan wabialwalidayni ihsanan wala taqtuloo awladakum min imlaqin nahnu narzuqukum waiyyahum wala taqraboo alfawahisha ma thahara minha wama batana wala taqtuloo alnnafsa allatee harrama Allahu illa bialhaqqi thalikum wassakum bihi laAAallakum taAAqiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][152]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala taqraboo mala alyateemi illa biallatee hiya ahsanu hatta yablugha ashuddahu waawfoo alkayla waalmeezana bialqisti la nukallifu nafsan illa wusAAaha waitha qultum faiAAdiloo walaw kana tha qurba wabiAAahdi Allahi awfoo thalikum wassakum bihi laAAallakum tathakkaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][153]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waanna hatha siratee mustaqeeman faittabiAAoohu wala tattabiAAoo alssubula fatafarraqa bikum AAan sabeelihi thalikum wassakum bihi laAAallakum tattaqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][154]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thumma atayna moosa alkitaba tamaman AAala allathee ahsana watafseelan likulli shayin wahudan warahmatan laAAallahum biliqai rabbihim yuminoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][155]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wahatha kitabun anzalnahu mubarakun faittabiAAoohu waittaqoo laAAallakum turhamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][156]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{An taqooloo innama onzila alkitabu AAala taifatayni min qablina wain kunna AAan dirasatihim laghafileena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][157]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Aw taqooloo law anna onzila AAalayna alkitabu lakunna ahda minhum faqad jaakum bayyinatun min rabbikum wahudan warahmatun faman athlamu mimman kaththaba biayati Allahi wasadafa AAanha sanajzee allatheena yasdifoona AAan ayatina sooa alAAathabi bima kanoo yasdifoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][158]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Hal yanthuroona illa an tatiyahumu almalaikatu aw yatiya rabbuka aw yatiya baAAdu ayati rabbika yawma yatee baAAdu ayati rabbika la yanfaAAu nafsan eemanuha lam takun amanat min qablu aw kasabat fee eemaniha khayran quli intathiroo inna muntathiroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][159]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena farraqoo deenahum wakanoo shiyaAAan lasta minhum fee shayin innama amruhum ila Allahi thumma yunabbiohum bima kanoo yafAAaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][160]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Man jaa bialhasanati falahu AAashru amthaliha waman jaa bialssayyiati fala yujza illa mithlaha wahum la yuthlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][161]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul innanee hadanee rabbee ila siratin mustaqeemin deenan qiyaman millata ibraheema haneefan wama kana mina almushrikeena}

\flushleft{Waila madyana akhahum shuAAayban qala ya qawmi oAAbudoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu qad jaatkum bayyinatun min rabbikum faawfoo alkayla waalmeezana wala tabkhasoo alnnasa ashyaahum wala tufsidoo fee alardi baAAda islahiha thalikum khayrun lakum in kuntum mumineena}

\flushleft{Wala taqAAudoo bikulli siratin tooAAidoona watasuddoona AAan sabeeli Allahi man amana bihi watabghoonaha AAiwajan waothkuroo ith kuntum qaleelan fakaththarakum waonthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu almufsideena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain kana taifatun minkum amanoo biallathee orsiltu bihi wataifatun lam yuminoo faisbiroo hatta yahkuma Allahu baynana wahuwa khayru alhakimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qala almalao allatheena istakbaroo min qawmihi lanukhrijannaka ya shuAAaybu waallatheena amanoo maAAaka min qaryatina aw lataAAoodunna fee millatina qala awalaw kunna kariheena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][89]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qadi iftarayna AAala Allahi kathiban in AAudna fee millatikum baAAda ith najjana Allahu minha wama yakoonu lana an naAAooda feeha illa an yashaa Allahu rabbuna wasiAAa rabbuna kulla shayin AAilman AAala Allahi tawakkalna rabbana iftah baynana wabayna qawmina bialhaqqi waanta khayru alfatiheena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][90]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqala almalao allatheena kafaroo min qawmihi laini ittabaAAtum shuAAayban innakum ithan lakhasiroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][91]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faakhathathumu alrrajfatu faasbahoo fee darihim jathimeena}

\quranayah[7][93]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fatawalla AAanhum waqala ya qawmi laqad ablaghtukum risalati rabbee wanasahtu lakum fakayfa asa AAala qawmin kafireena}

\quranayah[7][94]

\quranayah[7][95]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thumma baddalna makana alssayyiati alhasanata hatta AAafaw waqaloo qad massa abaana alddarrao waalssarrao faakhathnahum baghtatan wahum la yashAAuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][96]
\end{Arabic}}

\end{Arabic}}

\end{Arabic}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][101]
\end{Arabic}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][102]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama wajadna liaktharihim min AAahdin wain wajadna aktharahum lafasiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][103]
\end{Arabic}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][104]
\end{Arabic}}

\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Haqeequn AAala an la aqoola AAala Allahi illa alhaqqa qad jitukum bibayyinatin min rabbikum faarsil maAAiya banee israeela}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][106]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qala in kunta jita biayatin fati biha in kunta mina alssadiqeena}

\flushleft{Faalqa AAasahu faitha hiya thuAAbanun mubeenun}

\flushleft{WanazaAAa yadahu faitha hiya baydao lilnnathireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][109]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qala almalao min qawmi firAAawna inna hatha lasahirun AAaleemun}

\flushleft{Yureedu an yukhrijakum min ardikum famatha tamuroona}

\end{Arabic}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][118]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{FawaqaAAa alhaqqu wabatala ma kanoo yaAAmaloona}

\flushleft{Faghuliboo hunalika wainqalaboo saghireena}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}

\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qaloo amanna birabbi alAAalameena}

\quranayah[7][122]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Rabbi moosa waharoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][123]
\end{Arabic}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][124]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{LaoqatiAAanna aydiyakum waarjulakum min khilafin thumma laosallibannakum ajmaAAeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][125]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qaloo inna ila rabbina munqaliboona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][126]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama tanqimu minna illa an amanna biayati rabbina lamma jaatna rabbana afrigh AAalayna sabran watawaffana muslimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][127]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqala almalao min qawmi firAAawna atatharu moosa waqawmahu liyufsidoo fee alardi wayatharaka waalihataka qala sanuqattilu abnaahum wanastahyee nisaahum wainna fawqahum qahiroona}

\quranayah[7][128]
\end{Arabic}}

\quranayah[7][129]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qaloo ootheena min qabli an tatiyana wamin baAAdi ma jitana qala AAasa rabbukum an yuhlika AAaduwwakum wayastakhlifakum fee alardi fayanthura kayfa taAAmaloona}

\quranayah[7][130]
\end{Arabic}}

\flushleft{Faitha jaathumu alhasanatu qaloo lana hathihi wain tusibhum sayyiatun yattayyaroo bimoosa waman maAAahu ala innama tairuhum AAinda Allahi walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona}

\end{Arabic}}

\end{Arabic}}

\end{Arabic}}

\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waawrathna alqawma allatheena kanoo yustadAAafoona mashariqa alardi wamagharibaha allatee barakna feeha watammat kalimatu rabbika alhusna AAala banee israeela bima sabaroo wadammarna ma kana yasnaAAu firAAawnu waqawmuhu wama kanoo yaAArishoona}

\quranayah[7][138]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wajawazna bibanee israeela albahra faataw AAala qawmin yaAAkufoona AAala asnamin lahum qaloo ya moosa ijAAal lana ilahan kama lahum alihatun qala innakum qawmun tajhaloona}

\quranayah[7][139]
\end{Arabic}}

\end{Arabic}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][142]
\end{Arabic}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][143]

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][144]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qala ya moosa innee istafaytuka AAala alnnasi birisalatee wabikalamee fakhuth ma ataytuka wakun mina alshshakireena}

\quranayah[7][145]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wakatabna lahu fee alalwahi min kulli shayin mawAAithatan watafseelan likulli shayin fakhuthha biquwwatin wamur qawmaka yakhuthoo biahsaniha saoreekum dara alfasiqeena}

\quranayah[7][146]
\end{Arabic}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][147]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena kaththaboo biayatina waliqai alakhirati habitat aAAmaluhum hal yujzawna illa ma kanoo yaAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][148]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waittakhatha qawmu moosa min baAAdihi min huliyyihim AAijlan jasadan lahu khuwarun alam yaraw annahu la yukallimuhum wala yahdeehim sabeelan ittakhathoohu wakanoo thalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][149]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walamma suqita fee aydeehim waraaw annahum qad dalloo qaloo lain lam yarhamna rabbuna wayaghfir lana lanakoonanna mina alkhasireena}

\quranayah[7][150]
\end{Arabic}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][151]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qala rabbi ighfir lee waliakhee waadkhilna fee rahmatika waanta arhamu alrrahimeena}

\end{Arabic}}

\quranayah[7][153]
\end{Arabic}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][154]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walamma sakata AAan moosa alghadabu akhatha alalwaha wafee nuskhatiha hudan warahmatun lillatheena hum lirabbihim yarhaboona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][155]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waikhtara moosa qawmahu sabAAeena rajulan limeeqatina falamma akhathathumu alrrajfatu qala rabbi law shita ahlaktahum min qablu waiyyaya atuhlikuna bima faAAala alssufahao minna in hiya illa fitnatuka tudillu biha man tashao watahdee man tashao anta waliyyuna faighfir lana wairhamna waanta khayru alghafireena}

\quranayah[7][156]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waoktub lana fee hathihi alddunya hasanatan wafee alakhirati inna hudna ilayka qala AAathabee oseebu bihi man ashao warahmatee wasiAAat kulla shayin fasaaktubuha lillatheena yattaqoona wayutoona alzzakata waallatheena hum biayatina yuminoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][157]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena yattabiAAoona alrrasoola alnnabiyya alommiyya allathee yajidoonahu maktooban AAindahum fee alttawrati waalinjeeli yamuruhum bialmaAAroofi wayanhahum AAani almunkari wayuhillu lahumu alttayyibati wayuharrimu AAalayhimu alkhabaitha wayadaAAu AAanhum israhum waalaghlala allatee kanat AAalayhim faallatheena amanoo bihi waAAazzaroohu wanasaroohu waittabaAAoo alnnoora allathee onzila maAAahu olaika humu almuflihoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][158]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul ya ayyuha alnnasu innee rasoolu Allahi ilaykum jameeAAan allathee lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi la ilaha illa huwa yuhyee wayumeetu faaminoo biAllahi warasoolihi alnnabiyyi alommiyyi allathee yuminu biAllahi wakalimatihi waittabiAAoohu laAAallakum tahtadoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][159]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wamin qawmi moosa ommatun yahdoona bialhaqqi wabihi yaAAdiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][160]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaqattaAAnahumu ithnatay AAashrata asbatan omaman waawhayna ila moosa ithi istasqahu qawmuhu ani idrib biAAasaka alhajara fainbajasat minhu ithnata AAashrata AAaynan qad AAalima kullu onasin mashrabahum wathallalna AAalayhimu alghamama waanzalna AAalayhimu almanna waalssalwa kuloo min tayyibati ma razaqnakum wama thalamoona walakin kanoo anfusahum yathlimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][161]
\end{Arabic}}

\quranayah[7][163]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waisalhum AAani alqaryati allatee kanat hadirata albahri ith yaAAdoona fee alssabti ith tateehim heetanuhum yawma sabtihim shurraAAan wayawma la yasbitoona la tateehim kathalika nabloohum bima kanoo yafsuqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][164]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith qalat ommatun minhum lima taAAithoona qawman Allahu muhlikuhum aw muAAaththibuhum AAathaban shadeedan qaloo maAAthiratan ila rabbikum walaAAallahum yattaqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][165]
\end{Arabic}}

\quranayah[7][166]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Falamma AAataw AAan ma nuhoo AAanhu qulna lahum koonoo qiradatan khasieena}

\quranayah[7][167]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith taaththana rabbuka layabAAathanna AAalayhim ila yawmi alqiyamati man yasoomuhum sooa alAAathabi inna rabbaka lasareeAAu alAAiqabi wainnahu laghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][168]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaqattaAAnahum fee alardi omaman minhumu alssalihoona waminhum doona thalika wabalawnahum bialhasanati waalssayyiati laAAallahum yarjiAAoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][169]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fakhalafa min baAAdihim khalfun warithoo alkitaba yakhuthoona AAarada hatha aladna wayaqooloona sayughfaru lana wain yatihim AAaradun mithluhu yakhuthoohu alam yukhath AAalayhim meethaqu alkitabi an la yaqooloo AAala Allahi illa alhaqqa wadarasoo ma feehi waalddaru alakhiratu khayrun lillatheena yattaqoona afala taAAqiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][170]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena yumassikoona bialkitabi waaqamoo alssalata inna la nudeeAAu ajra almusliheena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][171]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith nataqna aljabala fawqahum kaannahu thullatun wathannoo annahu waqiAAun bihim khuthoo ma ataynakum biquwwatin waothkuroo ma feehi laAAallakum tattaqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][172]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith akhatha rabbuka min banee adama min thuhoorihim thurriyyatahum waashhadahum AAala anfusihim alastu birabbikum qaloo bala shahidna an taqooloo yawma alqiyamati inna kunna AAan hatha ghafileena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][173]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Aw taqooloo innama ashraka abaona min qablu wakunna thurriyyatan min baAAdihim afatuhlikuna bima faAAala almubtiloona}

\quranayah[7][174]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wakathalika nufassilu alayati walaAAallahum yarjiAAoona}
