\quranayah[7][175]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waotlu AAalayhim nabaa allathee ataynahu ayatina fainsalakha minha faatbaAAahu alshshaytanu fakana mina alghaweena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][176]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaw shina larafaAAnahu biha walakinnahu akhlada ila alardi waittabaAAa hawahu famathaluhu kamathali alkalbi in tahmil AAalayhi yalhath aw tatrukhu yalhath thalika mathalu alqawmi allatheena kaththaboo biayatina faoqsusi alqasasa laAAallahum yatafakkaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][177]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Saa mathalan alqawmu allatheena kaththaboo biayatina waanfusahum kanoo yathlimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][178]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Man yahdi Allahu fahuwa almuhtadee waman yudlil faolaika humu alkhasiroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][179]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaqad tharana lijahannama katheeran mina aljinni waalinsi lahum quloobun la yafqahoona biha walahum aAAyunun la yubsiroona biha walahum athanun la yasmaAAoona biha olaika kaalanAAami bal hum adallu olaika humu alghafiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][180]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walillahi alasmao alhusna faodAAoohu biha watharoo allatheena yulhidoona fee asmaihi sayujzawna ma kanoo yaAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][181]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wamimman khalaqna ommatun yahdoona bialhaqqi wabihi yaAAdiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][182]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena kaththaboo biayatina sanastadrijuhum min haythu la yaAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][183]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waomlee lahum inna kaydee mateenun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][184]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Awalam yatafakkaroo ma bisahibihim min jinnatin in huwa illa natheerun mubeenun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][185]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Awalam yanthuroo fee malakooti alssamawati waalardi wama khalaqa Allahu min shayin waan AAasa an yakoona qadi iqtaraba ajaluhum fabiayyi hadeethin baAAdahu yuminoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][186]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Man yudlili Allahu fala hadiya lahu wayatharuhum fee tughyanihim yaAAmahoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][187]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yasaloonaka AAani alssaAAati ayyana mursaha qul innama AAilmuha AAinda rabbee la yujalleeha liwaqtiha illa huwa thaqulat fee alssamawati waalardi la tateekum illa baghtatan yasaloonaka kaannaka hafiyyun AAanha qul innama AAilmuha AAinda Allahi walakinna akthara alnnasi la yaAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][188]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul la amliku linafsee nafAAan wala darran illa ma shaa Allahu walaw kuntu aAAlamu alghayba laistakthartu mina alkhayri wama massaniya alssooo in ana illa natheerun wabasheerun liqawmin yuminoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][189]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Huwa allathee khalaqakum min nafsin wahidatin wajaAAala minha zawjaha liyaskuna ilayha falamma taghashshaha hamalat hamlan khafeefan famarrat bihi falamma athqalat daAAawa Allaha rabbahuma lain ataytana salihan lanakoonanna mina alshshakireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][190]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Falamma atahuma salihan jaAAala lahu shurakaa feema atahuma fataAAala Allahu AAamma yushrikoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][191]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ayushrikoona ma la yakhluqu shayan wahum yukhlaqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][192]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala yastateeAAoona lahum nasran wala anfusahum yansuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][193]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain tadAAoohum ila alhuda la yattabiAAookum sawaon AAalaykum adaAAawtumoohum am antum samitoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][194]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena tadAAoona min dooni Allahi AAibadun amthalukum faodAAoohum falyastajeeboo lakum in kuntum sadiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][195]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alahum arjulun yamshoona biha am lahum aydin yabtishoona biha am lahum aAAyunun yubsiroona biha am lahum athanun yasmaAAoona biha quli odAAoo shurakaakum thumma keedooni fala tunthirooni}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][196]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna waliyyiya Allahu allathee nazzala alkitaba wahuwa yatawalla alssaliheena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][197]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena tadAAoona min doonihi la yastateeAAoona nasrakum wala anfusahum yansuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][198]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain tadAAoohum ila alhuda la yasmaAAoo watarahum yanthuroona ilayka wahum la yubsiroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][199]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Khuthi alAAafwa wamur bialAAurfi waaAArid AAani aljahileena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][200]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waimma yanzaghannaka mina alshshaytani nazghun faistaAAith biAllahi innahu sameeAAun AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][201]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena ittaqaw itha massahum taifun mina alshshaytani tathakkaroo faitha hum mubsiroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][202]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waikhwanuhum yamuddoonahum fee alghayyi thumma la yuqsiroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][203]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha lam tatihim biayatin qaloo lawla ijtabaytaha qul innama attabiAAu ma yooha ilayya min rabbee hatha basairu min rabbikum wahudan warahmatun liqawmin yuminoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][204]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha quria alquranu faistamiAAoo lahu waansitoo laAAallakum turhamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][205]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waothkur rabbaka fee nafsika tadarruAAan wakheefatan wadoona aljahri mina alqawli bialghuduwwi waalasali wala takun mina alghafileena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][206]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena AAinda rabbika la yastakbiroona AAan AAibadatihi wayusabbihoonahu walahu yasjudoona}
\chapter{Al-Anfal (Voluntary Gifts)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yasaloonaka AAani alanfali quli alanfalu lillahi waalrrasooli faittaqoo Allaha waaslihoo thata baynikum waateeAAoo Allaha warasoolahu in kuntum mumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Innama almuminoona allatheena itha thukira Allahu wajilat quloobuhum waitha tuliyat AAalayhim ayatuhu zadathum eemanan waAAala rabbihim yatawakkaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena yuqeemoona alssalata wamimma razaqnahum yunfiqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Olaika humu almuminoona haqqan lahum darajatun AAinda rabbihim wamaghfiratun warizqun kareemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Kama akhrajaka rabbuka min baytika bialhaqqi wainna fareeqan mina almumineena lakarihoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yujadiloonaka fee alhaqqi baAAdama tabayyana kaannama yusaqoona ila almawti wahum yanthuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith yaAAidukumu Allahu ihda alttaifatayni annaha lakum watawaddoona anna ghayra thati alshshawkati takoonu lakum wayureedu Allahu an yuhiqqa alhaqqa bikalimatihi wayaqtaAAa dabira alkafireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Liyuhiqqa alhaqqa wayubtila albatila walaw kariha almujrimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ith tastagheethoona rabbakum faistajaba lakum annee mumiddukum bialfin mina almalaikati murdifeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama jaAAalahu Allahu illa bushra walitatmainna bihi quloobukum wama alnnasru illa min AAindi Allahi inna Allaha AAazeezun hakeemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ith yughashsheekumu alnnuAAasa amanatan minhu wayunazzilu AAalaykum mina alssamai maan liyutahhirakum bihi wayuthhiba AAankum rijza alshshaytani waliyarbita AAala quloobikum wayuthabbita bihi alaqdama}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ith yoohee rabbuka ila almalaikati annee maAAakum fathabbitoo allatheena amanoo saolqee fee quloobi allatheena kafaroo alrruAAba faidriboo fawqa alaAAnaqi waidriboo minhum kulla bananin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thalika biannahum shaqqoo Allaha warasoolahu waman yushaqiqi Allaha warasoolahu fainna Allaha shadeedu alAAiqabi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thalikum fathooqoohu waanna lilkafireena AAathaba alnnari}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha laqeetumu allatheena kafaroo zahfan fala tuwalloohumu aladbara}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waman yuwallihim yawmaithin duburahu illa mutaharrifan liqitalin aw mutahayyizan ila fiatin faqad baa bighadabin mina Allahi wamawahu jahannamu wabisa almaseeru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Falam taqtuloohum walakinna Allaha qatalahum wama ramayta ith ramayta walakinna Allaha rama waliyubliya almumineena minhu balaan hasanan inna Allaha sameeAAun AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thalikum waanna Allaha moohinu kaydi alkafireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{In tastaftihoo faqad jaakumu alfathu wain tantahoo fahuwa khayrun lakum wain taAAoodoo naAAud walan tughniya AAankum fiatukum shayan walaw kathurat waanna Allaha maAAa almumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ateeAAoo Allaha warasoolahu wala tawallaw AAanhu waantum tasmaAAoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala takoonoo kaallatheena qaloo samiAAna wahum la yasmaAAoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna sharra alddawabbi AAinda Allahi alssummu albukmu allatheena la yaAAqiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaw AAalima Allahu feehim khayran laasmaAAahum walaw asmaAAahum latawallaw wahum muAAridoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo istajeeboo lillahi walilrrasooli itha daAAakum lima yuhyeekum waiAAlamoo anna Allaha yahoolu bayna almari waqalbihi waannahu ilayhi tuhsharoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waittaqoo fitnatan la tuseebanna allatheena thalamoo minkum khassatan waiAAlamoo anna Allaha shadeedu alAAiqabi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waothkuroo ith antum qaleelun mustadAAafoona fee alardi takhafoona an yatakhattafakumu alnnasu faawakum waayyadakum binasrihi warazaqakum mina alttayyibati laAAallakum tashkuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la takhoonoo Allaha waalrrasoola watakhoonoo amanatikum waantum taAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaiAAlamoo annama amwalukum waawladukum fitnatun waanna Allaha AAindahu ajrun AAatheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo in tattaqoo Allaha yajAAal lakum furqanan wayukaffir AAankum sayyiatikum wayaghfir lakum waAllahu thoo alfadli alAAatheemi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith yamkuru bika allatheena kafaroo liyuthbitooka aw yaqtulooka aw yukhrijooka wayamkuroona wayamkuru Allahu waAllahu khayru almakireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha tutla AAalayhim ayatuna qaloo qad samiAAna law nashao laqulna mithla hatha in hatha illa asateeru alawwaleena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith qaloo allahumma in kana hatha huwa alhaqqa min AAindika faamtir AAalayna hijaratan mina alssamai awi itina biAAathabin aleemin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama kana Allahu liyuAAaththibahum waanta feehim wama kana Allahu muAAaththibahum wahum yastaghfiroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama lahum alla yuAAaththibahumu Allahu wahum yasuddoona AAani almasjidi alharami wama kanoo awliyaahu in awliyaohu illa almuttaqoona walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama kana salatuhum AAinda albayti illa mukaan watasdiyatan fathooqoo alAAathaba bima kuntum takfuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena kafaroo yunfiqoona amwalahum liyasuddoo AAan sabeeli Allahi fasayunfiqoonaha thumma takoonu AAalayhim hasratan thumma yughlaboona waallatheena kafaroo ila jahannama yuhsharoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Liyameeza Allahu alkhabeetha mina alttayyibi wayajAAala alkhabeetha baAAdahu AAala baAAdin fayarkumahu jameeAAan fayajAAalahu fee jahannama olaika humu alkhasiroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul lillatheena kafaroo in yantahoo yughfar lahum ma qad salafa wain yaAAoodoo faqad madat sunnatu alawwaleena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqatiloohum hatta la takoona fitnatun wayakoona alddeenu kulluhu lillahi faini intahaw fainna Allaha bima yaAAmaloona baseerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain tawallaw faiAAlamoo anna Allaha mawlakum niAAma almawla waniAAma alnnaseeru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaiAAlamoo annama ghanimtum min shayin faanna lillahi khumusahu walilrrasooli walithee alqurba waalyatama waalmasakeeni waibni alssabeeli in kuntum amantum biAllahi wama anzalna AAala AAabdina yawma alfurqani yawma iltaqa aljamAAani waAllahu AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ith antum bialAAudwati alddunya wahum bialAAudwati alquswa waalrrakbu asfala minkum walaw tawaAAadtum laikhtalaftum fee almeeAAadi walakin liyaqdiya Allahu amran kana mafAAoolan liyahlika man halaka AAan bayyinatin wayahya man hayya AAan bayyinatin wainna Allaha lasameeAAun AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ith yureekahumu Allahu fee manamika qaleelan walaw arakahum katheeran lafashiltum walatanazaAAtum fee alamri walakinna Allaha sallama innahu AAaleemun bithati alssudoori}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith yureekumoohum ithi iltaqaytum fee aAAyunikum qaleelan wayuqallilukum fee aAAyunihim liyaqdiya Allahu amran kana mafAAoolan waila Allahi turjaAAu alomooru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha laqeetum fiatan faothbutoo waothkuroo Allaha katheeran laAAallakum tuflihoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaateeAAoo Allaha warasoolahu wala tanazaAAoo fatafshaloo watathhaba reehukum waisbiroo inna Allaha maAAa alssabireena}

\quranayah[8][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala takoonoo kaallatheena kharajoo min diyarihim bataran wariaa alnnasi wayasuddoona AAan sabeeli Allahi waAllahu bima yaAAmaloona muheetun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith zayyana lahumu alshshaytanu aAAmalahum waqala la ghaliba lakumu alyawma mina alnnasi wainnee jarun lakum falamma taraati alfiatani nakasa AAala AAaqibayhi waqala innee bareeon minkum innee ara ma la tarawna innee akhafu Allaha waAllahu shadeedu alAAiqabi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ith yaqoolu almunafiqoona waallatheena fee quloobihim maradun gharra haolai deenuhum waman yatawakkal AAala Allahi fainna Allaha AAazeezun hakeemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaw tara ith yatawaffa allatheena kafaroo almalaikatu yadriboona wujoohahum waadbarahum wathooqoo AAathaba alhareeqi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thalika bima qaddamat aydeekum waanna Allaha laysa bithallamin lilAAabeedi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Kadabi ali firAAawna waallatheena min qablihim kafaroo biayati Allahi faakhathahumu Allahu bithunoobihim inna Allaha qawiyyun shadeedu alAAiqabi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thalika bianna Allaha lam yaku mughayyiran niAAmatan anAAamaha AAala qawmin hatta yughayyiroo ma bianfusihim waanna Allaha sameeAAun AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Kadabi ali firAAawna waallatheena min qablihim kaththaboo biayati rabbihim faahlaknahum bithunoobihim waaghraqna ala firAAawna wakullun kanoo thalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna sharra alddawabbi AAinda Allahi allatheena kafaroo fahum la yuminoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena AAahadta minhum thumma yanqudoona AAahdahum fee kulli marratin wahum la yattaqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faimma tathqafannahum fee alharbi fasharrid bihim man khalfahum laAAallahum yaththakkaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waimma takhafanna min qawmin khiyanatan fainbith ilayhim AAala sawain inna Allaha la yuhibbu alkhaineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala yahsabanna allatheena kafaroo sabaqoo innahum la yuAAjizoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaaAAiddoo lahum ma istataAAtum min quwwatin wamin ribati alkhayli turhiboona bihi AAaduwwa Allahi waAAaduwwakum waakhareena min doonihim la taAAlamoonahumu Allahu yaAAlamuhum wama tunfiqoo min shayin fee sabeeli Allahi yuwaffa ilaykum waantum la tuthlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain janahoo lilssalmi faijnah laha watawakkal AAala Allahi innahu huwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain yureedoo an yakhdaAAooka fainna hasbaka Allahu huwa allathee ayyadaka binasrihi wabialmumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallafa bayna quloobihim law anfaqta ma fee alardi jameeAAan ma allafta bayna quloobihim walakinna Allaha allafa baynahum innahu AAazeezun hakeemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu hasbuka Allahu wamani ittabaAAaka mina almumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu harridi almumineena AAala alqitali in yakun minkum AAishroona sabiroona yaghliboo miatayni wain yakun minkum miatun yaghliboo alfan mina allatheena kafaroo biannahum qawmun la yafqahoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alana khaffafa Allahu AAankum waAAalima anna feekum daAAfan fain yakun minkum miatun sabiratun yaghliboo miatayni wain yakun minkum alfun yaghliboo alfayni biithni Allahi waAllahu maAAa alssabireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ma kana linabiyyin an yakoona lahu asra hatta yuthkhina fee alardi tureedoona AAarada alddunya waAllahu yureedu alakhirata waAllahu AAazeezun hakeemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lawla kitabun mina Allahi sabaqa lamassakum feema akhathtum AAathabun AAatheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fakuloo mimma ghanimtum halalan tayyiban waittaqoo Allaha inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu qul liman fee aydeekum mina alasra in yaAAlami Allahu fee quloobikum khayran yutikum khayran mimma okhitha minkum wayaghfir lakum waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain yureedoo khiyanataka faqad khanoo Allaha min qablu faamkana minhum waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena amanoo wahajaroo wajahadoo biamwalihim waanfusihim fee sabeeli Allahi waallatheena awaw wanasaroo olaika baAAduhum awliyao baAAdin waallatheena amanoo walam yuhajiroo ma lakum min walayatihim min shayin hatta yuhajiroo waini istansarookum fee alddeeni faAAalaykumu alnnasru illa AAala qawmin baynakum wabaynahum meethaqun waAllahu bima taAAmaloona baseerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena kafaroo baAAduhum awliyao baAAdin illa tafAAaloohu takun fitnatun fee alardi wafasadun kabeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena amanoo wahajaroo wajahadoo fee sabeeli Allahi waallatheena awaw wanasaroo olaika humu almuminoona haqqan lahum maghfiratun warizqun kareemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[8][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena amanoo min baAAdu wahajaroo wajahadoo maAAakum faolaika minkum waoloo alarhami baAAduhum awla bibaAAdin fee kitabi Allahi inna Allaha bikulli shayin AAaleemun}
\chapter{Al-Bara'at / At-Taubah(The Immunity)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Baraatun mina Allahi warasoolihi ila allatheena AAahadtum mina almushrikeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faseehoo fee alardi arbaAAata ashhurin waiAAlamoo annakum ghayru muAAjizee Allahi waanna Allaha mukhzee alkafireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waathanun mina Allahi warasoolihi ila alnnasi yawma alhajji alakbari anna Allaha bareeon mina almushrikeena warasooluhu fain tubtum fahuwa khayrun lakum wain tawallaytum faiAAlamoo annakum ghayru muAAjizee Allahi wabashshiri allatheena kafaroo biAAathabin aleemin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Illa allatheena AAahadtum mina almushrikeena thumma lam yanqusookum shayan walam yuthahiroo AAalaykum ahadan faatimmoo ilayhim AAahdahum ila muddatihim inna Allaha yuhibbu almuttaqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faitha insalakha alashhuru alhurumu faoqtuloo almushrikeena haythu wajadtumoohum wakhuthoohum waohsuroohum waoqAAudoo lahum kulla marsadin fain taboo waaqamoo alssalata waatawoo alzzakata fakhalloo sabeelahum inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain ahadun mina almushrikeena istajaraka faajirhu hatta yasmaAAa kalama Allahi thumma ablighhu mamanahu thalika biannahum qawmun la yaAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Kayfa yakoonu lilmushrikeena AAahdun AAinda Allahi waAAinda rasoolihi illa allatheena AAahadtum AAinda almasjidi alharami fama istaqamoo lakum faistaqeemoo lahum inna Allaha yuhibbu almuttaqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Kayfa wain yathharoo AAalaykum la yarquboo feekum illan wala thimmatan yurdoonakum biafwahihim wataba quloobuhum waaktharuhum fasiqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ishtaraw biayati Allahi thamanan qaleelan fasaddoo AAan sabeelihi innahum saa ma kanoo yaAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{La yarquboona fee muminin illan wala thimmatan waolaika humu almuAAtadoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fain taboo waaqamoo alssalata waatawoo alzzakata faikhwanukum fee alddeeni wanufassilu alayati liqawmin yaAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain nakathoo aymanahum min baAAdi AAahdihim wataAAanoo fee deenikum faqatiloo aimmata alkufri innahum la aymana lahum laAAallahum yantahoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ala tuqatiloona qawman nakathoo aymanahum wahammoo biikhraji alrrasooli wahum badaookum awwala marratin atakhshawnahum faAllahu ahaqqu an takhshawhu in kuntum mumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qatiloohum yuAAaththibhumu Allahu biaydeekum wayukhzihim wayansurkum AAalayhim wayashfi sudoora qawmin mumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wayuthhib ghaytha quloobihim wayatoobu Allahu AAala man yashao waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Am hasibtum an tutrakoo walamma yaAAlami Allahu allatheena jahadoo minkum walam yattakhithoo min dooni Allahi wala rasoolihi wala almumineena waleejatan waAllahu khabeerun bima taAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ma kana lilmushrikeena an yaAAmuroo masajida Allahi shahideena AAala anfusihim bialkufri olaika habitat aAAmaluhum wafee alnnari hum khalidoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Innama yaAAmuru masajida Allahi man amana biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri waaqama alssalata waata alzzakata walam yakhsha illa Allaha faAAasa olaika an yakoonoo mina almuhtadeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{AjaAAaltum siqayata alhajji waAAimarata almasjidi alharami kaman amana biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri wajahada fee sabeeli Allahi la yastawoona AAinda Allahi waAllahu la yahdee alqawma alththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena amanoo wahajaroo wajahadoo fee sabeeli Allahi biamwalihim waanfusihim aAAthamu darajatan AAinda Allahi waolaika humu alfaizoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yubashshiruhum rabbuhum birahmatin minhu waridwanin wajannatin lahum feeha naAAeemun muqeemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Khalideena feeha abadan inna Allaha AAindahu ajrun AAatheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tattakhithoo abaakum waikhwanakum awliyaa ini istahabboo alkufra AAala aleemani waman yatawallahum minkum faolaika humu alththalimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul in kana abaokum waabnaokum waikhwanukum waazwajukum waAAasheeratukum waamwalun iqtaraftumooha watijaratun takhshawna kasadaha wamasakinu tardawnaha ahabba ilaykum mina Allahi warasoolihi wajihadin fee sabeelihi fatarabbasoo hatta yatiya Allahu biamrihi waAllahu la yahdee alqawma alfasiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Laqad nasarakumu Allahu fee mawatina katheeratin wayawma hunaynin ith aAAjabatkum kathratukum falam tughni AAankum shayan wadaqat AAalaykumu alardu bima rahubat thumma wallaytum mudbireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thumma anzala Allahu sakeenatahu AAala rasoolihi waAAala almumineena waanzala junoodan lam tarawha waAAaththaba allatheena kafaroo wathalika jazao alkafireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thumma yatoobu Allahu min baAAdi thalika AAala man yashao waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo innama almushrikoona najasun fala yaqraboo almasjida alharama baAAda AAamihim hatha wain khiftum AAaylatan fasawfa yughneekumu Allahu min fadlihi in shaa inna Allaha AAaleemun hakeemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qatiloo allatheena la yuminoona biAllahi wala bialyawmi alakhiri wala yuharrimoona ma harrama Allahu warasooluhu wala yadeenoona deena alhaqqi mina allatheena ootoo alkitaba hatta yuAAtoo aljizyata AAan yadin wahum saghiroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqalati alyahoodu AAuzayrun ibnu Allahi waqalati alnnasara almaseehu ibnu Allahi thalika qawluhum biafwahihim yudahioona qawla allatheena kafaroo min qablu qatalahumu Allahu anna yufakoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ittakhathoo ahbarahum waruhbanahum arbaban min dooni Allahi waalmaseeha ibna maryama wama omiroo illa liyaAAbudoo ilahan wahidan la ilaha illa huwa subhanahu AAamma yushrikoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yureedoona an yutfioo noora Allahi biafwahihim wayaba Allahu illa an yutimma noorahu walaw kariha alkafiroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Huwa allathee arsala rasoolahu bialhuda wadeeni alhaqqi liyuthhirahu AAala alddeeni kullihi walaw kariha almushrikoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo inna katheeran mina alahbari waalrruhbani layakuloona amwala alnnasi bialbatili wayasuddoona AAan sabeeli Allahi waallatheena yaknizoona alththahaba waalfiddata wala yunfiqoonaha fee sabeeli Allahi fabashshirhum biAAathabin aleemin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yawma yuhma AAalayha fee nari jahannama fatukwa biha jibahuhum wajunoobuhum wathuhooruhum hatha ma kanaztum lianfusikum fathooqoo ma kuntum taknizoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna AAiddata alshshuhoori AAinda Allahi ithna AAashara shahran fee kitabi Allahi yawma khalaqa alssamawati waalarda minha arbaAAatun hurumun thalika alddeenu alqayyimu fala tathlimoo feehinna anfusakum waqatiloo almushrikeena kaffatan kama yuqatiloonakum kaffatan waiAAlamoo anna Allaha maAAa almuttaqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Innama alnnaseeo ziyadatun fee alkufri yudallu bihi allatheena kafaroo yuhilloonahu AAaman wayuharrimoonahu AAaman liyuwatioo AAiddata ma harrama Allahu fayuhilloo ma harrama Allahu zuyyina lahum sooo aAAmalihim waAllahu la yahdee alqawma alkafireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ma lakum itha qeela lakumu infiroo fee sabeeli Allahi iththaqaltum ila alardi aradeetum bialhayati alddunya mina alakhirati fama mataAAu alhayati alddunya fee alakhirati illa qaleelun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Illa tanfiroo yuAAaththibkum AAathaban aleeman wayastabdil qawman ghayrakum wala tadurroohu shayan waAllahu AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Illa tansuroohu faqad nasarahu Allahu ith akhrajahu allatheena kafaroo thaniya ithnayni ith huma fee alghari ith yaqoolu lisahibihi la tahzan inna Allaha maAAana faanzala Allahu sakeenatahu AAalayhi waayyadahu bijunoodin lam tarawha wajaAAala kalimata allatheena kafaroo alssufla wakalimatu Allahi hiya alAAulya waAllahu AAazeezun hakeemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Infiroo khifafan wathiqalan wajahidoo biamwalikum waanfusikum fee sabeeli Allahi thalikum khayrun lakum in kuntum taAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Law kana AAaradan qareeban wasafaran qasidan laittabaAAooka walakin baAAudat AAalayhimu alshshuqqatu wasayahlifoona biAllahi lawi istataAAna lakharajna maAAakum yuhlikoona anfusahum waAllahu yaAAlamu innahum lakathiboona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{AAafa Allahu AAanka lima athinta lahum hatta yatabayyana laka allatheena sadaqoo wataAAlama alkathibeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{La yastathinuka allatheena yuminoona biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri an yujahidoo biamwalihim waanfusihim waAllahu AAaleemun bialmuttaqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Innama yastathinuka allatheena la yuminoona biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri wairtabat quloobuhum fahum fee raybihim yataraddadoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaw aradoo alkhurooja laaAAaddoo lahu AAuddatan walakin kariha Allahu inbiAAathahum fathabbatahum waqeela oqAAudoo maAAa alqaAAideena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Law kharajoo feekum ma zadookum illa khabalan walaawdaAAoo khilalakum yabghoonakumu alfitnata wafeekum sammaAAoona lahum waAllahu AAaleemun bialththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Laqadi ibtaghawoo alfitnata min qablu waqallaboo laka alomoora hatta jaa alhaqqu wathahara amru Allahi wahum karihoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waminhum man yaqoolu ithan lee wala taftinnee ala fee alfitnati saqatoo wainna jahannama lamuheetatun bialkafireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{In tusibka hasanatun tasuhum wain tusibka museebatun yaqooloo qad akhathna amrana min qablu wayatawallaw wahum farihoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul lan yuseebana illa ma kataba Allahu lana huwa mawlana waAAala Allahi falyatawakkali almuminoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul hal tarabbasoona bina illa ihda alhusnayayni wanahnu natarabbasu bikum an yuseebakumu Allahu biAAathabin min AAindihi aw biaydeena fatarabbasoo inna maAAakum mutarabbisoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul anfiqoo tawAAan aw karhan lan yutaqabbala minkum innakum kuntum qawman fasiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama manaAAahum an tuqbala minhum nafaqatuhum illa annahum kafaroo biAllahi wabirasoolihi wala yatoona alssalata illa wahum kusala wala yunfiqoona illa wahum karihoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fala tuAAjibka amwaluhum wala awladuhum innama yureedu Allahu liyuAAaththibahum biha fee alhayati alddunya watazhaqa anfusuhum wahum kafiroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wayahlifoona biAllahi innahum laminkum wama hum minkum walakinnahum qawmun yafraqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Law yajidoona maljaan aw magharatin aw muddakhalan lawallaw ilayhi wahum yajmahoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waminhum man yalmizuka fee alssadaqati fain oAAtoo minha radoo wain lam yuAAtaw minha itha hum yaskhatoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaw annahum radoo ma atahumu Allahu warasooluhu waqaloo hasbuna Allahu sayuteena Allahu min fadlihi warasooluhu inna ila Allahi raghiboona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Innama alssadaqatu lilfuqarai waalmasakeeni waalAAamileena AAalayha waalmuallafati quloobuhum wafee alrriqabi waalgharimeena wafee sabeeli Allahi waibni alssabeeli fareedatan mina Allahi waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waminhumu allatheena yuthoona alnnabiyya wayaqooloona huwa othunun qul othunu khayrin lakum yuminu biAllahi wayuminu lilmumineena warahmatun lillatheena amanoo minkum waallatheena yuthoona rasoola Allahi lahum AAathabun aleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yahlifoona biAllahi lakum liyurdookum waAllahu warasooluhu ahaqqu an yurdoohu in kanoo mumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alam yaAAlamoo annahu man yuhadidi Allaha warasoolahu faanna lahu nara jahannama khalidan feeha thalika alkhizyu alAAatheemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yahtharu almunafiqoona an tunazzala AAalayhim sooratun tunabbiohum bima fee quloobihim quli istahzioo inna Allaha mukhrijun ma tahtharoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walain saaltahum layaqoolunna innama kunna nakhoodu wanalAAabu qul abiAllahi waayatihi warasoolihi kuntum tastahzioona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{La taAAtathiroo qad kafartum baAAda eemanikum in naAAfu AAan taifatin minkum nuAAaththib taifatan biannahum kanoo mujrimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Almunafiqoona waalmunafiqatu baAAduhum min baAAdin yamuroona bialmunkari wayanhawna AAani almaAAroofi wayaqbidoona aydiyahum nasoo Allaha fanasiyahum inna almunafiqeena humu alfasiqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaAAada Allahu almunafiqeena waalmunafiqati waalkuffara nara jahannama khalideena feeha hiya hasbuhum walaAAanahumu Allahu walahum AAathabun muqeemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Kaallatheena min qablikum kanoo ashadda minkum quwwatan waakthara amwalan waawladan faistamtaAAoo bikhalaqihim faistamtaAAtum bikhalaqikum kama istamtaAAa allatheena min qablikum bikhalaqihim wakhudtum kaallathee khadoo olaika habitat aAAmaluhum fee alddunya waalakhirati waolaika humu alkhasiroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alam yatihim nabao allatheena min qablihim qawmi noohin waAAadin wathamooda waqawmi ibraheema waashabi madyana waalmutafikati atathum rusuluhum bialbayyinati fama kana Allahu liyathlimahum walakin kanoo anfusahum yathlimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waalmuminoona waalmuminatu baAAduhum awliyao baAAdin yamuroona bialmaAAroofi wayanhawna AAani almunkari wayuqeemoona alssalata wayutoona alzzakata wayuteeAAoona Allaha warasoolahu olaika sayarhamuhumu Allahu inna Allaha AAazeezun hakeemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaAAada Allahu almumineena waalmuminati jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha wamasakina tayyibatan fee jannati AAadnin waridwanun mina Allahi akbaru thalika huwa alfawzu alAAatheemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu jahidi alkuffara waalmunafiqeena waoghluth AAalayhim wamawahum jahannamu wabisa almaseeru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yahlifoona biAllahi ma qaloo walaqad qaloo kalimata alkufri wakafaroo baAAda islamihim wahammoo bima lam yanaloo wama naqamoo illa an aghnahumu Allahu warasooluhu min fadlihi fain yatooboo yaku khayran lahum wain yatawallaw yuAAaththibhumu Allahu AAathaban aleeman fee alddunya waalakhirati wama lahum fee alardi min waliyyin wala naseerin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waminhum man AAahada Allaha lain atana min fadlihi lanassaddaqanna walanakoonanna mina alssaliheena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Falamma atahum min fadlihi bakhiloo bihi watawallaw wahum muAAridoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{FaaAAqabahum nifaqan fee quloobihim ila yawmi yalqawnahu bima akhlafoo Allaha ma waAAadoohu wabima kanoo yakthiboona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alam yaAAlamoo anna Allaha yaAAlamu sirrahum wanajwahum waanna Allaha AAallamu alghuyoobi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena yalmizoona almuttawwiAAeena mina almumineena fee alssadaqati waallatheena la yajidoona illa juhdahum fayaskharoona minhum sakhira Allahu minhum walahum AAathabun aleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Istaghfir lahum aw la tastaghfir lahum in tastaghfir lahum sabAAeena marratan falan yaghfira Allahu lahum thalika biannahum kafaroo biAllahi warasoolihi waAllahu la yahdee alqawma alfasiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fariha almukhallafoona bimaqAAadihim khilafa rasooli Allahi wakarihoo an yujahidoo biamwalihim waanfusihim fee sabeeli Allahi waqaloo la tanfiroo fee alharri qul naru jahannama ashaddu harran law kanoo yafqahoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Falyadhakoo qaleelan walyabkoo katheeran jazaan bima kanoo yaksiboona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fain rajaAAaka Allahu ila taifatin minhum faistathanooka lilkhurooji faqul lan takhrujoo maAAiya abadan walan tuqatiloo maAAiya AAaduwwan innakum radeetum bialquAAoodi awwala marratin faoqAAudoo maAAa alkhalifeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala tusalli AAala ahadin minhum mata abadan wala taqum AAala qabrihi innahum kafaroo biAllahi warasoolihi wamatoo wahum fasiqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala tuAAjibka amwaluhum waawladuhum innama yureedu Allahu an yuAAaththibahum biha fee alddunya watazhaqa anfusuhum wahum kafiroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][86]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha onzilat sooratun an aminoo biAllahi wajahidoo maAAa rasoolihi istathanaka oloo alttawli minhum waqaloo tharna nakun maAAa alqaAAideena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Radoo bian yakoonoo maAAa alkhawalifi watubiAAa AAala quloobihim fahum la yafqahoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lakini alrrasoolu waallatheena amanoo maAAahu jahadoo biamwalihim waanfusihim waolaika lahumu alkhayratu waolaika humu almuflihoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][89]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{aAAadda Allahu lahum jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha thalika alfawzu alAAatheemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][90]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wajaa almuAAaththiroona mina alaAArabi liyuthana lahum waqaAAada allatheena kathaboo Allaha warasoolahu sayuseebu allatheena kafaroo minhum AAathabun aleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][91]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Laysa AAala aldduAAafai wala AAala almarda wala AAala allatheena la yajidoona ma yunfiqoona harajun itha nasahoo lillahi warasoolihi ma AAala almuhsineena min sabeelin waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][92]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala AAala allatheena itha ma atawka litahmilahum qulta la ajidu ma ahmilukum AAalayhi tawallaw waaAAyunuhum tafeedu mina alddamAAi hazanan alla yajidoo ma yunfiqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][93]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Innama alssabeelu AAala allatheena yastathinoonaka wahum aghniyao radoo bian yakoonoo maAAa alkhawalifi watabaAAa Allahu AAala quloobihim fahum la yaAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][94]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{YaAAtathiroona ilaykum itha rajaAAtum ilayhim qul la taAAtathiroo lan numina lakum qad nabbaana Allahu min akhbarikum wasayara Allahu AAamalakum warasooluhu thumma turaddoona ila AAalimi alghaybi waalshshahadati fayunabbiokum bima kuntum taAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][95]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Sayahlifoona biAllahi lakum itha inqalabtum ilayhim lituAAridoo AAanhum faaAAridoo AAanhum innahum rijsun wamawahum jahannamu jazaan bima kanoo yaksiboona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][96]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yahlifoona lakum litardaw AAanhum fain tardaw AAanhum fainna Allaha la yarda AAani alqawmi alfasiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][97]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{AlaAArabu ashaddu kufran wanifaqan waajdaru alla yaAAlamoo hudooda ma anzala Allahu AAala rasoolihi waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][98]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wamina alaAArabi man yattakhithu ma yunfiqu maghraman wayatarabbasu bikumu alddawaira AAalayhim dairatu alssawi waAllahu sameeAAun AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][99]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wamina alaAArabi man yuminu biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri wayattakhithu ma yunfiqu qurubatin AAinda Allahi wasalawati alrrasooli ala innaha qurbatun lahum sayudkhiluhumu Allahu fee rahmatihi inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][100]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waalssabiqoona alawwaloona mina almuhajireena waalansari waallatheena ittabaAAoohum biihsanin radiya Allahu AAanhum waradoo AAanhu waaAAadda lahum jannatin tajree tahtaha alanharu khalideena feeha abadan thalika alfawzu alAAatheemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][101]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wamimman hawlakum mina alaAArabi munafiqoona wamin ahli almadeenati maradoo AAala alnnifaqi la taAAlamuhum nahnu naAAlamuhum sanuAAaththibuhum marratayni thumma yuraddoona ila AAathabin AAatheemin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][102]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waakharoona iAAtarafoo bithunoobihim khalatoo AAamalan salihan waakhara sayyian AAasa Allahu an yatooba AAalayhim inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][103]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Khuth min amwalihim sadaqatan tutahhiruhum watuzakkeehim biha wasalli AAalayhim inna salataka sakanun lahum waAllahu sameeAAun AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][104]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alam yaAAlamoo anna Allaha huwa yaqbalu alttawbata AAan AAibadihi wayakhuthu alssadaqati waanna Allaha huwa alttawwabu alrraheemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][105]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waquli iAAmaloo fasayara Allahu AAamalakum warasooluhu waalmuminoona wasaturaddoona ila AAalimi alghaybi waalshshahadati fayunabbiokum bima kuntum taAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][106]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waakharoona murjawna liamri Allahi imma yuAAaththibuhum waimma yatoobu AAalayhim waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][107]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena ittakhathoo masjidan diraran wakufran watafreeqan bayna almumineena wairsadan liman haraba Allaha warasoolahu min qablu walayahlifunna in aradna illa alhusna waAllahu yashhadu innahum lakathiboona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][108]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{La taqum feehi abadan lamasjidun ossisa AAala alttaqwa min awwali yawmin ahaqqu an taqooma feehi feehi rijalun yuhibboona an yatatahharoo waAllahu yuhibbu almuttahhireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][109]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Afaman assasa bunyanahu AAala taqwa mina Allahi waridwanin khayrun am man assasa bunyanahu AAala shafa jurufin harin fainhara bihi fee nari jahannama waAllahu la yahdee alqawma alththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][110]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{La yazalu bunyanuhumu allathee banaw reebatan fee quloobihim illa an taqattaAAa quloobuhum waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][111]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna Allaha ishtara mina almumineena anfusahum waamwalahum bianna lahumu aljannata yuqatiloona fee sabeeli Allahi fayaqtuloona wayuqtaloona waAAdan AAalayhi haqqan fee alttawrati waalinjeeli waalqurani waman awfa biAAahdihi mina Allahi faistabshiroo bibayAAikumu allathee bayaAAtum bihi wathalika huwa alfawzu alAAatheemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][112]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alttaiboona alAAabidoona alhamidoona alssaihoona alrrakiAAoona alssajidoona alamiroona bialmaAAroofi waalnnahoona AAani almunkari waalhafithoona lihudoodi Allahi wabashshiri almumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][113]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ma kana lilnnabiyyi waallatheena amanoo an yastaghfiroo lilmushrikeena walaw kanoo olee qurba min baAAdi ma tabayyana lahum annahum ashabu aljaheemi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][114]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama kana istighfaru ibraheema liabeehi illa AAan mawAAidatin waAAadaha iyyahu falamma tabayyana lahu annahu AAaduwwun lillahi tabarraa minhu inna ibraheema laawwahun haleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][115]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama kana Allahu liyudilla qawman baAAda ith hadahum hatta yubayyina lahum ma yattaqoona inna Allaha bikulli shayin AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][116]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna Allaha lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi yuhyee wayumeetu wama lakum min dooni Allahi min waliyyin wala naseerin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][117]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Laqad taba Allahu AAala alnnabiyyi waalmuhajireena waalansari allatheena ittabaAAoohu fee saAAati alAAusrati min baAAdi ma kada yazeeghu quloobu fareeqin minhum thumma taba AAalayhim innahu bihim raoofun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][118]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaAAala alththalathati allatheena khullifoo hatta itha daqat AAalayhimu alardu bima rahubat wadaqat AAalayhim anfusuhum wathannoo an la maljaa mina Allahi illa ilayhi thumma taba AAalayhim liyatooboo inna Allaha huwa alttawwabu alrraheemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][119]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ittaqoo Allaha wakoonoo maAAa alssadiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][120]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ma kana liahli almadeenati waman hawlahum mina alaAArabi an yatakhallafoo AAan rasooli Allahi wala yarghaboo bianfusihim AAan nafsihi thalika biannahum la yuseebuhum thamaon wala nasabun wala makhmasatun fee sabeeli Allahi wala yataoona mawtian yagheethu alkuffara wala yanaloona min AAaduwwin naylan illa kutiba lahum bihi AAamalun salihun inna Allaha la yudeeAAu ajra almuhsineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][121]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala yunfiqoona nafaqatan sagheeratan wala kabeeratan wala yaqtaAAoona wadiyan illa kutiba lahum liyajziyahumu Allahu ahsana ma kanoo yaAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][122]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama kana almuminoona liyanfiroo kaffatan falawla nafara min kulli firqatin minhum taifatun liyatafaqqahoo fee alddeeni waliyunthiroo qawmahum itha rajaAAoo ilayhim laAAallahum yahtharoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][123]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo qatiloo allatheena yaloonakum mina alkuffari walyajidoo feekum ghilthatan waiAAlamoo anna Allaha maAAa almuttaqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][124]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha ma onzilat sooratun faminhum man yaqoolu ayyukum zadathu hathihi eemanan faamma allatheena amanoo fazadathum eemanan wahum yastabshiroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][125]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waamma allatheena fee quloobihim maradun fazadathum rijsan ila rijsihim wamatoo wahum kafiroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][126]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Awala yarawna annahum yuftanoona fee kulli AAamin marratan aw marratayni thumma la yatooboona wala hum yaththakkaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][127]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha ma onzilat sooratun nathara baAAduhum ila baAAdin hal yarakum min ahadin thumma insarafoo sarafa Allahu quloobahum biannahum qawmun la yafqahoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][128]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Laqad jaakum rasoolun min anfusikum AAazeezun AAalayhi ma AAanittum hareesun AAalaykum bialmumineena raoofun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[9][129]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fain tawallaw faqul hasbiya Allahu la ilaha illa huwa AAalayhi tawakkaltu wahuwa rabbu alAAarshi alAAatheemi}
\chapter{Yunus (Jonah)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Aliflamra tilka ayatu alkitabi alhakeemi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Akana lilnnasi AAajaban an awhayna ila rajulin minhum an anthiri alnnasa wabashshiri allatheena amanoo anna lahum qadama sidqin AAinda rabbihim qala alkafiroona inna hatha lasahirun mubeenun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna rabbakumu Allahu allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda fee sittati ayyamin thumma istawa AAala alAAarshi yudabbiru alamra ma min shafeeAAin illa min baAAdi ithnihi thalikumu Allahu rabbukum faoAAbudoohu afala tathakkaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ilayhi marjiAAukum jameeAAan waAAda Allahi haqqan innahu yabdao alkhalqa thumma yuAAeeduhu liyajziya allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati bialqisti waallatheena kafaroo lahum sharabun min hameemin waAAathabun aleemun bima kanoo yakfuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Huwa allathee jaAAala alshshamsa diyaan waalqamara nooran waqaddarahu manazila litaAAlamoo AAadada alssineena waalhisaba ma khalaqa Allahu thalika illa bialhaqqi yufassilu alayati liqawmin yaAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna fee ikhtilafi allayli waalnnahari wama khalaqa Allahu fee alssamawati waalardi laayatin liqawmin yattaqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena la yarjoona liqaana waradoo bialhayati alddunya waitmaannoo biha waallatheena hum AAan ayatina ghafiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Olaika mawahumu alnnaru bima kanoo yaksiboona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati yahdeehim rabbuhum bieemanihim tajree min tahtihimu alanharu fee jannati alnnaAAeemi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{DaAAwahum feeha subhanaka allahumma watahiyyatuhum feeha salamun waakhiru daAAwahum ani alhamdu lillahi rabbi alAAalameena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaw yuAAajjilu Allahu lilnnasi alshsharra istiAAjalahum bialkhayri laqudiya ilayhim ajaluhum fanatharu allatheena la yarjoona liqaana fee tughyanihim yaAAmahoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha massa alinsana alddurru daAAana lijanbihi aw qaAAidan aw qaiman falamma kashafna AAanhu durrahu marra kaan lam yadAAuna ila durrin massahu kathalika zuyyina lilmusrifeena ma kanoo yaAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaqad ahlakna alquroona min qablikum lamma thalamoo wajaathum rusuluhum bialbayyinati wama kanoo liyuminoo kathalika najzee alqawma almujrimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thumma jaAAalnakum khalaifa fee alardi min baAAdihim linanthura kayfa taAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha tutla AAalayhim ayatuna bayyinatin qala allatheena la yarjoona liqaana iti biquranin ghayri hatha aw baddilhu qul ma yakoonu lee an obaddilahu min tilqai nafsee in attabiAAu illa ma yooha ilayya innee akhafu in AAasaytu rabbee AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul law shaa Allahu ma talawtuhu AAalaykum wala adrakum bihi faqad labithtu feekum AAumuran min qablihi afala taAAqiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faman athlamu mimmani iftara AAala Allahi kathiban aw kaththaba biayatihi innahu la yuflihu almujrimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WayaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi ma la yadurruhum wala yanfaAAuhum wayaqooloona haolai shufaAAaona AAinda Allahi qul atunabbioona Allaha bima la yaAAlamu fee alssamawati wala fee alardi subhanahu wataAAala AAamma yushrikoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama kana alnnasu illa ommatan wahidatan faikhtalafoo walawla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laqudiya baynahum feema feehi yakhtalifoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wayaqooloona lawla onzila AAalayhi ayatun min rabbihi faqul innama alghaybu lillahi faintathiroo innee maAAakum mina almuntathireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha athaqna alnnasa rahmatan min baAAdi darraa massathum itha lahum makrun fee ayatina quli Allahu asraAAu makran inna rusulana yaktuboona ma tamkuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Huwa allathee yusayyirukum fee albarri waalbahri hatta itha kuntum fee alfulki wajarayna bihim bireehin tayyibatin wafarihoo biha jaatha reehun AAasifun wajaahumu almawju min kulli makanin wathannoo annahum oheeta bihim daAAawoo Allaha mukhliseena lahu alddeena lain anjaytana min hathihi lanakoonanna mina alshshakireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Falamma anjahum itha hum yabghoona fee alardi bighayri alhaqqi ya ayyuha alnnasu innama baghyukum AAala anfusikum mataAAa alhayati alddunya thumma ilayna marjiAAukum fanunabbiokum bima kuntum taAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Innama mathalu alhayati alddunya kamain anzalnahu mina alssamai faikhtalata bihi nabatu alardi mimma yakulu alnnasu waalanAAamu hatta itha akhathati alardu zukhrufaha waizzayyanat wathanna ahluha annahum qadiroona AAalayha ataha amruna laylan aw naharan fajaAAalnaha haseedan kaan lam taghna bialamsi kathalika nufassilu alayati liqawmin yatafakkaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaAllahu yadAAoo ila dari alssalami wayahdee man yashao ila siratin mustaqeemin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lillatheena ahsanoo alhusna waziyadatun wala yarhaqu wujoohahum qatarun wala thillatun olaika ashabu aljannati hum feeha khalidoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena kasaboo alssayyiati jazao sayyiatin bimithliha watarhaquhum thillatun ma lahum mina Allahi min AAasimin kaannama oghshiyat wujoohuhum qitaAAan mina allayli muthliman olaika ashabu alnnari hum feeha khalidoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wayawma nahshuruhum jameeAAan thumma naqoolu lillatheena ashrakoo makanakum antum washurakaokum fazayyalna baynahum waqala shurakaohum ma kuntum iyyana taAAbudoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fakafa biAllahi shaheedan baynana wabaynakum in kunna AAan AAibadatikum laghafileena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Hunalika tabloo kullu nafsin ma aslafat waruddoo ila Allahi mawlahumu alhaqqi wadalla AAanhum ma kanoo yaftaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul man yarzuqukum mina alssamai waalardi amman yamliku alssamAAa waalabsara waman yukhriju alhayya mina almayyiti wayukhriju almayyita mina alhayyi waman yudabbiru alamra fasayaqooloona Allahu faqul afala tattaqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fathalikumu Allahu rabbukumu alhaqqu famatha baAAda alhaqqi illa alddalalu faanna tusrafoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Kathalika haqqat kalimatu rabbika AAala allatheena fasaqoo annahum la yuminoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul hal min shurakaikum man yabdao alkhalqa thumma yuAAeeduhu quli Allahu yabdao alkhalqa thumma yuAAeeduhu faanna tufakoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul hal min shurakaikum man yahdee ila alhaqqi quli Allahu yahdee lilhaqqi afaman yahdee ila alhaqqi ahaqqu an yuttabaAAa amman la yahiddee illa an yuhda fama lakum kayfa tahkumoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama yattabiAAu aktharuhum illa thannan inna alththanna la yughnee mina alhaqqi shayan inna Allaha AAaleemun bima yafAAaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama kana hatha alquranu an yuftara min dooni Allahi walakin tasdeeqa allathee bayna yadayhi watafseela alkitabi la rayba feehi min rabbi alAAalameena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Am yaqooloona iftarahu qul fatoo bisooratin mithlihi waodAAoo mani istataAAtum min dooni Allahi in kuntum sadiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Bal kaththaboo bima lam yuheetoo biAAilmihi walamma yatihim taweeluhu kathalika kaththaba allatheena min qablihim faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu alththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waminhum man yuminu bihi waminhum man la yuminu bihi warabbuka aAAlamu bialmufsideena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain kaththabooka faqul lee AAamalee walakum AAamalukum antum bareeoona mimma aAAmalu waana bareeon mimma taAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waminhum man yastamiAAoona ilayka afaanta tusmiAAu alssumma walaw kanoo la yaAAqiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waminhum man yanthuru ilayka afaanta tahdee alAAumya walaw kanoo la yubsiroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna Allaha la yathlimu alnnasa shayan walakinna alnnasa anfusahum yathlimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wayawma yahshuruhum kaan lam yalbathoo illa saAAatan mina alnnahari yataAAarafoona baynahum qad khasira allatheena kaththaboo biliqai Allahi wama kanoo muhtadeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waimma nuriyannaka baAAda allathee naAAiduhum aw natawaffayannaka failayna marjiAAuhum thumma Allahu shaheedun AAala ma yafAAaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walikulli ommatin rasoolun faitha jaa rasooluhum qudiya baynahum bialqisti wahum la yuthlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul la amliku linafsee darran wala nafAAan illa ma shaa Allahu likulli ommatin ajalun itha jaa ajaluhum fala yastakhiroona saAAatan wala yastaqdimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul araaytum in atakum AAathabuhu bayatan aw naharan matha yastaAAjilu minhu almujrimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Athumma itha ma waqaAAa amantum bihi alana waqad kuntum bihi tastaAAjiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thumma qeela lillatheena thalamoo thooqoo AAathaba alkhuldi hal tujzawna illa bima kuntum taksiboona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wayastanbioonaka ahaqqun huwa qul ee warabbee innahu lahaqqun wama antum bimuAAjizeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaw anna likulli nafsin thalamat ma fee alardi laiftadat bihi waasarroo alnnadamata lamma raawoo alAAathaba waqudiya baynahum bialqisti wahum la yuthlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ala inna lillahi ma fee alssamawati waalardi ala inna waAAda Allahi haqqun walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Huwa yuhyee wayumeetu wailayhi turjaAAoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha alnnasu qad jaatkum mawAAithatun min rabbikum washifaon lima fee alssudoori wahudan warahmatun lilmumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul bifadli Allahi wabirahmatihi fabithalika falyafrahoo huwa khayrun mimma yajmaAAoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul araaytum ma anzala Allahu lakum min rizqin fajaAAaltum minhu haraman wahalalan qul allahu athina lakum am AAala Allahi taftaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama thannu allatheena yaftaroona AAala Allahi alkathiba yawma alqiyamati inna Allaha lathoo fadlin AAala alnnasi walakinna aktharahum la yashkuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama takoonu fee shanin wama tatloo minhu min quranin wala taAAmaloona min AAamalin illa kunna AAalaykum shuhoodan ith tufeedoona feehi wama yaAAzubu AAan rabbika min mithqali tharratin fee alardi wala fee alssamai wala asghara min thalika wala akbara illa fee kitabin mubeenun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ala inna awliyaa Allahi la khawfun AAalayhim wala hum yahzanoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena amanoo wakanoo yattaqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lahumu albushra fee alhayati alddunya wafee alakhirati la tabdeela likalimati Allahi thalika huwa alfawzu alAAatheemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala yahzunka qawluhum inna alAAizzata lillahi jameeAAan huwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ala inna lillahi man fee alssamawati waman fee alardi wama yattabiAAu allatheena yadAAoona min dooni Allahi shurakaa in yattabiAAoona illa alththanna wain hum illa yakhrusoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Huwa allathee jaAAala lakumu allayla litaskunoo feehi waalnnahara mubsiran inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yasmaAAoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qaloo ittakhatha Allahu waladan subhanahu huwa alghaniyyu lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi in AAindakum min sultanin bihatha ataqooloona AAala Allahi ma la taAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul inna allatheena yaftaroona AAala Allahi alkathiba la yuflihoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{MataAAun fee alddunya thumma ilayna marjiAAuhum thumma nutheequhumu alAAathaba alshshadeeda bima kanoo yakfuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waotlu AAalayhim nabaa noohin ith qala liqawmihi ya qawmi in kana kabura AAalaykum maqamee watathkeeree biayati Allahi faAAala Allahi tawakkaltu faajmiAAoo amrakum washurakaakum thumma la yakun amrukum AAalaykum ghummatan thumma iqdoo ilayya wala tunthirooni}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fain tawallaytum fama saaltukum min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala Allahi waomirtu an akoona mina almuslimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fakaththaboohu fanajjaynahu waman maAAahu fee alfulki wajaAAalnahum khalaifa waaghraqna allatheena kaththaboo biayatina faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu almunthareena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thumma baAAathna min baAAdihi rusulan ila qawmihim fajaoohum bialbayyinati fama kanoo liyuminoo bima kaththaboo bihi min qablu kathalika natbaAAu AAala quloobi almuAAtadeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thumma baAAathna min baAAdihim moosa waharoona ila firAAawna wamalaihi biayatina faistakbaroo wakanoo qawman mujrimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Falamma jaahumu alhaqqu min AAindina qaloo inna hatha lasihrun mubeenun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qala moosa ataqooloona lilhaqqi lamma jaakum asihrun hatha wala yuflihu alssahiroona}

\quranayah[10][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qaloo ajitana litalfitana AAamma wajadna AAalayhi abaana watakoona lakuma alkibriyao fee alardi wama nahnu lakuma bimumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqala firAAawnu itoonee bikulli sahirin AAaleemin}

\quranayah[10][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Falamma jaa alssaharatu qala lahum moosa alqoo ma antum mulqoona}

\quranayah[10][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Falamma alqaw qala moosa ma jitum bihi alssihru inna Allaha sayubtiluhu inna Allaha la yuslihu AAamala almufsideena}

\quranayah[10][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wayuhiqqu Allahu alhaqqa bikalimatihi walaw kariha almujrimoona}

\quranayah[10][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fama amana limoosa illa thurriyyatun min qawmihi AAala khawfin min firAAawna wamalaihim an yaftinahum wainna firAAawna laAAalin fee alardi wainnahu lamina almusrifeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqala moosa ya qawmi in kuntum amantum biAllahi faAAalayhi tawakkaloo in kuntum muslimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faqaloo AAala Allahi tawakkalna rabbana la tajAAalna fitnatan lilqawmi alththalimeena}

\quranayah[10][86]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wanajjina birahmatika mina alqawmi alkafireena}

\quranayah[10][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waawhayna ila moosa waakheehi an tabawwaa liqawmikuma bimisra buyootan waijAAaloo buyootakum qiblatan waaqeemoo alssalata wabashshiri almumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqala moosa rabbana innaka atayta firAAawna wamalaahu zeenatan waamwalan fee alhayati alddunya rabbana liyudilloo AAan sabeelika rabbana itmis AAala amwalihim waoshdud AAala quloobihim fala yuminoo hatta yarawoo alAAathaba alaleema}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][89]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qala qad ojeebat daAAwatukuma faistaqeema wala tattabiAAanni sabeela allatheena la yaAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][90]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wajawazna bibanee israeela albahra faatbaAAahum firAAawnu wajunooduhu baghyan waAAadwan hatta itha adrakahu algharaqu qala amantu annahu la ilaha illa allathee amanat bihi banoo israeela waana mina almuslimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][91]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alana waqad AAasayta qablu wakunta mina almufsideena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][92]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faalyawma nunajjeeka bibadanika litakoona liman khalfaka ayatan wainna katheeran mina alnnasi AAan ayatina laghafiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][93]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaqad bawwana banee israeela mubawwaa sidqin warazaqnahum mina alttayyibati fama ikhtalafoo hatta jaahumu alAAilmu inna rabbaka yaqdee baynahum yawma alqiyamati feema kanoo feehi yakhtalifoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][94]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fain kunta fee shakkin mimma anzalnna ilayka faisali allatheena yaqraoona alkitaba min qablika laqad jaaka alhaqqu min rabbika fala takoonanna mina almumtareena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][95]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala takoonanna mina allatheena kaththaboo biayati Allahi fatakoona mina alkhasireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][96]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena haqqat AAalayhim kalimatu rabbika la yuminoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][97]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaw jaathum kullu ayatin hatta yarawoo alAAathaba alaleema}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][98]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Falawla kanat qaryatun amanat fanafaAAaha eemanuha illa qawma yoonusa lamma amanoo kashafna AAanhum AAathaba alkhizyi fee alhayati alddunya wamattaAAnahum ila heenin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][99]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaw shaa rabbuka laamana man fee alardi kulluhum jameeAAan afaanta tukrihu alnnasa hatta yakoonoo mumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][100]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama kana linafsin an tumina illa biithni Allahi wayajAAalu alrrijsa AAala allatheena la yaAAqiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][101]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Quli onthuroo matha fee alssamawati waalardi wama tughnee alayatu waalnnuthuru AAan qawmin la yuminoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][102]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fahal yantathiroona illa mithla ayyami allatheena khalaw min qablihim qul faintathiroo innee maAAakum mina almuntathireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][103]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thumma nunajjee rusulana waallatheena amanoo kathalika haqqan AAalayna nunjee almumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][104]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul ya ayyuha alnnasu in kuntum fee shakkin min deenee fala aAAbudu allatheena taAAbudoona min dooni Allahi walakin aAAbudu Allaha allathee yatawaffakum waomirtu an akoona mina almumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][105]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waan aqim wajhaka lilddeeni haneefan wala takoonanna mina almushrikeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][106]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala tadAAu min dooni Allahi ma la yanfaAAuka wala yadurruka fain faAAalta fainnaka ithan mina alththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][107]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain yamsaska Allahu bidurrin fala kashifa lahu illa huwa wain yuridka bikhayrin fala radda lifadlihi yuseebu bihi man yashao min AAibadihi wahuwa alghafooru alrraheemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}

\flushleft{Qala hal amanukum AAalayhi illa kama amintukum AAala akheehi min qablu faAllahu khayrun hafithan wahuwa arhamu alrrahimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walamma fatahoo mataAAahum wajadoo bidaAAatahum ruddat ilayhim qaloo ya abana ma nabghee hathihi bidaAAatuna ruddat ilayna wanameeru ahlana wanahfathu akhana wanazdadu kayla baAAeerin thalika kaylun yaseerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qala lan orsilahu maAAakum hatta tutooni mawthiqan mina Allahi latatunnanee bihi illa an yuhata bikum falamma atawhu mawthiqahum qala Allahu AAala ma naqoolu wakeelun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqala ya baniyya la tadkhuloo min babin wahidin waodkhuloo min abwabin mutafarriqatin wama oghnee AAankum mina Allahi min shayin ini alhukmu illa lillahi AAalayhi tawakkaltu waAAalayhi falyatawakkali almutawakkiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walamma dakhaloo min haythu amarahum aboohum ma kana yughnee AAanhum mina Allahi min shayin illa hajatan fee nafsi yaAAqooba qadaha wainnahu lathoo AAilmin lima AAallamnahu walakinna akthara alnnasi la yaAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}

\quranayah[12][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Falamma jahhazahum bijahazihim jaAAala alssiqayata fee rahli akheehi thumma aththana muaththinun ayyatuha alAAeeru innakum lasariqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}

\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qaloo taAllahi laqad AAalimtum ma jina linufsida fee alardi wama kunna sariqeena}
