\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qaloo fama jazaohu in kuntum kathibeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qaloo jazaohu man wujida fee rahlihi fahuwa jazaohu kathalika najzee alththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fabadaa biawAAiyatihim qabla wiAAai akheehi thumma istakhrajaha min wiAAai akheehi kathalika kidna liyoosufa ma kana liyakhutha akhahu fee deeni almaliki illa an yashaa Allahu narfaAAu darajatin man nashao wafawqa kulli thee AAilmin AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qaloo in yasriq faqad saraqa akhun lahu min qablu faasarraha yoosufu fee nafsihi walam yubdiha lahum qala antum sharrun makanan waAllahu aAAlamu bima tasifoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qaloo ya ayyuha alAAazeezu inna lahu aban shaykhan kabeeran fakhuth ahadana makanahu inna naraka mina almuhsineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qala maAAatha Allahi an nakhutha illa man wajadna mataAAana AAindahu inna ithan lathalimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Falamma istayasoo minhu khalasoo najiyyan qala kabeeruhum alam taAAlamoo anna abakum qad akhatha AAalaykum mawthiqan mina Allahi wamin qablu ma farrattum fee yoosufa falan abraha alarda hatta yathana lee abee aw yahkuma Allahu lee wahuwa khayru alhakimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{IrjiAAoo ila abeekum faqooloo ya abana inna ibnaka saraqa wama shahidna illa bima AAalimna wama kunna lilghaybi hafitheena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waisali alqaryata allatee kunna feeha waalAAeera allatee aqbalna feeha wainna lasadiqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qala bal sawwalat lakum anfusukum amran fasabrun jameelun AAasa Allahu an yatiyanee bihim jameeAAan innahu huwa alAAaleemu alhakeemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Watawalla AAanhum waqala ya asafa AAala yoosufa waibyaddat AAaynahu mina alhuzni fahuwa katheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qaloo taAllahi taftao tathkuru yoosufa hatta takoona haradan aw takoona mina alhalikeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][86]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qala innama ashkoo baththee wahuznee ila Allahi waaAAlamu mina Allahi ma la taAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya baniyya ithhaboo fatahassasoo min yoosufa waakheehi wala tayasoo min rawhi Allahi innahu la yayasu min rawhi Allahi illa alqawmu alkafiroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Falamma dakhaloo AAalayhi qaloo ya ayyuha alAAazeezu massana waahlana alddurru wajina bibidaAAatin muzjatin faawfi lana alkayla watasaddaq AAalayna inna Allaha yajzee almutasaddiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][89]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qala hal AAalimtum ma faAAaltum biyoosufa waakheehi ith antum jahiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][90]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qaloo ainnaka laanta yoosufa qala ana yoosufu wahatha akhee qad manna Allahu AAalayna innahu man yattaqi wayasbir fainna Allaha la yudeeAAu ajra almuhsineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][91]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qaloo taAllahi laqad atharaka Allahu AAalayna wain kunna lakhatieena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][92]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qala la tathreeba AAalaykumu alyawma yaghfiru Allahu lakum wahuwa arhamu alrrahimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][93]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ithhaboo biqameesee hatha faalqoohu AAala wajhi abee yati baseeran watoonee biahlikum ajmaAAeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][94]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walamma fasalati alAAeeru qala aboohum innee laajidu reeha yoosufa lawla an tufannidooni}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][95]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qaloo taAllahi innaka lafee dalalika alqadeemi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][96]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Falamma an jaa albasheeru alqahu AAala wajhihi fairtadda baseeran qala alam aqul lakum innee aAAlamu mina Allahi ma la taAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][97]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qaloo ya abana istaghfir lana thunoobana inna kunna khatieena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][98]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qala sawfa astaghfiru lakum rabbee innahu huwa alghafooru alrraheemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][99]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Falamma dakhaloo AAala yoosufa awa ilayhi abawayhi waqala odkhuloo misra in shaa Allahu amineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][100]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WarafaAAa abawayhi AAala alAAarshi wakharroo lahu sujjadan waqala ya abati hatha taweelu ruyaya min qablu qad jaAAalaha rabbee haqqan waqad ahsana bee ith akhrajanee mina alssijni wajaa bikum mina albadwi min baAAdi an nazagha alshshaytanu baynee wabayna ikhwatee inna rabbee lateefun lima yashao innahu huwa alAAaleemu alhakeemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][101]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Rabbi qad ataytanee mina almulki waAAallamtanee min taweeli alahadeethi fatira alssamawati waalardi anta waliyyee fee alddunya waalakhirati tawaffanee musliman waalhiqnee bialssaliheena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][102]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thalika min anbai alghaybi nooheehi ilayka wama kunta ladayhim ith ajmaAAoo amrahum wahum yamkuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][103]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama aktharu alnnasi walaw harasta bimumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][104]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama tasaluhum AAalayhi min ajrin in huwa illa thikrun lilAAalameena}

\flushleft{Wakaayyin min ayatin fee alssamawati waalardi yamurroona AAalayha wahum AAanha muAAridoona}

\quranayah[12][106]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama yuminu aktharuhum biAllahi illa wahum mushrikoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][107]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Afaaminoo an tatiyahum ghashiyatun min AAathabi Allahi aw tatiyahumu alssaAAatu baghtatan wahum la yashAAuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][108]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul hathihi sabeelee adAAoo ila Allahi AAala baseeratin ana wamani ittabaAAanee wasubhana Allahi wama ana mina almushrikeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][109]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama arsalna min qablika illa rijalan noohee ilayhim min ahli alqura afalam yaseeroo fee alardi fayanthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu allatheena min qablihim waladaru alakhirati khayrun lillatheena ittaqaw afala taAAqiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][110]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Hatta itha istayasa alrrusulu wathannoo annahum qad kuthiboo jaahum nasruna fanujjiya man nashao wala yuraddu basuna AAani alqawmi almujrimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][111]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Laqad kana fee qasasihim AAibratun liolee alalbabi ma kana hadeethan yuftara walakin tasdeeqa allathee bayna yadayhi watafseela kulli shayin wahudan warahmatan liqawmin yuminoona}
\chapter{Ar-Ra'd (The Thunder)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Aliflammeemra tilka ayatu alkitabi waallathee onzila ilayka min rabbika alhaqqu walakinna akthara alnnasi la yuminoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allahu allathee rafaAAa alssamawati bighayri AAamadin tarawnaha thumma istawa AAala alAAarshi wasakhkhara alshshamsa waalqamara kullun yajree liajalin musamman yudabbiru alamra yufassilu alayati laAAallakum biliqai rabbikum tooqinoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wahuwa allathee madda alarda wajaAAala feeha rawasiya waanharan wamin kulli alththamarati jaAAala feeha zawjayni ithnayni yughshee allayla alnnahara inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yatafakkaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wafee alardi qitaAAun mutajawiratun wajannatun min aAAnabin wazarAAun wanakheelun sinwanun waghayru sinwanin yusqa bimain wahidin wanufaddilu baAAdaha AAala baAAdin fee alokuli inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yaAAqiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain taAAjab faAAajabun qawluhum aitha kunna turaban ainna lafee khalqin jadeedin olaika allatheena kafaroo birabbihim waolaika alaghlalu fee aAAnaqihim waolaika ashabu alnnari hum feeha khalidoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WayastaAAjiloonaka bialssayyiati qabla alhasanati waqad khalat min qablihimu almathulatu wainna rabbaka lathoo maghfiratin lilnnasi AAala thulmihim wainna rabbaka lashadeedu alAAiqabi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wayaqoolu allatheena kafaroo lawla onzila AAalayhi ayatun min rabbihi innama anta munthirun walikulli qawmin hadin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allahu yaAAlamu ma tahmilu kullu ontha wama tagheedu alarhamu wama tazdadu wakullu shayin AAindahu bimiqdarin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{AAalimu alghaybi waalshshahadati alkabeeru almutaAAali}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Sawaon minkum man asarra alqawla waman jahara bihi waman huwa mustakhfin biallayli wasaribun bialnnahari}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lahu muAAaqqibatun min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi yahfathoonahu min amri Allahi inna Allaha la yughayyiru ma biqawmin hatta yughayyiroo ma bianfusihim waitha arada Allahu biqawmin sooan fala maradda lahu wama lahum min doonihi min walin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Huwa allathee yureekumu albarqa khawfan watamaAAan wayunshio alssahaba alththiqala}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wayusabbihu alrraAAdu bihamdihi waalmalaikatu min kheefatihi wayursilu alssawaAAiqa fayuseebu biha man yashao wahum yujadiloona fee Allahi wahuwa shadeedu almihali}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lahu daAAwatu alhaqqi waallatheena yadAAoona min doonihi la yastajeeboona lahum bishayin illa kabasiti kaffayhi ila almai liyablugha fahu wama huwa bibalighihi wama duAAao alkafireena illa fee dalalin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walillahi yasjudu man fee alssamawati waalardi tawAAan wakarhan wathilaluhum bialghuduwwi waalasali}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul man rabbu alssamawati waalardi quli Allahu qul afaittakhathtum min doonihi awliyaa la yamlikoona lianfusihim nafAAan wala darran qul hal yastawee alaAAma waalbaseeru am hal tastawee alththulumatu waalnnooru am jaAAaloo lillahi shurakaa khalaqoo kakhalqihi fatashabaha alkhalqu AAalayhim quli Allahu khaliqu kulli shayin wahuwa alwahidu alqahharu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Anzala mina alssamai maan fasalat awdiyatun biqadariha faihtamala alssaylu zabadan rabiyan wamimma yooqidoona AAalayhi fee alnnari ibtighaa hilyatin aw mataAAin zabadun mithluhu kathalika yadribu Allahu alhaqqa waalbatila faamma alzzabadu fayathhabu jufaan waamma ma yanfaAAu alnnasa fayamkuthu fee alardi kathalika yadribu Allahu alamthala}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lillatheena istajaboo lirabbihimu alhusna waallatheena lam yastajeeboo lahu law anna lahum ma fee alardi jameeAAan wamithlahu maAAahu laiftadaw bihi olaika lahum sooo alhisabi wamawahum jahannamu wabisa almihadu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Afaman yaAAlamu annama onzila ilayka min rabbika alhaqqu kaman huwa aAAma innama yatathakkaru oloo alalbabi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena yoofoona biAAahdi Allahi wala yanqudoona almeethaqa}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena yasiloona ma amara Allahu bihi an yoosala wayakhshawna rabbahum wayakhafoona sooa alhisabi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena sabaroo ibtighaa wajhi rabbihim waaqamoo alssalata waanfaqoo mimma razaqnahum sirran waAAalaniyatan wayadraoona bialhasanati alssayyiata olaika lahum AAuqba alddari}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Jannatu AAadnin yadkhuloonaha waman salaha min abaihim waazwajihim wathurriyyatihim waalmalaikatu yadkhuloona AAalayhim min kulli babin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Salamun AAalaykum bima sabartum faniAAma AAuqba alddari}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena yanqudoona AAahda Allahi min baAAdi meethaqihi wayaqtaAAoona ma amara Allahu bihi an yoosala wayufsidoona fee alardi olaika lahumu allaAAnatu walahum sooo alddari}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allahu yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashao wayaqdiru wafarihoo bialhayati alddunya wama alhayatu alddunya fee alakhirati illa mataAAun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wayaqoolu allatheena kafaroo lawla onzila AAalayhi ayatun min rabbihi qul inna Allaha yudillu man yashao wayahdee ilayhi man anaba}

\quranayah[13][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena amanoo watatmainnu quloobuhum bithikri Allahi ala bithikri Allahi tatmainnu alquloobu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati tooba lahum wahusnu maabin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Kathalika arsalnaka fee ommatin qad khalat min qabliha omamun litatluwa AAalayhimu allathee awhayna ilayka wahum yakfuroona bialrrahmani qul huwa rabbee la ilaha illa huwa AAalayhi tawakkaltu wailayhi matabi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaw anna quranan suyyirat bihi aljibalu aw quttiAAat bihi alardu aw kullima bihi almawta bal lillahi alamru jameeAAan afalam yayasi allatheena amanoo an law yashao Allahu lahada alnnasa jameeAAan wala yazalu allatheena kafaroo tuseebuhum bima sanaAAoo qariAAatun aw tahullu qareeban min darihim hatta yatiya waAAdu Allahi inna Allaha la yukhlifu almeeAAada}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaqadi istuhzia birusulin min qablika faamlaytu lillatheena kafaroo thumma akhathtuhum fakayfa kana AAiqabi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Afaman huwa qaimun AAala kulli nafsin bima kasabat wajaAAaloo lillahi shurakaa qul sammoohum am tunabbioonahu bima la yaAAlamu fee alardi am bithahirin mina alqawli bal zuyyina lillatheena kafaroo makruhum wasuddoo AAani alssabeeli waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min hadin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lahum AAathabun fee alhayati alddunya walaAAathabu alakhirati ashaqqu wama lahum mina Allahi min waqin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Mathalu aljannati allatee wuAAida almuttaqoona tajree min tahtiha alanharu okuluha daimun wathilluha tilka AAuqba allatheena ittaqaw waAAuqba alkafireena alnnaru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena ataynahumu alkitaba yafrahoona bima onzila ilayka wamina alahzabi man yunkiru baAAdahu qul innama omirtu an aAAbuda Allaha wala oshrika bihi ilayhi adAAoo wailayhi maabi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wakathalika anzalnahu hukman AAarabiyyan walaini ittabaAAta ahwaahum baAAda ma jaaka mina alAAilmi ma laka mina Allahi min waliyyin wala waqin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][38]
\end{Arabic}}

\flushleft{Alkhabeethatu lilkhabeetheena waalkhabeethoona lilkhabeethati waalttayyibatu lilttayyibeena waalttayyiboona lilttayyibati olaika mubarraoona mimma yaqooloona lahum maghfiratun warizqun kareemun}

\begin{Arabic}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][7]

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wawassayna alinsana biwalidayhi hamalathu ommuhu wahnan AAala wahnin wafisaluhu fee AAamayni ani oshkur lee waliwalidayka ilayya almaseeru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain jahadaka AAala an tushrika bee ma laysa laka bihi AAilmun fala tutiAAhuma wasahibhuma fee alddunya maAAroofan waittabiAA sabeela man anaba ilayya thumma ilayya marjiAAukum faonabbiokum bima kuntum taAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya bunayya innaha in taku mithqala habbatin min khardalin fatakun fee sakhratin aw fee alssamawati aw fee alardi yati biha Allahu inna Allaha lateefun khabeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][17]

\flushleft{Ya bunayya aqimi alssalata wamur bialmaAAroofi wainha AAani almunkari waisbir AAala ma asabaka inna thalika min AAazmi alomoori}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala tusaAAAAir khaddaka lilnnasi wala tamshi fee alardi marahan inna Allaha la yuhibbu kulla mukhtalin fakhoorin}

\quranayah[31][19]

\quranayah[31][20]

\flushleft{Alam taraw anna Allaha sakhkhara lakum ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi waasbagha AAalaykum niAAamahu thahiratan wabatinatan wamina alnnasi man yujadilu fee Allahi bighayri AAilmin wala hudan wala kitabin muneerin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha qeela lahumu ittabiAAoo ma anzala Allahu qaloo bal nattabiAAu ma wajadna AAalayhi abaana awalaw kana alshshaytanu yadAAoohum ila AAathabi alssaAAeeri}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}

\flushleft{Waman yuslim wajhahu ila Allahi wahuwa muhsinun faqadi istamsaka bialAAurwati alwuthqa waila Allahi AAaqibatu alomoori}

\quranayah[31][23]

\flushleft{Waman kafara fala yahzunka kufruhu ilayna marjiAAuhum fanunabbiohum bima AAamiloo inna Allaha AAaleemun bithati alssudoori}

\flushleft{Walain saaltahum man khalaqa alssamawati waalarda layaqoolunna Allahu quli alhamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum la yaAAlamoona}

\flushleft{Walaw annama fee alardi min shajaratin aqlamun waalbahru yamudduhu min baAAdihi sabAAatu abhurin ma nafidat kalimatu Allahi inna Allaha AAazeezun hakeemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ma khalqukum wala baAAthukum illa kanafsin wahidatin inna Allaha sameeAAun baseerun}

\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alam tara anna Allaha yooliju allayla fee alnnahari wayooliju alnnahara fee allayli wasakhkhara alshshamsa waalqamara kullun yajree ila ajalin musamman waanna Allaha bima taAAmaloona khabeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][30]
\end{Arabic}}

\flushleft{Alam tara anna alfulka tajree fee albahri biniAAmati Allahi liyuriyakum min ayatihi inna fee thalika laayatin likulli sabbarin shakoorin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha ghashiyahum mawjun kaalththulali daAAawoo Allaha mukhliseena lahu alddeena falamma najjahum ila albarri faminhum muqtasidun wama yajhadu biayatina illa kullu khattarin kafoorin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][33]

\flushleft{Ya ayyuha alnnasu ittaqoo rabbakum waikhshaw yawman la yajzee walidun AAan waladihi wala mawloodun huwa jazin AAan walidihi shayan inna waAAda Allahi haqqun fala taghurrannakumu alhayatu alddunya wala yaghurrannakum biAllahi algharooru}

\chapter{As-Sajdah (The Adoration)}

\quranayah[32][17]

\flushleft{Fala taAAlamu nafsun ma okhfiya lahum min qurrati aAAyunin jazaan bima kanoo yaAAmaloona}

\quranayah[32][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waamma allatheena fasaqoo famawahumu alnnaru kullama aradoo an yakhrujoo minha oAAeedoo feeha waqeela lahum thooqoo AAathaba alnnari allathee kuntum bihi tukaththiboona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][21]

\quranayah[32][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waman athlamu mimman thukkira biayati rabbihi thumma aAArada AAanha inna mina almujrimeena muntaqimoona}

\quranayah[32][23]

\flushleft{WajaAAalna minhum aimmatan yahdoona biamrina lamma sabaroo wakanoo biayatina yooqinoona}

\quranayah[32][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wayaqooloona mata hatha alfathu in kuntum sadiqeena}

\quranayah[32][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul yawma alfathi la yanfaAAu allatheena kafaroo eemanuhum wala hum yuntharoona}

\quranayah[32][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{FaaAArid AAanhum waintathir innahum muntathiroona}
\chapter{Al-Ahzab (The Allies)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu ittaqi Allaha wala tutiAAi alkafireena waalmunafiqeena inna Allaha kana AAaleeman hakeeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaittabiAA ma yooha ilayka min rabbika inna Allaha kana bima taAAmaloona khabeeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Watawakkal AAala Allahi wakafa biAllahi wakeelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ma jaAAala Allahu lirajulin min qalbayni fee jawfihi wama jaAAala azwajakumu allaee tuthahiroona minhunna ommahatikum wama jaAAala adAAiyaakum abnaakum thalikum qawlukum biafwahikum waAllahu yaqoolu alhaqqa wahuwa yahdee alssabeela}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{OdAAoohum liabaihim huwa aqsatu AAinda Allahi fain lam taAAlamoo abaahum faikhwanukum fee alddeeni wamawaleekum walaysa AAalaykum junahun feema akhtatum bihi walakin ma taAAammadat quloobukum wakana Allahu ghafooran raheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alnnabiyyu awla bialmumineena min anfusihim waazwajuhu ommahatuhum waoloo alarhami baAAduhum awla bibaAAdin fee kitabi Allahi mina almumineena waalmuhajireena illa an tafAAaloo ila awliyaikum maAAroofan kana thalika fee alkitabi mastooran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith akhathna mina alnnabiyyeena meethaqahum waminka wamin noohin waibraheema wamoosa waAAeesa ibni maryama waakhathna minhum meethaqan ghaleethan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Liyasala alssadiqeena AAan sidqihim waaAAadda lilkafireena AAathaban aleeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo othkuroo niAAmata Allahi AAalaykum ith jaatkum junoodun faarsalna AAalayhim reehan wajunoodan lam tarawha wakana Allahu bima taAAmaloona baseeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ith jaookum min fawqikum wamin asfala minkum waith zaghati alabsaru wabalaghati alquloobu alhanajira watathunnoona biAllahi alththunoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Hunalika ibtuliya almuminoona wazulziloo zilzalan shadeedan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith yaqoolu almunafiqoona waallatheena fee quloobihim maradun ma waAAadana Allahu warasooluhu illa ghurooran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith qalat taifatun minhum ya ahla yathriba la muqama lakum fairjiAAoo wayastathinu fareequn minhumu alnnabiyya yaqooloona inna buyootana AAawratun wama hiya biAAawratin in yureedoona illa firaran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaw dukhilat AAalayhim min aqtariha thumma suiloo alfitnata laatawha wama talabbathoo biha illa yaseeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaqad kanoo AAahadoo Allaha min qablu la yuwalloona aladbara wakana AAahdu Allahi masoolan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul lan yanfaAAakumu alfiraru in farartum mina almawti awi alqatli waithan la tumattaAAoona illa qaleelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul man tha allathee yaAAsimukum mina Allahi in arada bikum sooan aw arada bikum rahmatan wala yajidoona lahum min dooni Allahi waliyyan wala naseeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qad yaAAlamu Allahu almuAAawwiqeena minkum waalqaileena liikhwanihim halumma ilayna wala yatoona albasa illa qaleelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ashihhatan AAalaykum faitha jaa alkhawfu raaytahum yanthuroona ilayka tadooru aAAyunuhum kaallathee yughsha AAalayhi mina almawti faitha thahaba alkhawfu salaqookum bialsinatin hidadin ashihhatan AAala alkhayri olaika lam yuminoo faahbata Allahu aAAmalahum wakana thalika AAala Allahi yaseeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yahsaboona alahzaba lam yathhaboo wain yati alahzabu yawaddoo law annahum badoona fee alaAArabi yasaloona AAan anbaikum walaw kanoo feekum ma qataloo illa qaleelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Laqad kana lakum fee rasooli Allahi oswatun hasanatun liman kana yarjoo Allaha waalyawma alakhira wathakara Allaha katheeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walamma raa almuminoona alahzaba qaloo hatha ma waAAadana Allahu warasooluhu wasadaqa Allahu warasooluhu wama zadahum illa eemanan watasleeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Mina almumineena rijalun sadaqoo ma AAahadoo Allaha AAalayhi faminhum man qada nahbahu waminhum man yantathiru wama baddaloo tabdeelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Liyajziya Allahu alssadiqeena bisidqihim wayuAAaththiba almunafiqeena in shaa aw yatooba AAalayhim inna Allaha kana ghafooran raheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waradda Allahu allatheena kafaroo bighaythihim lam yanaloo khayran wakafa Allahu almumineena alqitala wakana Allahu qawiyyan AAazeezan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waanzala allatheena thaharoohum min ahli alkitabi min sayaseehim waqathafa fee quloobihimu alrruAAba fareeqan taqtuloona watasiroona fareeqan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waawrathakum ardahum wadiyarahum waamwalahum waardan lam tataooha wakana Allahu AAala kulli shayin qadeeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu qul liazwajika in kuntunna turidna alhayata alddunya wazeenataha fataAAalayna omattiAAkunna waosarrihkunna sarahan jameelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain kuntunna turidna Allaha warasoolahu waalddara alakhirata fainna Allaha aAAadda lilmuhsinati minkunna ajran AAatheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya nisaa alnnabiyyi man yati minkunna bifahishatin mubayyinatin yudaAAaf laha alAAathabu diAAfayni wakana thalika AAala Allahi yaseeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waman yaqnut minkunna lillahi warasoolihi wataAAmal salihan nutiha ajraha marratayni waaAAtadna laha rizqan kareeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya nisaa alnnabiyyi lastunna kaahadin mina alnnisai ini ittaqaytunna fala takhdaAAna bialqawli fayatmaAAa allathee fee qalbihi maradun waqulna qawlan maAAroofan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqarna fee buyootikunna wala tabarrajna tabarruja aljahiliyyati aloola waaqimna alssalata waateena alzzakata waatiAAna Allaha warasoolahu innama yureedu Allahu liyuthhiba AAankumu alrrijsa ahla albayti wayutahhirakum tatheeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waothkurna ma yutla fee buyootikunna min ayati Allahi waalhikmati inna Allaha kana lateefan khabeeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna almuslimeena waalmuslimati waalmumineena waalmuminati waalqaniteena waalqanitati waalssadiqeena waalssadiqati waalssabireena waalssabirati waalkhashiAAeena waalkhashiAAati waalmutasaddiqeena waalmutasaddiqati waalssaimeena waalssaimati waalhafitheena furoojahum waalhafithati waalththakireena Allaha katheeran waalththakirati aAAadda Allahu lahum maghfiratan waajran AAatheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama kana limuminin wala muminatin itha qada Allahu warasooluhu amran an yakoona lahumu alkhiyaratu min amrihim waman yaAAsi Allaha warasoolahu faqad dalla dalalan mubeenan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith taqoolu lillathee anAAama Allahu AAalayhi waanAAamta AAalayhi amsik AAalayka zawjaka waittaqi Allaha watukhfee fee nafsika ma Allahu mubdeehi watakhsha alnnasa waAllahu ahaqqu an takhshahu falamma qada zaydun minha wataran zawwajnakaha likay la yakoona AAala almumineena harajun fee azwaji adAAiyaihim itha qadaw minhunna wataran wakana amru Allahi mafAAoolan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ma kana AAala alnnabiyyi min harajin feema farada Allahu lahu sunnata Allahi fee allatheena khalaw min qablu wakana amru Allahi qadaran maqdooran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena yuballighoona risalati Allahi wayakhshawnahu wala yakhshawna ahadan illa Allaha wakafa biAllahi haseeban}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ma kana muhammadun aba ahadin min rijalikum walakin rasoola Allahi wakhatama alnnabiyyeena wakana Allahu bikulli shayin AAaleeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo othkuroo Allaha thikran katheeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wasabbihoohu bukratan waaseelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Huwa allathee yusallee AAalaykum wamalaikatuhu liyukhrijakum mina alththulumati ila alnnoori wakana bialmumineena raheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Tahiyyatuhum yawma yalqawnahu salamun waaAAadda lahum ajran kareeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu inna arsalnaka shahidan wamubashshiran wanatheeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WadaAAiyan ila Allahi biithnihi wasirajan muneeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wabashshiri almumineena bianna lahum mina Allahi fadlan kabeeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala tutiAAi alkafireena waalmunafiqeena wadaAA athahum watawakkal AAala Allahi wakafa biAllahi wakeelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha nakahtumu almuminati thumma tallaqtumoohunna min qabli an tamassoohunna fama lakum AAalayhinna min AAiddatin taAAtaddoonaha famattiAAoohunna wasarrihoohunna sarahan jameelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu inna ahlalna laka azwajaka allatee atayta ojoorahunna wama malakat yameenuka mimma afaa Allahu AAalayka wabanati AAammika wabanati AAammatika wabanati khalika wabanati khalatika allatee hajarna maAAaka waimraatan muminatan in wahabat nafsaha lilnnabiyyi in arada alnnabiyyu an yastankihaha khalisatan laka min dooni almumineena qad AAalimna ma faradna AAalayhim fee azwajihim wama malakat aymanuhum likayla yakoona AAalayka harajun wakana Allahu ghafooran raheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Turjee man tashao minhunna watuwee ilayka man tashao wamani ibtaghayta mimman AAazalta fala junaha AAalayka thalika adna an taqarra aAAyunuhunna wala yahzanna wayardayna bima ataytahunna kulluhunna waAllahu yaAAlamu ma fee quloobikum wakana Allahu AAaleeman haleeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{La yahillu laka alnnisao min baAAdu wala an tabaddala bihinna min azwajin walaw aAAjabaka husnuhunna illa ma malakat yameenuka wakana Allahu AAala kulli shayin raqeeban}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tadkhuloo buyoota alnnabiyyi illa an yuthana lakum ila taAAamin ghayra nathireena inahu walakin itha duAAeetum faodkhuloo faitha taAAimtum faintashiroo wala mustaniseena lihadeethin inna thalikum kana yuthee alnnabiyya fayastahyee minkum waAllahu la yastahyee mina alhaqqi waitha saaltumoohunna mataAAan faisaloohunna min warai hijabin thalikum atharu liquloobikum waquloobihinna wama kana lakum an tuthoo rasoola Allahi wala an tankihoo azwajahu min baAAdihi abadan inna thalikum kana AAinda Allahi AAatheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{In tubdoo shayan aw tukhfoohu fainna Allaha kana bikulli shayin AAaleeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{La junaha AAalayhinna fee abaihinna wala abnaihinna wala ikhwanihinna wala abnai ikhwanihinna wala abnai akhawatihinna wala nisaihinna wala ma malakat aymanuhunna waittaqeena Allaha inna Allaha kana AAala kulli shayin shaheedan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna Allaha wamalaikatahu yusalloona AAala alnnabiyyi ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo salloo AAalayhi wasallimoo tasleeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena yuthoona Allaha warasoolahu laAAanahumu Allahu fee alddunya waalakhirati waaAAadda lahum AAathaban muheenan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena yuthoona almumineena waalmuminati bighayri ma iktasaboo faqadi ihtamaloo buhtanan waithman mubeenan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu qul liazwajika wabanatika wanisai almumineena yudneena AAalayhinna min jalabeebihinna thalika adna an yuAArafna fala yuthayna wakana Allahu ghafooran raheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lain lam yantahi almunafiqoona waallatheena fee quloobihim maradun waalmurjifoona fee almadeenati lanughriyannaka bihim thumma la yujawiroonaka feeha illa qaleelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{MalAAooneena aynama thuqifoo okhithoo waquttiloo taqteelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Sunnata Allahi fee allatheena khalaw min qablu walan tajida lisunnati Allahi tabdeelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yasaluka alnnasu AAani alssaAAati qul innama AAilmuha AAinda Allahi wama yudreeka laAAalla alssaAAata takoonu qareeban}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna Allaha laAAana alkafireena waaAAadda lahum saAAeeran}

\quranayah[33][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Khalideena feeha abadan la yajidoona waliyyan wala naseeran}

\quranayah[33][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yawma tuqallabu wujoohuhum fee alnnari yaqooloona ya laytana ataAAna Allaha waataAAna alrrasoola}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqaloo rabbana inna ataAAna sadatana wakubaraana faadalloona alssabeela}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Rabbana atihim diAAfayni mina alAAathabi wailAAanhum laAAnan kabeeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la takoonoo kaallatheena athaw moosa fabarraahu Allahu mimma qaloo wakana AAinda Allahi wajeehan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ittaqoo Allaha waqooloo qawlan sadeedan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yuslih lakum aAAmalakum wayaghfir lakum thunoobakum waman yutiAAi Allaha warasoolahu faqad faza fawzan AAatheeman}

\quranayah[33][72]

\flushleft{Inna AAaradna alamanata AAala alssamawati waalardi waaljibali faabayna an yahmilnaha waashfaqna minha wahamalaha alinsanu innahu kana thalooman jahoolan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][73]

\flushleft{LiyuAAaththiba Allahu almunafiqeena waalmunafiqati waalmushrikeena waalmushrikati wayatooba Allahu AAala almumineena waalmuminati wakana Allahu ghafooran raheeman}
\chapter{Al-Saba' (The Saba')}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alhamdu lillahi allathee lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi walahu alhamdu fee alakhirati wahuwa alhakeemu alkhabeeru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{YaAAlamu ma yaliju fee alardi wama yakhruju minha wama yanzilu mina alssamai wama yaAAruju feeha wahuwa alrraheemu alghafooru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqala allatheena kafaroo la tateena alssaAAatu qul bala warabbee latatiyannakum AAalimi alghaybi la yaAAzubu AAanhu mithqalu tharratin fee alssamawati wala fee alardi wala asgharu min thalika wala akbaru illa fee kitabin mubeenin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Liyajziya allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati olaika lahum maghfiratun warizqun kareemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena saAAaw fee ayatina muAAajizeena olaika lahum AAathabun min rijzin aleemin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wayara allatheena ootoo alAAilma allathee onzila ilayka min rabbika huwa alhaqqa wayahdee ila sirati alAAazeezi alhameedi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqala allatheena kafaroo hal nadullukum AAala rajulin yunabbiokum itha muzziqtum kulla mumazzaqin innakum lafee khalqin jadeedin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Aftara AAala Allahi kathiban am bihi jinnatun bali allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati fee alAAathabi waalddalali albaAAeedi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Afalam yaraw ila ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum mina alssamai waalardi in nasha nakhsif bihimu alarda aw nusqit AAalayhim kisafan mina alssamai inna fee thalika laayatan likulli AAabdin muneebin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaqad atayna dawooda minna fadlan ya jibalu awwibee maAAahu waalttayra waalanna lahu alhadeeda}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ani iAAmal sabighatin waqaddir fee alssardi waiAAmaloo salihan innee bima taAAmaloona baseerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walisulaymana alrreeha ghuduwwuha shahrun warawahuha shahrun waasalna lahu AAayna alqitri wamina aljinni man yaAAmalu bayna yadayhi biithni rabbihi waman yazigh minhum AAan amrina nuthiqhu min AAathabi alssaAAeeri}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{YaAAmaloona lahu ma yashao min mahareeba watamatheela wajifanin kaaljawabi waqudoorin rasiyatin iAAmaloo ala dawooda shukran waqaleelun min AAibadiya alshshakooru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Falamma qadayna AAalayhi almawta ma dallahum AAala mawtihi illa dabbatu alardi takulu minsaatahu falamma kharra tabayyanati aljinnu an law kanoo yaAAlamoona alghayba ma labithoo fee alAAathabi almuheeni}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Laqad kana lisabain fee maskanihim ayatun jannatani AAan yameenin washimalin kuloo min rizqi rabbikum waoshkuroo lahu baldatun tayyibatun warabbun ghafoorun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{FaaAAradoo faarsalna AAalayhim sayla alAAarimi wabaddalnahum bijannatayhim jannatayni thawatay okulin khamtin waathlin washayin min sidrin qaleelin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thalika jazaynahum bima kafaroo wahal nujazee illa alkafoora}

\quranayah[34][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WajaAAalna baynahum wabayna alqura allatee barakna feeha quran thahiratan waqaddarna feeha alssayra seeroo feeha layaliya waayyaman amineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faqaloo rabbana baAAid bayna asfarina wathalamoo anfusahum fajaAAalnahum ahadeetha wamazzaqnahum kulla mumazzaqin inna fee thalika laayatin likulli sabbarin shakoorin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaqad saddaqa AAalayhim ibleesu thannahu faittabaAAoohu illa fareeqan mina almumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama kana lahu AAalayhim min sultanin illa linaAAlama man yuminu bialakhirati mimman huwa minha fee shakkin warabbuka AAala kulli shayin hafeethun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Quli odAAoo allatheena zaAAamtum min dooni Allahi la yamlikoona mithqala tharratin fee alssamawati wala fee alardi wama lahum feehima min shirkin wama lahu minhum min thaheerin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala tanfaAAu alshshafaAAatu AAindahu illa liman athina lahu hatta itha fuzziAAa AAan quloobihim qaloo matha qala rabbukum qaloo alhaqqa wahuwa alAAaliyyu alkabeeru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul man yarzuqukum mina alssamawati waalardi quli Allahu wainna aw iyyakum laAAala hudan aw fee dalalin mubeenin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul la tusaloona AAamma ajramna wala nusalu AAamma taAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul yajmaAAu baynana rabbuna thumma yaftahu baynana bialhaqqi wahuwa alfattahu alAAaleemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul arooniya allatheena alhaqtum bihi shurakaa kalla bal huwa Allahu alAAazeezu alhakeemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama arsalnaka illa kaffatan lilnnasi basheeran wanatheeran walakinna akthara alnnasi la yaAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul lakum meeAAadu yawmin la tastakhiroona AAanhu saAAatan wala tastaqdimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqala allatheena kafaroo lan numina bihatha alqurani wala biallathee bayna yadayhi walaw tara ithi alththalimoona mawqoofoona AAinda rabbihim yarjiAAu baAAduhum ila baAAdin alqawla yaqoolu allatheena istudAAifoo lillatheena istakbaroo lawla antum lakunna mumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qala allatheena istakbaroo lillatheena istudAAifoo anahnu sadadnakum AAani alhuda baAAda ith jaakum bal kuntum mujrimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqala allatheena istudAAifoo lillatheena istakbaroo bal makru allayli waalnnahari ith tamuroonana an nakfura biAllahi wanajAAala lahu andadan waasarroo alnnadamata lamma raawoo alAAathaba wajaAAalna alaghlala fee aAAnaqi allatheena kafaroo hal yujzawna illa ma kanoo yaAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama arsalna fee qaryatin min natheerin illa qala mutrafooha inna bima orsiltum bihi kafiroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqaloo nahnu aktharu amwalan waawladan wama nahnu bimuAAaththabeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul inna rabbee yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashao wayaqdiru walakinna akthara alnnasi la yaAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama amwalukum wala awladukum biallatee tuqarribukum AAindana zulfa illa man amana waAAamila salihan faolaika lahum jazao alddiAAfi bima AAamiloo wahum fee alghurufati aminoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena yasAAawna fee ayatina muAAajizeena olaika fee alAAathabi muhdaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul inna rabbee yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashao min AAibadihi wayaqdiru lahu wama anfaqtum min shayin fahuwa yukhlifuhu wahuwa khayru alrraziqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wayawma yahshuruhum jameeAAan thumma yaqoolu lilmalaikati ahaolai iyyakum kanoo yaAAbudoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qaloo subhanaka anta waliyyuna min doonihim bal kanoo yaAAbudoona aljinna aktharuhum bihim muminoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faalyawma la yamliku baAAdukum libaAAdin nafAAan wala darran wanaqoolu lillatheena thalamoo thooqoo AAathaba alnnari allatee kuntum biha tukaththiboona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha tutla AAalayhim ayatuna bayyinatin qaloo ma hatha illa rajulun yureedu an yasuddakum AAamma kana yaAAbudu abaokum waqaloo ma hatha illa ifkun muftaran waqala allatheena kafaroo lilhaqqi lamma jaahum in hatha illa sihrun mubeenun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama ataynahum min kutubin yadrusoonaha wama arsalna ilayhim qablaka min natheerin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wakaththaba allatheena min qablihim wama balaghoo miAAshara ma ataynahum fakaththaboo rusulee fakayfa kana nakeeri}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul innama aAAithukum biwahidatin an taqoomoo lillahi mathna wafurada thumma tatafakkaroo ma bisahibikum min jinnatin in huwa illa natheerun lakum bayna yaday AAathabin shadeedin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul ma saaltukum min ajrin fahuwa lakum in ajriya illa AAala Allahi wahuwa AAala kulli shayin shaheedun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul inna rabbee yaqthifu bialhaqqi AAallamu alghuyoobi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul jaa alhaqqu wama yubdio albatilu wama yuAAeedu}

\quranayah[34][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul in dalaltu fainnama adillu AAala nafsee waini ihtadaytu fabima yoohee ilayya rabbee innahu sameeAAun qareebun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaw tara ith faziAAoo fala fawta waokhithoo min makanin qareebin}

\chapter{Al-Fatir (The Originator)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alhamdu lillahi fatiri alssamawati waalardi jaAAili almalaikati rusulan olee ajnihatin mathna wathulatha warubaAAa yazeedu fee alkhalqi ma yashao inna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ma yaftahi Allahu lilnnasi min rahmatin fala mumsika laha wama yumsik fala mursila lahu min baAAdihi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha alnnasu othkuroo niAAmata Allahi AAalaykum hal min khaliqin ghayru Allahi yarzuqukum mina alssamai waalardi la ilaha illa huwa faanna tufakoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][4]
\end{Arabic}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}

\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha alnnasu inna waAAda Allahi haqqun fala taghurrannakumu alhayatu alddunya wala yaghurrannakum biAllahi algharooru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna alshshaytana lakum AAaduwwun faittakhithoohu AAaduwwan innama yadAAoo hizbahu liyakoonoo min ashabi alssaAAeeri}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena kafaroo lahum AAathabun shadeedun waallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum maghfiratun waajrun kabeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Afaman zuyyina lahu sooo AAamalihi faraahu hasanan fainna Allaha yudillu man yashao wayahdee man yashao fala tathhab nafsuka AAalayhim hasaratin inna Allaha AAaleemun bima yasnaAAoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaAllahu allathee arsala alrriyaha fatutheeru sahaban fasuqnahu ila baladin mayyitin faahyayna bihi alarda baAAda mawtiha kathalika alnnushooru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Man kana yureedu alAAizzata falillahi alAAizzatu jameeAAan ilayhi yasAAadu alkalimu alttayyibu waalAAamalu alssalihu yarfaAAuhu waallatheena yamkuroona alssayyiati lahum AAathabun shadeedun wamakru olaika huwa yabooru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaAllahu khalaqakum min turabin thumma min nutfatin thumma jaAAalakum azwajan wama tahmilu min ontha wala tadaAAu illa biAAilmihi wama yuAAammaru min muAAammarin wala yunqasu min AAumurihi illa fee kitabin inna thalika AAala Allahi yaseerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama yastawee albahrani hatha AAathbun furatun saighun sharabuhu wahatha milhun ojajun wamin kullin takuloona lahman tariyyan watastakhrijoona hilyatan talbasoonaha watara alfulka feehi mawakhira litabtaghoo min fadlihi walaAAallakum tashkuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yooliju allayla fee alnnahari wayooliju alnnahara fee allayli wasakhkhara alshshamsa waalqamara kullun yajree liajalin musamman thalikumu Allahu rabbukum lahu almulku waallatheena tadAAoona min doonihi ma yamlikoona min qitmeerin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{In tadAAoohum la yasmaAAoo duAAaakum walaw samiAAoo ma istajaboo lakum wayawma alqiyamati yakfuroona bishirkikum wala yunabbioka mithlu khabeerin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha alnnasu antumu alfuqarao ila Allahi waAllahu huwa alghaniyyu alhameedu}

\quranayah[35][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{In yasha yuthhibkum wayati bikhalqin jadeedin}

\quranayah[35][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama thalika AAala Allahi biAAazeezin}

\quranayah[35][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala taziru waziratun wizra okhra wain tadAAu muthqalatun ila himliha la yuhmal minhu shayon walaw kana tha qurba innama tunthiru allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum bialghaybi waaqamoo alssalata waman tazakka fainnama yatazakka linafsihi waila Allahi almaseeru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama yastawee alaAAma waalbaseeru}

\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala alththulumatu wala alnnooru}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama yastawee alahyao wala alamwatu inna Allaha yusmiAAu man yashao wama anta bimusmiAAin man fee alquboori}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{In anta illa natheerun}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wamina alnnasi waalddawabbi waalanAAami mukhtalifun alwanuhu kathalika innama yakhsha Allaha min AAibadihi alAAulamao inna Allaha AAazeezun ghafoorun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][29]
\end{Arabic}}

\quranayah[35][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thumma awrathna alkitaba allatheena istafayna min AAibadina faminhum thalimun linafsihi waminhum muqtasidun waminhum sabiqun bialkhayrati biithni Allahi thalika huwa alfadlu alkabeeru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][33]

\flushleft{Jannatu AAadnin yadkhuloonaha yuhallawna feeha min asawira min thahabin waluluan walibasuhum feeha hareerun}

\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqaloo alhamdu lillahi allathee athhaba AAanna alhazana inna rabbana laghafoorun shakoorun}

\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allathee ahallana dara almuqamati min fadlihi la yamassuna feeha nasabun wala yamassuna feeha lughoobun}

\quranayah[35][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena kafaroo lahum naru jahannama la yuqda AAalayhim fayamootoo wala yukhaffafu AAanhum min AAathabiha kathalika najzee kulla kafoorin}

\flushleft{Huwa allathee jaAAalakum khalaifa fee alardi faman kafara faAAalayhi kufruhu wala yazeedu alkafireena kufruhum AAinda rabbihim illa maqtan wala yazeedu alkafireena kufruhum illa khasaran}

\quranayah[35][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul araaytum shurakaakumu allatheena tadAAoona min dooni Allahi aroonee matha khalaqoo mina alardi am lahum shirkun fee alssamawati am ataynahum kitaban fahum AAala bayyinatin minhu bal in yaAAidu alththalimoona baAAduhum baAAdan illa ghurooran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna Allaha yumsiku alssamawati waalarda an tazoola walain zalata in amsakahuma min ahadin min baAAdihi innahu kana haleeman ghafooran}

\quranayah[35][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waaqsamoo biAllahi jahda aymanihim lain jaahum natheerun layakoonunna ahda min ihda alomami falamma jaahum natheerun ma zadahum illa nufooran}

\quranayah[35][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Istikbaran fee alardi wamakra alssayyii wala yaheequ almakru alssayyio illa biahlihi fahal yanthuroona illa sunnata alawwaleena falan tajida lisunnati Allahi tabdeelan walan tajida lisunnati Allahi tahweelan}

\quranayah[35][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Awalam yaseeroo fee alardi fayanthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu allatheena min qablihim wakanoo ashadda minhum quwwatan wama kana Allahu liyuAAjizahu min shayin fee alssamawati wala fee alardi innahu kana AAaleeman qadeeran}

\quranayah[35][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaw yuakhithu Allahu alnnasa bima kasaboo ma taraka AAala thahriha min dabbatin walakin yuakhkhiruhum ila ajalin musamman faitha jaa ajaluhum fainna Allaha kana biAAibadihi baseeran}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}

\flushleft{Waamma thamoodu fahadaynahum faistahabboo alAAama AAala alhuda faakhathathum saAAiqatu alAAathabi alhooni bima kanoo yaksiboona}

\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waqaloo lijuloodihim lima shahidtum AAalayna qaloo antaqana Allahu allathee antaqa kulla shayin wahuwa khalaqakum awwala marratin wailayhi turjaAAoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}

\flushleft{Wama kuntum tastatiroona an yashhada AAalaykum samAAukum wala absarukum wala juloodukum walakin thanantum anna Allaha la yaAAlamu katheeran mimma taAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}

\flushleft{Waqayyadna lahum quranaa fazayyanoo lahum ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum wahaqqa AAalayhimu alqawlu fee omamin qad khalat min qablihim mina aljinni waalinsi innahum kanoo khasireena}

\end{Arabic}}

\quranayah[41][28]
\end{Arabic}}

\flushleft{Inna allatheena qaloo rabbuna Allahu thumma istaqamoo tatanazzalu AAalayhimu almalaikatu alla takhafoo wala tahzanoo waabshiroo bialjannati allatee kuntum tooAAadoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Nahnu awliyaokum fee alhayati alddunya wafee alakhirati walakum feeha ma tashtahee anfusukum walakum feeha ma taddaAAoona}

\end{Arabic}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}

\flushleft{Waman ahsanu qawlan mimman daAAa ila Allahi waAAamila salihan waqala innanee mina almuslimeena}

\flushleft{Wala tastawee alhasanatu wala alssayyiatu idfaAA biallatee hiya ahsanu faitha allathee baynaka wabaynahu AAadawatun kaannahu waliyyun hameemun}

\flushleft{Wamin ayatihi allaylu waalnnaharu waalshshamsu waalqamaru la tasjudoo lilshshamsi wala lilqamari waosjudoo lillahi alathee khalaqahunna in kuntum iyyahu taAAbudoona}

\quranayah[41][38]

\quranayah[41][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{La yasamu alinsanu min duAAai alkhayri wain massahu alshsharru fayaoosun qanootun}

\quranayah[41][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walain athaqnahu rahmatan minna min baAAdi darraa massathu layaqoolanna hatha lee wama athunnu alssaAAata qaimatan walain rujiAAtu ila rabbee inna lee AAindahu lalhusna falanunabbianna allatheena kafaroo bima AAamiloo walanutheeqannahum min AAathabin ghaleethin}

\flushleft{Fatiru alssamawati waalardi jaAAala lakum min anfusikum azwajan wamina alanAAami azwajan yathraokum feehi laysa kamithlihi shayon wahuwa alssameeAAu albaseeru}

\end{Arabic}}

\quranayah[42][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Am lahum shurakao sharaAAoo lahum mina alddeeni ma lam yathan bihi Allahu walawla kalimatu alfasli laqudiya baynahum wainna alththalimeena lahum AAathabun aleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][22]
\end{Arabic}}

\flushleft{Thalika allathee yubashshiru Allahu AAibadahu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati qul la asalukum AAalayhi ajran illa almawaddata fee alqurba waman yaqtarif hasanatan nazid lahu feeha husnan inna Allaha ghafoorun shakoorun}

\quranayah[42][24]
\end{Arabic}}

\end{Arabic}}

\flushleft{Wakathalika awhayna ilayka roohan min amrina ma kunta tadree ma alkitabu wala aleemanu walakin jaAAalnahu nooran nahdee bihi man nashao min AAibadina wainnaka latahdee ila siratin mustaqeemin}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][6]

\chapter{Al-Ahqaf (The Sandhills)}
\begin{Arabic}

\flushleft{Hameem}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}

\quranayah[46][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ma khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma illa bialhaqqi waajalin musamman waallatheena kafaroo AAamma onthiroo muAAridoona}

\quranayah[46][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul araaytum ma tadAAoona min dooni Allahi aroonee matha khalaqoo mina alardi am lahum shirkun fee alssamawati eetoonee bikitabin min qabli hatha aw atharatin min AAilmin in kuntum sadiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][5]

\quranayah[46][6]

\quranayah[46][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha tutla AAalayhim ayatuna bayyinatin qala allatheena kafaroo lilhaqqi lamma jaahum hatha sihrun mubeenun}

\quranayah[46][8]

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][9]
\end{Arabic}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul araaytum in kana min AAindi Allahi wakafartum bihi washahida shahidun min banee israeela AAala mithlihi faamana waistakbartum inna Allaha la yahdee alqawma alththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][11]

\quranayah[46][12]
\end{Arabic}}

\quranayah[46][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena qaloo rabbuna Allahu thumma istaqamoo fala khawfun AAalayhim wala hum yahzanoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Olaika ashabu aljannati khalideena feeha jazaan bima kanoo yaAAmaloona}

\quranayah[46][15]

\flushleft{Wawassayna alinsana biwalidayhi ihsanan hamalathu ommuhu kurhan wawadaAAathu kurhan wahamluhu wafisaluhu thalathoona shahran hatta itha balagha ashuddahu wabalagha arbaAAeena sanatan qala rabbi awziAAnee an ashkura niAAmataka allatee anAAamta AAalayya waAAala walidayya waan aAAmala salihan tardahu waaslih lee fee thurriyyatee innee tubtu ilayka wainnee mina almuslimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Olaika allatheena nataqabbalu AAanhum ahsana ma AAamiloo wanatajawazu AAan sayyiatihim fee ashabi aljannati waAAda alssidqi allathee kanoo yooAAadoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallathee qala liwalidayhi offin lakuma ataAAidaninee an okhraja waqad khalati alquroonu min qablee wahuma yastagheethani Allaha waylaka amin inna waAAda Allahi haqqun fayaqoolu ma hatha illa asateeru alawwaleena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Olaika allatheena haqqa AAalayhimu alqawlu fee umamin qad khalat min qablihim mina aljinni waalinsi innahum kanoo khasireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walikullin darajatun mimma AAamiloo waliyuwaffiyahum aAAmalahum wahum la yuthlamoona}

\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wayawma yuAAradu allatheena kafaroo AAala alnnari athhabtum tayyibatikum fee hayatikumu alddunya waistamtaAAtum biha faalyawma tujzawna AAathaba alhooni bima kuntum tastakbiroona fee alardi bighayri alhaqqi wabima kuntum tafsuqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waothkur akha AAadin ith anthara qawmahu bialahqafi waqad khalati alnnuthuru min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi alla taAAbudoo illa Allaha innee akhafu AAalaykum AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][22]

\flushleft{Qaloo ajitana litafikana AAan alihatina fatina bima taAAiduna in kunta mina alssadiqeena}

\quranayah[46][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qala innama alAAilmu AAinda Allahi waoballighukum ma orsiltu bihi walakinnee arakum qawman tajhaloona}

\quranayah[46][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Falamma raawhu AAaridan mustaqbila awdiyatihim qaloo hatha AAaridun mumtiruna bal huwa ma istaAAjaltum bihi reehun feeha AAathabun aleemun}

\quranayah[46][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Tudammiru kulla shayin biamri rabbiha faasbahoo la yura illa masakinuhum kathalika najzee alqawma almujrimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaqad makkannahum feema in makkannakum feehi wajaAAalna lahum samAAan waabsaran waafidatan fama aghna AAanhum samAAuhum wala absaruhum wala afidatuhum min shayin ith kanoo yajhadoona biayati Allahi wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaqad ahlakna ma hawlakum mina alqura wasarrafna alayati laAAallahum yarjiAAoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Falawla nasarahumu allatheena ittakhathoo min dooni Allahi qurbanan alihatan bal dalloo AAanhum wathalika ifkuhum wama kanoo yaftaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith sarafna ilayka nafaran mina aljinni yastamiAAoona alqurana falamma hadaroohu qaloo ansitoo falamma qudiya wallaw ila qawmihim munthireena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qaloo ya qawmana inna samiAAna kitaban onzila min baAAdi moosa musaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi yahdee ila alhaqqi waila tareeqin mustaqeemin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya qawmana ajeeboo daAAiya Allahi waaminoo bihi yaghfir lakum min thunoobikum wayujirkum min AAathabin aleemin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waman la yujib daAAiya Allahi falaysa bimuAAjizin fee alardi walaysa lahu min doonihi awliyaa olaika fee dalalin mubeenin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Awalam yaraw anna Allaha allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda walam yaAAya bikhalqihinna biqadirin AAala an yuhyiya almawta bala innahu AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wayawma yuAAradu allatheena kafaroo AAala alnnari alaysa hatha bialhaqqi qaloo bala warabbina qala fathooqoo alAAathaba bima kuntum takfuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][35]

\flushleft{Faisbir kama sabara oloo alAAazmi mina alrrusuli wala tastaAAjil lahum kaannahum yawma yarawna ma yooAAadoona lam yalbathoo illa saAAatan min naharin balaghun fahal yuhlaku illa alqawmu alfasiqoona}

\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}

\flushleft{Allatheena kafaroo wasaddoo AAan sabeeli Allahi adalla aAAmalahum}

\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati waamanoo bima nuzzila AAala muhammadin wahuwa alhaqqu min rabbihim kaffara AAanhum sayyiatihim waaslaha balahum}

\quranayah[47][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thalika bianna allatheena kafaroo ittabaAAoo albatila waanna allatheena amanoo ittabaAAoo alhaqqa min rabbihim kathalika yadribu Allahu lilnnasi amthalahum}
