\quranayah[47][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faitha laqeetumu allatheena kafaroo fadarba alrriqabi hatta itha athkhantumoohum fashuddoo alwathaqa faimma mannan baAAdu waimma fidaan hatta tadaAAa alharbu awzaraha thalika walaw yashao Allahu laintasara minhum walakin liyabluwa baAAdakum bibaAAdin waallatheena qutiloo fee sabeeli Allahi falan yudilla aAAmalahum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Sayahdeehim wayuslihu balahum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wayudkhiluhumu aljannata AAarrafaha lahum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo in tansuroo Allaha yansurkum wayuthabbit aqdamakum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena kafaroo fataAAsan lahum waadalla aAAmalahum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thalika biannahum karihoo ma anzala Allahu faahbata aAAmalahum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Afalam yaseeroo fee alardi fayanthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu allatheena min qablihim dammara Allahu AAalayhim walilkafireena amthaluha}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thalika bianna Allaha mawla allatheena amanoo waanna alkafireena la mawla lahum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna Allaha yudkhilu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu waallatheena kafaroo yatamattaAAoona wayakuloona kama takulu alanAAamu waalnnaru mathwan lahum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wakaayyin min qaryatin hiya ashaddu quwwatan min qaryatika allatee akhrajatka ahlaknahum fala nasira lahum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Afaman kana AAala bayyinatin min rabbihi kaman zuyyina lahu sooo AAamalihi waittabaAAoo ahwaahum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Mathalu aljannati allatee wuAAida almuttaqoona feeha anharun min main ghayri asinin waanharun min labanin lam yataghayyar taAAmuhu waanharun min khamrin laththatin lilshsharibeena waanharun min AAasalin musaffan walahum feeha min kulli alththamarati wamaghfiratun min rabbihim kaman huwa khalidun fee alnnari wasuqoo maan hameeman faqattaAAa amAAaahum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waminhum man yastamiAAu ilayka hatta itha kharajoo min AAindika qaloo lillatheena ootoo alAAilma matha qala anifan olaika allatheena tabaAAa Allahu AAala quloobihim waittabaAAoo ahwaahum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena ihtadaw zadahum hudan waatahum taqwahum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fahal yanthuroona illa alssaAAata an tatiyahum baghtatan faqad jaa ashratuha faanna lahum itha jaathum thikrahum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{FaiAAlam annahu la ilaha illa Allahu waistaghfir lithanbika walilmumineena waalmuminati waAllahu yaAAlamu mutaqallabakum wamathwakum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wayaqoolu allatheena amanoo lawla nuzzilat sooratun faitha onzilat sooratun muhkamatun wathukira feeha alqitalu raayta allatheena fee quloobihim maradun yanthuroona ilayka nathara almaghshiyyi AAalayhi mina almawti faawla lahum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{TaAAatun waqawlun maAAroofun faitha AAazama alamru falaw sadaqoo Allaha lakana khayran lahum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fahal AAasaytum in tawallaytum an tufsidoo fee alardi watuqattiAAoo arhamakum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Olaika allatheena laAAanahumu Allahu faasammahum waaAAma absarahum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Afala yatadabbaroona alqurana am AAala quloobin aqfaluha}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena irtaddoo AAala adbarihim min baAAdi ma tabayyana lahumu alhuda alshshaytanu sawwala lahum waamla lahum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thalika biannahum qaloo lillatheena karihoo ma nazzala Allahu sanuteeAAukum fee baAAdi alamri waAllahu yaAAlamu israrahum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fakayfa itha tawaffathumu almalaikatu yadriboona wujoohahum waadbarahum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thalika biannahumu ittabaAAoo ma askhata Allaha wakarihoo ridwanahu faahbata aAAmalahum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Am hasiba allatheena fee quloobihim maradun an lan yukhrija Allahu adghanahum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaw nashao laaraynakahum falaAAaraftahum biseemahum walataAArifannahum fee lahni alqawli waAllahu yaAAlamu aAAmalakum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walanabluwannakum hatta naAAlama almujahideena minkum waalssabireena wanabluwa akhbarakum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena kafaroo wasaddoo AAan sabeeli Allahi washaqqoo alrrasoola min baAAdi ma tabayyana lahumu alhuda lan yaduroo Allaha shayan wasayuhbitu aAAmalahum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ateeAAoo Allaha waateeAAoo alrrasoola wala tubtiloo aAAmalakum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena kafaroo wasaddoo AAan sabeeli Allahi thumma matoo wahum kuffarun falan yaghfira Allahu lahum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fala tahinoo watadAAoo ila alssalmi waantumu alaAAlawna waAllahu maAAakum walan yatirakum aAAmalakum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Innama alhayatu alddunya laAAibun walahwun wain tuminoo watattaqoo yutikum ojoorakum wala yasalkum amwalakum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{In yasalkumooha fayuhfikum tabkhaloo wayukhrij adghanakum}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Haantum haolai tudAAawna litunfiqoo fee sabeeli Allahi faminkum man yabkhalu waman yabkhal fainnama yabkhalu AAan nafsihi waAllahu alghaniyyu waantumu alfuqarao wain tatawallaw yastabdil qawman ghayrakum thumma la yakoonoo amthalakum}
\chapter{Al-Fath (The Victory)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna fatahna laka fathan mubeenan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Liyaghfira laka Allahu ma taqaddama min thanbika wama taakhkhara wayutimma niAAmatahu AAalayka wayahdiyaka siratan mustaqeeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wayansuraka Allahu nasran AAazeezan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Huwa allathee anzala alssakeenata fee quloobi almumineena liyazdadoo eemanan maAAa eemanihim walillahi junoodu alssamawati waalardi wakana Allahu AAaleeman hakeeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Liyudkhila almumineena waalmuminati jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha wayukaffira AAanhum sayyiatihim wakana thalika AAinda Allahi fawzan AAatheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WayuAAaththiba almunafiqeena waalmunafiqati waalmushrikeena waalmushrikati alththanneena biAllahi thanna alssawi AAalayhim dairatu alssawi waghadiba Allahu AAalayhim walaAAanahum waaAAadda lahum jahannama wasaat maseeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walillahi junoodu alssamawati waalardi wakana Allahu AAazeezan hakeeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna arsalnaka shahidan wamubashshiran wanatheeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lituminoo biAllahi warasoolihi watuAAazziroohu watuwaqqiroohu watusabbihoohu bukratan waaseelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena yubayiAAoonaka innama yubayiAAoona Allaha yadu Allahi fawqa aydeehim faman nakatha fainnama yankuthu AAala nafsihi waman awfa bima AAahada AAalayhu Allaha fasayuteehi ajran AAatheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Sayaqoolu laka almukhallafoona mina alaAArabi shaghalatna amwaluna waahloona faistaghfir lana yaqooloona bialsinatihim ma laysa fee quloobihim qul faman yamliku lakum mina Allahi shayan in arada bikum darran aw arada bikum nafAAan bal kana Allahu bima taAAmaloona khabeeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Bal thanantum an lan yanqaliba alrrasoolu waalmuminoona ila ahleehim abadan wazuyyina thalika fee quloobikum wathanantum thanna alssawi wakuntum qawman booran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waman lam yumin biAllahi warasoolihi fainna aAAtadna lilkafireena saAAeeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walillahi mulku alssamawati waalardi yaghfiru liman yashao wayuAAaththibu man yashao wakana Allahu ghafooran raheeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Sayaqoolu almukhallafoona itha intalaqtum ila maghanima litakhuthooha tharoona nattabiAAkum yureedoona an yubaddiloo kalama Allahi qul lan tattabiAAoona kathalikum qala Allahu min qablu fasayaqooloona bal tahsudoonana bal kanoo la yafqahoona illa qaleelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul lilmukhallafeena mina alaAArabi satudAAawna ila qawmin olee basin shadeedin tuqatiloonahum aw yuslimoona fain tuteeAAoo yutikumu Allahu ajran hasanan wain tatawallaw kama tawallaytum min qablu yuAAaththibkum AAathaban aleeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Laysa AAala alaAAma harajun wala AAala alaAAraji harajun wala AAala almareedi harajun waman yutiAAi Allaha warasoolahu yudkhilhu jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu waman yatawalla yuAAaththibhu AAathaban aleeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Laqad radiya Allahu AAani almumineena ith yubayiAAoonaka tahta alshshajarati faAAalima ma fee quloobihim faanzala alsakeenata AAalayhim waathabahum fathan qareeban}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wamaghanima katheeratan yakhuthoonaha wakana Allahu AAazeezan hakeeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaAAadakumu Allahu maghanima katheeratan takhuthoonaha faAAajjala lakum hathihi wakaffa aydiya alnnasi AAankum walitakoona ayatan lilmumineena wayahdiyakum siratan mustaqeeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waokhra lam taqdiroo AAalayha qad ahata Allahu biha wakana Allahu AAala kulli shayin qadeeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaw qatalakumu allatheena kafaroo lawallawoo aladbara thumma la yajidoona waliyyan wala naseeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Sunnata Allahi allatee qad khalat min qablu walan tajida lisunnati Allahi tabdeelan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wahuwa allathee kaffa aydiyahum AAankum waaydiyakum AAanhum bibatni makkata min baAAdi an athfarakum AAalayhim wakana Allahu bima taAAmaloona baseeran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Humu allatheena kafaroo wasaddookum AAani almasjidi alharami waalhadya maAAkoofan an yablugha mahillahu walawla rijalun muminoona wanisaon muminatun lam taAAlamoohum an tataoohum fatuseebakum minhum maAAarratun bighayri AAilmin liyudkhila Allahu fee rahmatihi man yashao law tazayyaloo laAAaththabna allatheena kafaroo minhum AAathaban aleeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ith jaAAala allatheena kafaroo fee quloobihimu alhamiyyata hamiyyata aljahiliyyati faanzala Allahu sakeenatahu AAala rasoolihi waAAala almumineena waalzamahum kalimata alttaqwa wakanoo ahaqqa biha waahlaha wakana Allahu bikulli shayin AAaleeman}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Laqad sadaqa Allahu rasoolahu alrruya bialhaqqi latadkhulunna almasjida alharama in shaa Allahu amineena muhalliqeena ruoosakum wamuqassireena la takhafoona faAAalima ma lam taAAlamoo fajaAAala min dooni thalika fathan qareeban}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Huwa allathee arsala rasoolahu bialhuda wadeeni alhaqqi liyuthhirahu AAala alddeeni kullihi wakafa biAllahi shaheedan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Muhammadun rasoolu Allahi waallatheena maAAahu ashiddao AAala alkuffari ruhamao baynahum tarahum rukkaAAan sujjadan yabtaghoona fadlan mina Allahi waridwanan seemahum fee wujoohihim min athari alssujoodi thalika mathaluhum fee alttawrati wamathaluhum fee alinjeeli kazarAAin akhraja shatahu faazarahu faistaghlatha faistawa AAala sooqihi yuAAjibu alzzurraAAa liyagheetha bihimu alkuffara waAAada Allahu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati minhum maghfiratan waajran AAatheeman}
\chapter{Al-Hujurat (The Apartments)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tuqaddimoo bayna yadayi Allahi warasoolihi waittaqoo Allaha inna Allaha sameeAAun AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tarfaAAoo aswatakum fawqa sawti alnnabiyyi wala tajharoo lahu bialqawli kajahri baAAdikum libaAAdin an tahbata aAAmalukum waantum la tashAAuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena yaghuddoona aswatahum AAinda rasooli Allahi olaika allatheena imtahana Allahu quloobahum lilttaqwa lahum maghfiratun waajrun AAatheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena yunadoonaka min warai alhujurati aktharuhum la yaAAqiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaw annahum sabaroo hatta takhruja ilayhim lakana khayran lahum waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo in jaakum fasiqun binabain fatabayyanoo an tuseeboo qawman bijahalatin fatusbihoo AAala ma faAAaltum nadimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaiAAlamoo anna feekum rasoola Allahi law yuteeAAukum fee katheerin mina alamri laAAanittum walakinna Allaha habbaba ilaykumu aleemana wazayyanahu fee quloobikum wakarraha ilaykumu alkufra waalfusooqa waalAAisyana olaika humu alrrashidoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fadlan mina Allahi waniAAmatan waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain taifatani mina almumineena iqtataloo faaslihoo baynahuma fain baghat ihdahuma AAala alokhra faqatiloo allatee tabghee hatta tafeea ila amri Allahi fain faat faaslihoo baynahuma bialAAadli waaqsitoo inna Allaha yuhibbu almuqsiteena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Innama almuminoona ikhwatun faaslihoo bayna akhawaykum waittaqoo Allaha laAAallakum turhamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la yaskhar qawmun min qawmin AAasa an yakoonoo khayran minhum wala nisaon min nisain AAasa an yakunna khayran minhunna wala talmizoo anfusakum wala tanabazoo bialalqabi bisa alismu alfusooqu baAAda aleemani waman lam yatub faolaika humu alththalimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ijtaniboo katheeran mina alththanni inna baAAda alththanni ithmun wala tajassasoo wala yaghtab baAAdukum baAAdan ayuhibbu ahadukum an yakula lahma akheehi maytan fakarihtumoohu waittaqoo Allaha inna Allaha tawwabun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha alnnasu inna khalaqnakum min thakarin waontha wajaAAalnakum shuAAooban waqabaila litaAAarafoo inna akramakum AAinda Allahi atqakum inna Allaha AAaleemun khabeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qalati alaAArabu amanna qul lam tuminoo walakin qooloo aslamna walamma yadkhuli aleemanu fee quloobikum wain tuteeAAoo Allaha warasoolahu la yalitkum min aAAmalikum shayan inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Innama almuminoona allatheena amanoo biAllahi warasoolihi thumma lam yartaboo wajahadoo biamwalihim waanfusihim fee sabeeli Allahi olaika humu alssadiqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul atuAAallimoona Allaha bideenikum waAllahu yaAAlamu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi waAllahu bikulli shayin AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yamunnoona AAalayka an aslamoo qul la tamunnoo AAalayya islamakum bali Allahu yamunnu AAalaykum an hadakum lileemani in kuntum sadiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna Allaha yaAAlamu ghayba alssamawati waalardi waAllahu baseerun bima taAAmaloona}
\chapter{Qaf (Qaf)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qaf waalqurani almajeedi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Bal AAajiboo an jaahum munthirun minhum faqala alkafiroona hatha shayon AAajeebun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Aitha mitna wakunna turaban thalika rajAAun baAAeedun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qad AAalimna ma tanqusu alardu minhum waAAindana kitabun hafeethun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Bal kaththaboo bialhaqqi lamma jaahum fahum fee amrin mareejin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}

\chapter{Al-Hadid (Iron)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Sabbaha lillahi ma fee alssamawati waalardi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi yuhyee wayumeetu wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Huwa alawwalu waalakhiru waalththahiru waalbatinu wahuwa bikulli shayin AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Huwa allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda fee sittati ayyamin thumma istawa AAala alAAarshi yaAAlamu ma yaliju fee alardi wama yakhruju minha wama yanzilu mina alssamai wama yaAAruju feeha wahuwa maAAakum ayna ma kuntum waAllahu bima taAAmaloona baseerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi waila Allahi turjaAAu alomooru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yooliju allayla fee alnnahari wayooliju alnnahara fee allayi wahuwa AAaleemun bithati alssudoori}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Aminoo biAllahi warasoolihi waanfiqoo mimma jaAAalakum mustakhlafeena feehi faallatheena amanoo minkum waanfaqoo lahum ajrun kabeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama lakum la tuminoona biAllahi waalrrasoolu yadAAookum lituminoo birabbikum waqad akhatha meethaqakum in kuntum mumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Huwa allathee yunazzilu AAala AAabdihi ayatin bayyinatin liyukhrijakum mina alththulumati ila alnnoori wainna Allaha bikum laraoofun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama lakum alla tunfiqoo fee sabeeli Allahi walillahi meerathu alssamawati waalardi la yastawee minkum man anfaqa min qabli alfathi waqatala olaika aAAthamu darajatan mina allatheena anfaqoo min baAAdu waqataloo wakullan waAAada Allahu alhusna waAllahu bima taAAmaloona khabeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Man tha allathee yuqridu Allaha qardan hasanan fayudaAAifahu lahu walahu ajrun kareemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yawma tara almumineena waalmuminati yasAAa nooruhum bayna aydeehim wabiaymanihim bushrakumu alyawma jannatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha thalika huwa alfawzu alAAatheemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yawma yaqoolu almunafiqoona waalmunafiqatu lillatheena amanoo onthuroona naqtabis min noorikum qeela irjiAAoo waraakum failtamisoo nooran faduriba baynahum bisoorin lahu babun batinuhu feehi alrrahmatu wathahiruhu min qibalihi alAAathabu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yunadoonahum alam nakun maAAakum qaloo bala walakinnakum fatantum anfusakum watarabbastum wairtabtum wagharratkumu alamaniyyu hatta jaa amru Allahi wagharrakum biAllahi algharooru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faalyawma la yukhathu minkum fidyatun wala mina allatheena kafaroo mawakumu alnnaru hiya mawlakum wabisa almaseeru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alam yani lillatheena amanoo an takhshaAAa quloobuhum lithikri Allahi wama nazala mina alhaqqi wala yakoonoo kaallatheena ootoo alkitaba min qablu fatala AAalayhimu alamadu faqasat quloobuhum wakatheerun minhum fasiqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{IAAlamoo anna Allaha yuhyee alarda baAAda mawtiha qad bayyanna lakumu alayati laAAallakum taAAqiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna almussaddiqeena waalmussaddiqati waaqradoo Allaha qardan hasanan yudaAAafu lahum walahum ajrun kareemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena amanoo biAllahi warusulihi olaika humu alssiddeeqoona waalshshuhadao AAinda rabbihim lahum ajruhum wanooruhum waallatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biayatina olaika ashabu aljaheemi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{IAAlamoo annama alhayatu alddunya laAAibun walahwun wazeenatun watafakhurun baynakum watakathurun fee alamwali waalawladi kamathali ghaythin aAAjaba alkuffara nabatuhu thumma yaheeju fatarahu musfarran thumma yakoonu hutaman wafee alakhirati AAathabun shadeedun wamaghfiratun mina Allahi waridwanun wama alhayatu alddunya illa mataAAu alghuroori}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Sabiqoo ila maghfiratin min rabbikum wajannatin AAarduha kaAAardi alssamai waalardi oAAiddat lillatheena amanoo biAllahi warusulihi thalika fadlu Allahi yuteehi man yashao waAllahu thoo alfadli alAAatheemi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ma asaba min museebatin fee alardi wala fee anfusikum illa fee kitabin min qabli an nabraaha inna thalika AAala Allahi yaseerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Likayla tasaw AAala ma fatakum wala tafrahoo bima atakum waAllahu la yuhibbu kulla mukhtalin fakhoorin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena yabkhaloona wayamuroona alnnasa bialbukhli waman yatawalla fainna Allaha huwa alghaniyyu alhameedu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Laqad arsalna rusulana bialbayyinati waanzalna maAAahumu alkitaba waalmeezana liyaqooma alnnasu bialqisti waanzalna alhadeeda feehi basun shadeedun wamanafiAAu lilnnasi waliyaAAlama Allahu man yansuruhu warusulahu bialghaybi inna Allaha qawiyyun AAazeezun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walaqad arsalna noohan waibraheema wajaAAalna fee thurriyyatihima alnnubuwwata waalkitaba faminhum muhtadin wakatheerun minhum fasiqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thumma qaffayna AAala atharihim birusulina waqaffayna biAAeesa ibni maryama waataynahu alinjeela wajaAAalna fee quloobi allatheena ittabaAAoohu rafatan warahmatan warahbaniyyatan ibtadaAAooha ma katabnaha AAalayhim illa ibtighaa ridwani Allahi fama raAAawha haqqa riAAayatiha faatayna allatheena amanoo minhum ajrahum wakatheerun minhum fasiqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ittaqoo Allaha waaminoo birasoolihi yutikum kiflayni min rahmatihi wayajAAal lakum nooran tamshoona bihi wayaghfir lakum waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lialla yaAAlama ahlu alkitabi alla yaqdiroona AAala shayin min fadli Allahi waanna alfadla biyadi Allahi yuteehi man yashao waAllahu thoo alfadli alAAatheemi}
\chapter{Al-Mujadilah (The Pleading Woman)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[58][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qad samiAAa Allahu qawla allatee tujadiluka fee zawjiha watashtakee ila Allahi waAllahu yasmaAAu tahawurakuma inna Allaha sameeAAun baseerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[58][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allatheena yuthahiroona minkum min nisaihim ma hunna ommahatihim in ommahatuhum illa allaee waladnahum wainnahum layaqooloona munkaran mina alqawli wazooran wainna Allaha laAAafuwwun ghafoorun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[58][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena yuthahiroona min nisaihim thumma yaAAoodoona lima qaloo fatahreeru raqabatin min qabli an yatamassa thalikum tooAAathoona bihi waAllahu bima taAAmaloona khabeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[58][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faman lam yajid fasiyamu shahrayni mutatabiAAayni min qabli an yatamassa faman lam yastatiAA faitAAamu sitteena miskeenan thalika lituminoo biAllahi warasoolihi watilka hudoodu Allahi walilkafireena AAathabun aleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[58][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena yuhaddoona Allaha warasoolahu kubitoo kama kubita allatheena min qablihim waqad anzalna ayatin bayyinatin walilkafireena AAathabun muheenun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[58][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yawma yabAAathuhumu Allahu jameeAAan fayunabbiohum bima AAamiloo ahsahu Allahu wanasoohu waAllahu AAala kulli shayin shaheedun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[58][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alam tara anna Allaha yaAAlamu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi ma yakoonu min najwa thalathatin illa huwa rabiAAuhum wala khamsatin illa huwa sadisuhum wala adna min thalika wala akthara illa huwa maAAahum ayna ma kanoo thumma yunabbiohum bima AAamiloo yawma alqiyamati inna Allaha bikulli shayin AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[58][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alam tara ila allatheena nuhoo AAani alnnajwa thumma yaAAoodoona lima nuhoo AAanhu wayatanajawna bialithmi waalAAudwani wamaAAsiyati alrrasooli waitha jaooka hayyawka bima lam yuhayyika bihi Allahu wayaqooloona fee anfusihim lawla yuAAaththibuna Allahu bima naqoolu hasbuhum jahannamu yaslawnaha fabisa almaseeru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[58][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha tanajaytum fala tatanajaw bialithmi waalAAudwani wamaAAsiyati alrrasooli watanajaw bialbirri waalttaqwa waittaqoo Allaha allathee ilayhi tuhsharoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[58][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Innama alnnajwa mina alshshaytani liyahzuna allatheena amanoo walaysa bidarrihim shayan illa biithni Allahi waAAala Allahi falyatawakkali almuminoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[58][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha qeela lakum tafassahoo fee almajalisi faifsahoo yafsahi Allahu lakum waitha qeela onshuzoo faonshuzoo yarfaAAi Allahu allatheena amanoo minkum waallatheena ootoo alAAilma darajatin waAllahu bima taAAmaloona khabeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[58][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha najaytumu alrrasoola faqaddimoo bayna yaday najwakum sadaqatan thalika khayrun lakum waatharu fain lam tajidoo fainna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[58][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Aashfaqtum an tuqaddimoo bayna yaday najwakum sadaqatin faith lam tafAAaloo wataba Allahu AAalaykum faaqeemoo alssalata waatoo alzzakata waateeAAoo Allaha warasoolahu waAllahu khabeerun bima taAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[58][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alam tara ila allatheena tawallaw qawman ghadiba Allahu AAalayhim ma hum minkum wala minhum wayahlifoona AAala alkathibi wahum yaAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[58][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{aAAadda Allahu lahum AAathaban shadeedan innahum saa ma kanoo yaAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[58][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ittakhathoo aymanahum junnatan fasaddoo AAan sabeeli Allahi falahum AAathabun muheenun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[58][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lan tughniya AAanhum amwaluhum wala awladuhum mina Allahi shayan olaika ashabu alnnari hum feeha khalidoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[58][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yawma yabAAathuhumu Allahu jameeAAan fayahlifoona lahu kama yahlifoona lakum wayahsaboona annahum AAala shayin ala innahum humu alkathiboona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[58][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Istahwatha AAalayhimu alshshaytanu faansahum thikra Allahi olaika hizbu alshshaytani ala inna hizba alshshaytani humu alkhasiroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[58][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna allatheena yuhaddoona Allaha warasoolahu olaika fee alathalleena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[58][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Kataba Allahu laaghlibanna ana warusulee inna Allaha qawiyyun AAazeezun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[58][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{La tajidu qawman yuminoona biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri yuwaddoona man hadda Allaha warasoolahu walaw kanoo abaahum aw abnaahum aw ikhwanahum aw AAasheeratahum olaika kataba fee quloobihimu aleemana waayyadahum biroohin minhu wayudkhiluhum jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha radiya Allahu AAanhum waradoo AAanhu olaika hizbu Allahi ala inna hizba Allahi humu almuflihoona}
\chapter{Al-Hashr (The Banishment)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[59][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Sabbaha lillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[59][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Huwa allathee akhraja allatheena kafaroo min ahli alkitabi min diyarihim liawwali alhashri ma thanantum an yakhrujoo wathannoo annahum maniAAatuhum husoonuhum mina Allahi faatahumu Allahu min haythu lam yahtasiboo waqathafa fee quloobihimu alrruAAba yukhriboona buyootahum biaydeehim waaydee almumineena faiAAtabiroo ya olee alabsari}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[59][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walawla an kataba Allahu AAalayhimu aljalaa laAAaththabahum fee alddunya walahum fee alakhirati AAathabu alnnari}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[59][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thalika biannahum shaqqoo Allaha warasoolahu waman yushaqqi Allaha fainna Allaha shadeedu alAAiqabi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[59][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ma qataAAtum min leenatin aw taraktumooha qaimatan AAala osooliha fabiithni Allahi waliyukhziya alfasiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[59][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wama afaa Allahu AAala rasoolihi minhum fama awjaftum AAalayhi min khaylin wala rikabin walakinna Allaha yusallitu rusulahu AAala man yashao waAllahu AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[59][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ma afaa Allahu AAala rasoolihi min ahli alqura falillahi walilrrasooli walithee alqurba waalyatama waalmasakeeni waibni alssabeeli kay la yakoona doolatan bayna alaghniyai minkum wama atakumu alrrasoolu fakhuthoohu wama nahakum AAanhu faintahoo waittaqoo Allaha inna Allaha shadeedu alAAiqabi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[59][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lilfuqarai almuhajireena allatheena okhrijoo min diyarihim waamwalihim yabtaghoona fadlan mina Allahi waridwanan wayansuroona Allaha warasoolahu olaika humu alssadiqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[59][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena tabawwaoo alddara waaleemana min qablihim yuhibboona man hajara ilayhim wala yajidoona fee sudoorihim hajatan mimma ootoo wayuthiroona AAala anfusihim walaw kana bihim khasasatun waman yooqa shuhha nafsihi faolaika humu almuflihoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[59][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena jaoo min baAAdihim yaqooloona rabbana ighfir lana waliikhwanina allatheena sabaqoona bialeemani wala tajAAal fee quloobina ghillan lillatheena amanoo rabbana innaka raoofun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[59][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alam tara ila allatheena nafaqoo yaqooloona liikhwanihimu allatheena kafaroo min ahli alkitabi lain okhrijtum lanakhrujanna maAAakum wala nuteeAAu feekum ahadan abadan wain qootiltum lanansurannakum waAllahu yashhadu innahum lakathiboona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[59][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lain okhrijoo la yakhrujoona maAAahum walain qootiloo la yansuroonahum walain nasaroohum layuwallunna aladbara thumma la yunsaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[59][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Laantum ashaddu rahbatan fee sudoorihim mina Allahi thalika biannahum qawmun la yafqahoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[59][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{La yuqatiloonakum jameeAAan illa fee quran muhassanatin aw min warai judurin basuhum baynahum shadeedun tahsabuhum jameeAAan waquloobuhum shatta thalika biannahum qawmun la yaAAqiloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[59][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Kamathali allatheena min qablihim qareeban thaqoo wabala amrihim walahum AAathabun aleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[59][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Kamathali alshshaytani ith qala lilinsani okfur falamma kafara qala innee bareeon minka innee akhafu Allaha rabba alAAalameena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[59][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fakana AAaqibatahuma annahuma fee alnnari khalidayni feeha wathalika jazao alththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[59][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ittaqoo Allaha waltanthur nafsun ma qaddamat lighadin waittaqoo Allaha inna Allaha khabeerun bima taAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[59][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala takoonoo kaallatheena nasoo Allaha faansahum anfusahum olaika humu alfasiqoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[59][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{La yastawee ashabu alnnari waashabu aljannati ashabu aljannati humu alfaizoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[59][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Law anzalna hatha alqurana AAala jabalin laraaytahu khashiAAan mutasaddiAAan min khashyati Allahi watilka alamthalu nadribuha lilnnasi laAAallahum yatafakkaroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[59][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Huwa Allahu allathee la ilaha illa huwa AAalimu alghaybi waalshshahadati huwa alrrahmanu alrraheemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[59][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Huwa Allahu allathee la ilaha illa huwa almaliku alquddoosu alssalamu almuminu almuhayminu alAAazeezu aljabbaru almutakabbiru subhana Allahi AAamma yushrikoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[59][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Huwa Allahu alkhaliqu albario almusawwiru lahu alasmao alhusna yusabbihu lahu ma fee alssamawati waalardi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu}
\chapter{Al-Mumtahanah (The Woman who is Examined)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[60][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tattakhithoo AAaduwwee waAAaduwwakum awliyaa tulqoona ilayhim bialmawaddati waqad kafaroo bima jaakum mina alhaqqi yukhrijoona alrrasoola waiyyakum an tuminoo biAllahi rabbikum in kuntum kharajtum jihadan fee sabeelee waibtighaa mardatee tusirroona ilayhim bialmawaddati waana aAAlamu bima akhfaytum wama aAAlantum waman yafAAalhu minkum faqad dalla sawaa alssabeeli}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[60][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{In yathqafookum yakoonoo lakam aAAdaan wayabsutoo ilaykum aydiyahum waalsinatahum bialssooi wawaddoo law takfuroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[60][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Lan tanfaAAakum arhamukum wala awladukum yawma alqiyamati yafsilu baynakum waAllahu bima taAAmaloona baseerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[60][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qad kanat lakum oswatun hasanatun fee ibraheema waallatheena maAAahu ith qaloo liqawmihim inna buraao minkum wamimma taAAbudoona min dooni Allahi kafarna bikum wabada baynana wabaynakumu alAAadawatu waalbaghdao abadan hatta tuminoo biAllahi wahdahu illa qawla ibraheema liabeehi laastaghfiranna laka wama amliku laka mina Allahi min shayin rabbana AAalayka tawakkalna wailayka anabna wailayka almaseeru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[60][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Rabbana la tajAAalna fitnatan lillatheena kafaroo waighfir lana rabbana innaka anta alAAazeezu alhakeemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[60][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Laqad kana lakum feehim oswatun hasanatun liman kana yarjoo Allaha waalyawma alakhira waman yatawalla fainna Allaha huwa alghanniyyu alhameedu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[60][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{AAasa Allahu an yajAAala baynakum wabayna allatheena AAadaytum minhum mawaddatan waAllahu qadeerun waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[60][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{La yanhakumu Allahu AAani allatheena lam yuqatilookum fee alddeeni walam yukhrijookum min diyarikum an tabarroohum watuqsitoo ilayhim inna Allaha yuhibbu almuqsiteena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[60][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Innama yanhakumu Allahu AAani allatheena qatalookum fee alddeeni waakhrajookum min diyarikum wathaharoo AAala ikhrajikum an tawallawhum waman yatawallahum faolaika humu alththalimoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[60][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha jaakumu almuminatu muhajiratin faimtahinoohunna Allahu aAAlamu bieemanihinna fain AAalimtumoohunna muminatin fala tarjiAAoohunna ila alkuffari la hunna hillun lahum wala hum yahilloona lahunna waatoohum ma anfaqoo wala junaha AAalaykum an tankihoohunna itha ataytumoohunna ojoorahunna wala tumsikoo biAAisami alkawafiri waisaloo ma anfaqtum walyasaloo ma anfaqoo thalikum hukmu Allahi yahkumu baynakum waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[60][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wain fatakum shayon min azwajikum ila alkuffari faAAaqabtum faatoo allatheena thahabat azwajuhum mithla ma anfaqoo waittaqoo Allaha allathee antum bihi muminoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[60][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu itha jaaka almuminatu yubayiAAnaka AAala an la yushrikna biAllahi shayan wala yasriqna wala yazneena wala yaqtulna awladahunna wala yateena bibuhtanin yaftareenahu bayna aydeehinna waarjulihinna wala yaAAseenaka fee maAAroofin fabayiAAhunna waistaghfir lahunna Allaha inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[60][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tatawallaw qawman ghadiba Allahu AAalayhim qad yaisoo mina alakhirati kama yaisa alkuffaru min ashabi alquboori}
\chapter{As-Saff (The Ranks)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[61][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Sabbaha lillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[61][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo lima taqooloona ma la tafAAaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[61][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Kabura maqtan AAinda Allahi an taqooloo ma la tafAAaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[61][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Inna Allaha yuhibbu allatheena yuqatiloona fee sabeelihi saffan kaannahum bunyanun marsoosun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[61][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith qala moosa liqawmihi ya qawmi lima tuthoonanee waqad taAAlamoona annee rasoolu Allahi ilaykum falamma zaghoo azagha Allahu quloobahum waAllahu la yahdee alqawma alfasiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[61][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waith qala AAeesa ibnu maryama ya banee israeela innee rasoolu Allahi ilaykum musaddiqan lima bayna yadayya mina alttawrati wamubashshiran birasoolin yatee min baAAdee ismuhu ahmadu falamma jaahum bialbayyinati qaloo hatha sihrun mubeenun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[61][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waman athlamu mimmani iftara AAala Allahi alkathiba wahuwa yudAAa ila alislami waAllahu la yahdee alqawma alththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[61][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yureedoona liyutfioo noora Allahi biafwahihim waAllahu mutimmu noorihi walaw kariha alkafiroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[61][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Huwa allathee arsala rasoolahu bialhuda wadeeni alhaqqi liyuthhirahu AAala alddeeni kullihi walaw kariha almushrikoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[61][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo hal adullukum AAala tijaratin tunjeekum min AAathabin aleemin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[61][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Tuminoona biAllahi warasoolihi watujahidoona fee sabeeli Allahi biamwalikum waanfusikum thalikum khayrun lakum in kuntum taAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[61][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yaghfir lakum thunoobakum wayudkhilkum jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu wamasakina tayyibatan fee jannati AAadnin thalika alfawzu alAAatheemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[61][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waokhra tuhibboonaha nasrun mina Allahi wafathun qarreebun wabashshiri almumineena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[61][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo koonoo ansara Allahi kama qala AAeesa ibnu maryama lilhawariyyeena man ansaree ila Allahi qala alhawariyyoona nahnu ansaru Allahi faamanat taifatun min banee israeela wakafarat taifatun faayyadna allatheena amanoo AAala AAaduwwihim faasbahoo thahireena}
\chapter{Al-Jumu'ah (The Congregation)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[62][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yusabbihu lillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi almaliki alquddoosi alAAazeezi alhakeemi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[62][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Huwa allathee baAAatha fee alommiyyeena rasoolan minhum yatloo AAalayhim ayatihi wayuzakkeehim wayuAAallimuhumu alkitaba waalhikmata wain kanoo min qablu lafee dalalin mubeenin}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[62][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waakhareena minhum lamma yalhaqoo bihim wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[62][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thalika fadlu Allahi yuteehi man yashao waAllahu thoo alfadli alAAatheemi}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[62][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Mathalu allatheena hummiloo alttawrata thumma lam yahmilooha kamathali alhimari yahmilu asfaran bisa mathalu alqawmi allatheena kaththaboo biayati Allahi waAllahu la yahdee alqawma alththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[62][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul ya ayyuha allatheena hadoo in zaAAamtum annakum awliyao lillahi min dooni alnnasi fatamannawoo almawta in kuntum sadiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[62][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wala yatamannawnahu abadan bima qaddamat aydeehim waAllahu AAaleemun bialththalimeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[62][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Qul inna almawta allathee tafirroona minhu fainnahu mulaqeekum thumma turaddoona ila AAalimi alghaybi waalshshahadati fayunabbiokum bima kuntum taAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[62][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha noodiya lilssalati min yawmi aljumuAAati faisAAaw ila thikri Allahi watharoo albayAAa thalikum khayrun lakum in kuntum taAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[62][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faitha qudiyati alssalatu faintashiroo fee alardi waibtaghoo min fadli Allahi waothkuroo Allaha katheeran laAAallakum tuflihoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[62][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha raaw tijaratan aw lahwan infaddoo ilayha watarakooka qaiman qul ma AAinda Allahi khayrun mina allahwi wamina alttijarati waAllahu khayru alrraziqeena}
\chapter{Al-Munafiqun (The Hypocrites)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[63][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Itha jaaka almunafiqoona qaloo nashhadu innaka larasoolu Allahi waAllahu yaAAlamu innaka larasooluhu waAllahu yashhadu inna almunafiqeena lakathiboona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[63][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ittakhathoo aymanahum junnatan fasaddoo AAan sabeeli Allahi innahum saa ma kanoo yaAAmaloona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[63][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thalika biannahum amanoo thumma kafaroo fatubiAAa AAala quloobihim fahum la yafqahoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[63][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha raaytahum tuAAjibuka ajsamuhum wain yaqooloo tasmaAA liqawlihim kaannahum khushubun musannadatun yahsaboona kulla sayhatin AAalayhim humu alAAaduwwu faihtharhum qatalahumu Allahu anna yufakoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[63][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waitha qeela lahum taAAalaw yastaghfir lakum rasoolu Allahi lawwaw ruoosahum waraaytahum yasuddoona wahum mustakbiroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[63][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Sawaon AAalayhim astaghfarta lahum am lam tastaghfir lahum lan yaghfira Allahu lahum inna Allaha la yahdee alqawma alfasiqeena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[63][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Humu allatheena yaqooloona la tunfiqoo AAala man AAinda rasooli Allahi hatta yanfaddoo walillahi khazainu alssamawati waalardi walakinna almunafiqeena la yafqahoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[63][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yaqooloona lain rajaAAna ila almadeenati layukhrijanna alaAAazzu minha alathalla walillahi alAAizzatu walirasoolihi walilmumineena walakinna almunafiqeena la yaAAlamoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[63][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tulhikum amwalukum wala awladukum AAan thikri Allahi waman yafAAal thalika faolaika humu alkhasiroona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[63][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waanfiqoo min ma razaqnakum min qabli an yatiya ahadakumu almawtu fayaqoola rabbi lawla akhkhartanee ila ajalin qareebin faassaddaqa waakun mina alssaliheena}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[63][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Walan yuakhkhira Allahu nafsan itha jaa ajaluha waAllahu khabeerun bima taAAmaloona}
\chapter{At-Taghabun (The Manifestation of Losses)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[64][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yusabbihu lillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi lahu almulku walahu alhamdu wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[64][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Huwa allathee khalaqakum faminkum kafirun waminkum muminun waAllahu bima taAAmaloona baseerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[64][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Khalaqa alssamawati waalarda bialhaqqi wasawwarakum faahsana suwarakum wailayhi almaseeru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[64][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{YaAAlamu ma fee alssamawati waalardi wayaAAlamu ma tusirroona wama tuAAlinoona waAllahu AAaleemun bithati alssudoori}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[64][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Alam yatikum nabao allatheena kafaroo min qablu fathaqoo wabala amrihim walahum AAathabun aleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[64][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thalika biannahu kanat tateehim rusuluhum bialbayyinati faqaloo abasharun yahdoonana fakafaroo watawallaw waistaghna Allahu waAllahu ghaniyyun hameedun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[64][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{ZaAAama allatheena kafaroo an lan yubAAathoo qul bala warabbee latubAAathunna thumma latunabbaonna bima AAamiltum wathalika AAala Allahi yaseerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[64][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faaminoo biAllahi warasoolihi waalnnoori allathee anzalna waAllahu bima taAAmaloona khabeerun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[64][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Yawma yajmaAAukum liyawmi aljamAAi thalika yawmu alttaghabuni waman yumin biAllahi wayaAAmal salihan yukaffir AAanhu sayyiatihi wayudkhilhu jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha abadan thalika alfawzu alAAatheemu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[64][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biayatina olaika ashabu alnnari khalideena feeha wabisa almaseeru}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[64][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ma asaba min museebatin illa biithni Allahi waman yumin biAllahi yahdi qalbahu waAllahu bikulli shayin AAaleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[64][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{WaateeAAoo Allaha waateeAAoo alrrasoola fain tawallaytum fainnama AAala rasoolina albalaghu almubeenu}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[64][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Allahu la ilaha illa huwa waAAala Allahi falyatawakkali almuminoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[64][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo inna min azwajikum waawladikum AAaduwwan lakum faihtharoohum wain taAAfoo watasfahoo wataghfiroo fainna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[64][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Innama amwalukum waawladukum fitnatun waAllahu AAindahu ajrun AAatheemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[64][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faittaqoo Allaha ma istataAAtum waismaAAoo waateeAAoo waanfiqoo khayran lianfusikum waman yooqa shuhha nafsihi faolaika humu almuflihoona}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[64][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{In tuqridoo Allaha qardan hasanan yudaAAifhu lakum wayaghfir lakum waAllahu shakoorun haleemun}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[64][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{AAalimu alghaybi waalshshahadati alAAazeezu alhakeemu}
\chapter{At-Talaq (Divorce)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[65][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu itha tallaqtumu alnnisaa fatalliqoohunna liAAiddatihinna waahsoo alAAiddata waittaqoo Allaha rabbakum la tukhrijoohunna min buyootihinna wala yakhrujna illa an yateena bifahishatin mubayyinatin watilka hudoodu Allahi waman yataAAadda hudooda Allahi faqad thalama nafsahu la tadree laAAalla Allaha yuhdithu baAAda thalika amran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[65][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Faitha balaghna ajalahunna faamsikoohunna bimaAAroofin aw fariqoohunna bimaAAroofin waashhidoo thaway AAadlin minkum waaqeemoo alshshahadata lillahi thalikum yooAAathu bihi man kana yuminu biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri waman yattaqi Allaha yajAAal lahu makhrajan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[65][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wayarzuqhu min haythu la yahtasibu waman yatawakkal AAala Allahi fahuwa hasbuhu inna Allaha balighu amrihi qad jaAAala Allahu likulli shayin qadran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[65][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Waallaee yaisna mina almaheedi min nisaikum ini irtabtum faAAiddatuhunna thalathatu ashhurin waallaee lam yahidna waolatu alahmali ajaluhunna an yadaAAna hamlahunna waman yattaqi Allaha yajAAal lahu min amrihi yusran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[65][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Thalika amru Allahi anzalahu ilaykum waman yattaqi Allaha yukaffir AAanhu sayyiatihi wayuAAthim lahu ajran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[65][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Askinoohunna min haythu sakantum min wujdikum wala tudarroohunna litudayyiqoo AAalayhinna wain kunna olati hamlin faanfiqoo AAalayhinna hatta yadaAAna hamlahunna fain ardaAAna lakum faatoohunna ojoorahunna watamiroo baynakum bimaAAroofin wain taAAasartum fasaturdiAAu lahu okhra}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[65][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Liyunfiq thoo saAAatin min saAAatihi waman qudira AAalayhi rizquhu falyunfiq mimma atahu Allahu la yukallifu Allahu nafsan illa ma ataha sayajAAalu Allahu baAAda AAusrin yusran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[65][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Wakaayyin min qaryatin AAatat AAan amri rabbiha warusulihi fahasabnaha hisaban shadeedan waAAaththabnaha AAathaban nukran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[65][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Fathaqat wabala amriha wakana AAaqibatu amriha khusran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[65][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{aAAadda Allahu lahum AAathaban shadeedan faittaqoo Allaha ya olee alalbabi allatheena amanoo qad anzala Allahu ilaykum thikran}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[65][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{Rasoolan yatloo AAalaykum ayati Allahi mubayyinatin liyukhrija allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati mina alththulumati ila alnnoori waman yumin biAllahi wayaAAmal salihan yudkhilhu jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha abadan qad ahsana Allahu lahu rizqan}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[65][12]
\end{Arabic}}
